l-m-h3-b0c34-02.material: Ikirari: Zaɓuɓɓuka biyu masu darajar sa ran iri ɗaya suna da sakamako masu yiwuwa iri ɗaya, don haka babu bambanci wanne ka zaɓa. (Ga tsabar kuɗi da dan lido, kanun/wutsiya da ma'aura/mara ma'aura kowanne yiwuwar 1/2 ne.) Nemo ma'auratan da ke karyata ikirarin.

l-m-h3-b0c34-02.s.s1.o.c: Kanun ko wutsiya duka won 100 da ma'aura ko mara ma'aura duka won 100
l-m-h3-b0c34-02.s.s1.r.c: Zaɓuɓɓukan biyu suna bayar da tabbataccen won 100. Wannan misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-h3-b0c34-02.s.s1.o.d: Won 100 tabbatacce da jefa kuɗi: kanun won 200, wutsiya won 0
l-m-h3-b0c34-02.s.s1.explain: Darajar sa ran biyun won 100 ce, amma na farko koyaushe daidai won 100 ne, na biyun kuma ko won 200 ko 0. Sakamakon ya bambanta.

l-m-h3-b0c34-04.goal: Bincika ko ikirarin cewa riba mai tarawa ta fi riba mai sauƙi koyaushe gaskiya ne, nemo kuma ka bayyana yanayin da bai yi aiki ba (misalin karyatawa).
l-m-h3-b0c34-04.material: Ikirari: Idan babban jari da yawan riba na shekara (5%) iri ɗaya ne, riba mai tarawa koyaushe ta fi riba mai sauƙi. Bayan ajiye won 100×10,000, duba ko ya dogara da shekarun da aka bari.

l-m-h3-b0c34-04.s.s1.explain: Bayan shekara 1 ribar sauƙi da ta tarawa duka won 5×10,000 ce, sun yi daidai kuma ikirarin cewa ta tarawa ta “fi” ya gaza. Bambancin yana farawa shekara ta 2.
l-m-h3-b0c34-04.s.s2.model.0: Bayan shekara 1 ribar sauƙi da ta tarawa duka won 5×10,000 ce kuma daidai suke, don haka ikirarin cewa ta tarawa ta fi ya gaza.

l-m-h3-b0c35-01.s.s1.r.a: Tallace-tallace sun tashi daga won 10,000 zuwa won 11,000, don haka misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.

l-m-h3-b0c35-01.s.s1.r.d: Tallace-tallace sun tashi daga won 8,000 zuwa won 9,000, don haka misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-h3-b0c35-01.s.s1.explain: 500×200=won 100,000 ne, amma 600×150=won 90,000, saboda haka ya ragu. Idan adadin da aka sayar ya ragu sosai, tallace-tallace kan ragu.
l-m-h3-b0c35-01.s.s2.model.0: Farashin ya ƙaru amma tallace-tallace sun ragu daga won 100,000 zuwa won 90,000, saboda haka wannan shagon ne misalin da ya karya ikirarin.

l-m-h3-b0c35-09.s.s1.r.a: Ƙimar fata ta A ta fi girma, kuma yiwuwar asararsa ta fi ƙasa, saboda haka ya dace da da’awar.
l-m-h3-b0c35-09.s.s1.r.c: B ya fi a duka biyun, saboda haka wannan misali ya dace da da’awar.
l-m-h3-b0c35-09.s.s1.r.d: A ya fi a duka biyun, saboda haka wannan misali ya dace da da’awar.
l-m-h3-b0c35-09.s.s1.explain: Ƙimar fata ta A ta fi girma, amma yiwuwar asararsa ma 40% ce, fiye da 5% na B. Ko da matsakaicin riba ya yi yawa, haɗarin asara na iya zama babba.
l-m-h3-b0c35-09.s.s2.model.0: Ƙimar fata ta A ta fi girma, wato 50, amma yiwuwar asararsa 40% ce, fiye da 5% na B. Wannan misalin ƙaryatawa ne.
l-m-h3-b0c35-09.s.s2.model.1: Ƙimar fata matsakaici ce kawai. Saboda haka kamar A, ko da matsakaicin ya yi yawa, yiwuwar asara na iya kaiwa 40%.

l-m-h3-b0c36-03.material: Da’awa: Ga aikin f, wurin da f’(x)=0 koyaushe ne wurin da f ke da ƙima mafi ƙaranci. Nemo aiki da wuri da ke karya wannan.

l-m-h3-b0c37-03.title: Idan MSE ɗaya ne, MAE ma ɗaya ne?
l-m-h3-b0c37-03.goal: Duba ko da’awar cewa samfurori biyu masu MSE ɗaya suna da MAE ɗaya kullum gaskiya ce. Idan ba haka ba, kawo misali mai karya ta.
l-m-h3-b0c37-03.material: Da’awa: Samfurori biyu masu matsakaicin kuskuren murabba’i (MSE) ɗaya suna da matsakaicin kuskuren cikakkiyar ƙima (MAE) ɗaya. Cikin nau’ikan kuskure huɗu, nemo wanda ke karya ta.
l-m-h3-b0c37-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi biyun da suka saɓa da da’awar (misalin karya).
l-m-h3-b0c37-03.s.s1.r.a: MSE da MAE duka 1 ne, don haka misali ne mai goyon baya.
l-m-h3-b0c37-03.s.s1.r.b: MSE=4 da MAE=2 ga duka; misali ne mai goyon baya.
l-m-h3-b0c37-03.s.s1.r.c: MSE=9/4 da MAE=3/4 ga duka, don haka misali ne mai goyon baya.
l-m-h3-b0c37-03.s.s1.explain: MSE na biyun 4 ne amma MAE 2 da 1 ne. Idan kuskure ya taru wuri guda, MAE na bambanta duk da MSE ɗaya.
l-m-h3-b0c37-03.s.s2.model.0: (2,2,2,2) yana da MSE 4, MAE 2; (0,0,0,4) yana da MSE 4, MAE 1. MAE ya bambanta, wannan misalin karya ne.
l-m-h3-b0c37-03.s.s2.model.1: Idan kuskure ya taru wuri guda, matsakaicin cikakkun ƙimomi ya ragu saboda murabba’i, ko MSE ɗaya ne; da’awar ta gaza.

l-m-h3-b0c37-04.title: Idan recall ya yi yawa, precision ma yana da yawa?
l-m-h3-b0c37-04.goal: Duba ko da’awar recall 90% ko fiye yana nufin precision 90% ko fiye gaskiya ce kullum. Idan ba haka ba, kawo misali mai karya ta.
l-m-h3-b0c37-04.material: Da’awa: Samfurin da recall ɗinsa aƙalla 90% yana da precision aƙalla 90%. Samfurorin nan duka suna da recall aƙalla 90%. (TP=marasa lafiya da aka gano, FN=waɗanda aka rasa, FP=lafiyayyu da aka kira marasa lafiya) Nemo samfurin da ya karya da’awar.
l-m-h3-b0c37-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi samfurin da precision ɗinsa ƙasa da 90%.
l-m-h3-b0c37-04.s.s1.r.a: Recall 0.9 da precision 0.9; misali ne da ya dace da da’awar.
l-m-h3-b0c37-04.s.s1.r.b: Recall 0.9 da precision 0.9; misali ne da ya dace da da’awar.
l-m-h3-b0c37-04.s.s1.r.c: Recall 0.9 da precision 0.9; misali ne da ya dace da da’awar.
l-m-h3-b0c37-04.s.s1.explain: Idan aka kira kowa mara lafiya, recall 100% ne amma precision 50/200=25%. Recall kaɗai ba ya nuna ƙararrawar ƙarya.
l-m-h3-b0c37-04.s.s2.model.0: Da TP 50 da FP 150, precision ita ce 50/200=25%, recall kuma 100%; saboda haka wannan misali ne mai karya ikirarin.
l-m-h3-b0c37-04.s.s2.model.1: Idan ka kira kusan kowa da sakamako tabbatacce domin kada ka rasa marasa lafiya, recall ya yi yawa amma akwai ƙararrawar ƙarya da yawa, don haka precision ya yi ƙasa.

l-m-h3-b0c40-01.goal: Ka bincika ko ikirarin cewa canza zafin jiki zuwa Fahrenheit yana sa lambar ta fi girma gaskiya ne koyaushe, sannan ka nemo ka bayyana yanayin da ba haka ba (misalin karyatawa).
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.material: Ana samun Fahrenheit ta hanyar ninka Celsius da 1.8 sannan a ƙara 32 (F = 1.8C + 32). Ikirari: lambar zafin jiki iri ɗaya a Fahrenheit tana da girma fiye da lambar a Celsius koyaushe.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi zafin jikin da ya karya ikirarin.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s1.r.a: 32 ya fi 0 girma, saboda haka ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s1.r.b: 212 ya fi 100 girma, saboda haka ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s1.r.c: 68 ya fi 20 girma, saboda haka ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s1.explain: −50°C shi ne 1.8×(−50)+32=−58°F. −58 ya fi −50 ƙanƙanta, saboda haka ikirarin cewa lambar Fahrenheit ta fi girma ya karye.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s2.model.0: Canza −50°C zuwa Fahrenheit yana ba da −58°F, kuma −58 ya fi −50 ƙanƙanta; saboda haka ikirarin ya karye.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s2.model.1: Idan lambar ba ta da kyau, ninka ta da 1.8 yana ƙara rage ta, don haka ko bayan ƙara 32 sai ta zama −58. Lambar Fahrenheit ta fi ƙanƙanta, wannan kuwa misali ne na karyatawa.

l-m-h3-b0c41-01.goal: Ka bincika ko ikirarin “tun da 1m=100cm ne, 1m²=100cm²” gaskiya ne koyaushe, sannan ka nemo ka bayyana yanayin da ba haka ba (misalin karyatawa).
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.material: Ikirari: Tun da 1m=100cm ne, 1m²=100cm². A wurin da ake canza girman fili daga m² zuwa cm², mu duba ko wannan ikirari gaskiya ne.
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi gaskiyar da ke nuna cewa wannan ikirari ba daidai ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s1.r.a: Canza tsawon daidai ne. Wannan ba hujja ba ce cewa canza yanki ba daidai ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s1.r.b: Wannan gaskiya ne, amma bai nuna ƙimar da aka samu bayan canzawa ba.
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s1.r.d: An yi lissafin a m² kaɗai, saboda haka ba a iya kwatanta shi da cm² ba.
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s1.explain: Idan gefe ɗaya 100cm ne, yankin shi ne 100×100=10000cm². Dole ne a ɗaga rabon canza tsawon zuwa murabba'i.
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s2.model.0: 1m² shi ne 100cm×100cm=10000cm², amma ikirarin ya ce 100cm², saboda haka wannan misali ne na karyatawa.
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s2.model.1: Ana samun yanki ta ninka faɗi da tsawo, saboda haka ana kuma ɗaga rabon canzawa zuwa murabba'i, wanda ya ba da 10000cm².

l-m-h3-b0c44-02.material: Ikirari: Idan ma'aunin alaƙa na masu canji biyu ya zama 0, babu wata dangantaka ko kaɗan a tsakaninsu. A cikin bayanan da ke ƙasa, nemo yanayin da ma'aunin alaƙa ya zama 0 amma akwai bayyananniyar dangantaka.
l-m-h3-b0c44-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi bayanan da suka saɓa wa ikirarin.
l-m-h3-b0c44-02.s.s1.r.a: y yana ƙaruwa tare da x, saboda haka ma'aunin alaƙa ya zama 1, ba 0 ba.
l-m-h3-b0c44-02.s.s1.r.b: y yana motsawa akasin x, saboda haka ma'aunin alaƙa ya zama −1, ba 0 ba.
l-m-h3-b0c44-02.s.s1.r.d: y yana da daidaiton kai-tsaye da x, saboda haka ma'aunin alaƙa ya zama 1, ba 0 ba.
l-m-h3-b0c44-02.s.s1.explain: Ga y=x² inda x ya kasance daga −2 zuwa 2, ma'aunin alaƙa ya zama 0, amma y yana dogara ne da x. Ma'aunin alaƙa yana auna dangantakar layi madaidaiciya kawai.
l-m-h3-b0c44-02.s.s2.model.0: Idan y=x² kuma x yana daga −2 zuwa 2, ma'aunin alaƙa ya zama 0, amma y yana dogara ne da x, don haka akwai dangantaka.
l-m-h3-b0c44-02.s.s2.model.1: Ma'aunin alaƙa yana auna dangantakar layi madaidaiciya kawai; saboda haka, idan dangantakar tana da lanƙwasa, ba za ka ce babu dangantaka ba saboda kawai ma'aunin ya zama 0.

l-m-h3-b0c47-01.title: Shin rabon sharuɗɗa biyu maƙwabta koyaushe ya fi 1.6 girma?
l-m-h3-b0c47-01.goal: Bincika ko maganar “rabo tsakanin sharuɗɗa biyu maƙwabta (na baya ÷ na farko) koyaushe ya fi 1.6 girma” gaskiya ce, sannan ka nemo ka bayyana yanayin da ba haka ba (misali mai karya magana).
l-m-h3-b0c47-01.material: A cikin jerin Fibonacci 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21, …, rabon sharuɗɗa biyu maƙwabta (na baya ÷ na farko) yana matsowa kusa da rabon zinariya 1.618. Magana: wannan rabo koyaushe ya fi 1.6 girma.
l-m-h3-b0c47-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi rabon sharuɗɗa biyu maƙwabta da ya saɓa wa maganar (misali mai karya ta).
l-m-h3-b0c47-01.s.s1.r.a: 1.667 ya fi 1.6 girma, saboda haka misali ne da ya dace da maganar.
l-m-h3-b0c47-01.s.s1.r.c: 1.625 ya fi 1.6 girma, saboda haka misali ne da ya dace da maganar.
l-m-h3-b0c47-01.s.s1.r.d: 1.615 ya fi 1.6 girma, saboda haka misali ne da ya dace da maganar.
l-m-h3-b0c47-01.s.s1.explain: 3÷2=1.5 ya yi ƙasa da 1.6. Rabon sharuɗɗa na farko-farko yana hawa da sauka a kusa da 1.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-01.s.s2.model.0: 3÷2=1.5 ya yi ƙasa da 1.6. Tun da wasu rabon sun kai 1.6 ko ƙasa da haka, wannan misali ne mai karya maganar.
l-m-h3-b0c47-01.s.s2.model.1: Dukkan sauran rabon sun fi 1.6 girma, amma 3÷2=1.5, saboda haka maganar ba gaskiya ba ce koyaushe.

l-m-h3-b0d07-15.goal: Duba ko da’awar cewa abin da aka samo daga aikin exponential yana da kyau koyaushe gaskiya ce, sannan nemo misali inda ba gaskiya ba (misalin ƙaryatawa) kuma bayyana shi.
l-m-h3-b0d07-15.material: Da’awa: abin da aka samo daga y=aˣ (a>0, a≠1) yana da kyau ga kowane x. Nemo aikin exponential da ke nuna wannan da’awa ba daidai ba ce.
l-m-h3-b0d07-15.s.s1.prompt: Wane aiki ne ya saba wa da’awar?
l-m-h3-b0d07-15.s.s1.r.a: Abin da aka samo 10ˣ ln 10 yana da kyau koyaushe. Misali ne da ya dace da da’awar.
l-m-h3-b0d07-15.s.s1.r.b: Abin da aka samo 2ˣ ln 2 yana da kyau koyaushe. Misali ne da ya dace da da’awar.
l-m-h3-b0d07-15.s.s1.r.d: Abin da aka samo eˣ ne, wanda yake da kyau koyaushe. Misali ne da ya dace da da’awar.
l-m-h3-b0d07-15.s.s1.explain: (aˣ)'=aˣ ln a. Idan 0<a<1, to ln a<0, saboda haka abin da aka samo mara kyau ne.
l-m-h3-b0d07-15.s.s2.model.0: Abin da aka samo daga (1/2)ˣ shi ne (1/2)ˣ ln(1/2); tun da ln(1/2)<0, koyaushe mara kyau ne, don haka misali ne na ƙaryatawa.

l-m-h3-b0d07-28.title: Shin integral na ninkin daidai yake da ninkin integral-olin?
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.goal: Bincika ko ikirarin ∫fg dx=∫f dx·∫g dx koyaushe gaskiya ne, sannan ka nemo ka bayyana yanayin da ba haka ba (misalin karyatawa).
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.material: Ikirari: A kan zangon [0,1], ∫f(x)g(x)dx=(∫f(x)dx)(∫g(x)dx) koyaushe yana aiki. Nemo f da g da ke karyata ikirarin.
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.s.s1.prompt: Wane f da g ne suka saɓa wa ikirarin?
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.s.s1.r.a: Bangarorin biyu 1 ne, don haka wannan misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.s.s1.r.b: Bangarorin biyu 1/2 ne, don haka wannan misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.s.s1.r.c: Bangarorin biyu 0 ne, don haka wannan misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.s.s1.explain: Idan f=g=x, to ∫x²dx=1/3, amma (1/2)(1/2)=1/4. Sun bambanta.
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.s.s2.model.0: Idan f=g=x, to ∫x²dx=1/3, amma ninkawar ƙimomin ∫x dx ita ce 1/4; saboda haka ƙimomin biyu sun bambanta, wannan kuma misalin karyatawa ne.
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.s.s2.model.1: Haɗin samfurin yana bada 1/3, ninkawar haɗe-haɗen dabam kuma tana bada 1/4; saboda haka ikirarin ya karye idan f=g=x.

l-m-h3-b0d08-01.goal: Bincika ko maganar “idan aₙ→1 to aₙⁿ→1” gaskiya ce koyaushe, sannan ka nemo ka bayyana yanayin da ba haka ba (misali mai karya magana).
l-m-h3-b0d08-01.material: Magana: Idan jerin aₙ ya taru zuwa 1, to aₙⁿ ma yana taruwa zuwa 1. Nemo jerin da ke nuna wannan maganar ba daidai ba ce.
l-m-h3-b0d08-01.s.s1.prompt: Wane jerin ne ya saɓa wa maganar?
l-m-h3-b0d08-01.s.s1.r.b: aₙⁿ=1, saboda haka yana taruwa zuwa 1. Misali ne da ya dace da maganar.
l-m-h3-b0d08-01.s.s1.r.c: (1+1/n²)ⁿ ma yana kusantar 1. Misali ne da ya dace da maganar.
l-m-h3-b0d08-01.s.s1.r.d: (1−1/n²)ⁿ ma yana kusantar 1. Misali ne da ya dace da maganar.
l-m-h3-b0d08-01.s.s1.explain: (1+1/n)ⁿ kusan 2.717 ne idan n=1000, kuma yana taruwa zuwa e. Ba 1 ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0d08-01.s.s2.model.0: Ko da tushe na (1+1/n)ⁿ yana kusantar 1, ma’aunin n yana ƙaruwa a lokaci guda, saboda haka yana taruwa zuwa e≈2.718, ba 1 ba; wannan misali ne mai karya magana.
l-m-h3-b0d08-01.s.s2.model.1: Idan n=1000, (1+1/1000)¹⁰⁰⁰≈2.717, wanda ya yi nisa da 1, saboda haka maganar ta gaza ga aₙ=1+1/n.

l-m-h3-b0d09-15.title: Idan sakamakon dot product ɗin ya yi daidai, shin vector biyun ma sun yi daidai?
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.goal: Duba ko ikirarin cewa a·b=a·c yana nufin b=c gaskiya ne koyaushe, sannan nemo kuma bayyana yanayin da bai yi aiki ba (misali mai karya ikirarin).
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.material: Ikirari: ga vector a wanda ba sifili ba, idan a·b=a·c, to b=c. Da a=(1, 0), nemo b da c da ke nuna cewa ikirarin ba daidai ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.s.s1.prompt: Wadanne b da c ne suka karyata ikirarin?
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.s.s1.r.a: a·b=3 kuma a·c=2 ba su daidaita ba, saboda haka sharadin farko bai cika ba.
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.s.s1.r.c: b da c vector ɗaya ne, saboda haka ba za su iya karyata ikirarin ba.

l-m-h3-b0c36-07.title: Domin ƙayyade matsayi na gaba a saukowar gangara
l-m-h3-b0c36-07.goal: Domin lissafa matsayi na gaba a saukowar gangara, ƙayyade muhimmin ma’auni (bayani), sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c36-07.material: Muna amfani da saukowar gangara domin kusantar ƙaramin darajar f(x). Domin ɗaukar mataki daga x na yanzu da ƙayyade matsayi na gaba, ka yi tunanin abin da ya kamata mu sani.
l-m-h3-b0c36-07.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ake buƙata domin ƙayyade matsayi na gaba?
l-m-h3-b0c36-07.s.s1.r.a: Ba tare da gangara a matsayin yanzu ba, ba za ka iya ƙayyade alkibla da girman mataki ba.
l-m-h3-b0c36-07.s.s1.o.b: Gangara a matsayin yanzu da ƙimar koyon
l-m-h3-b0c36-07.s.s1.r.c: Ba a amfani da tushen y wajen ƙayyade matsayi na gaba.
l-m-h3-b0c36-07.s.s1.r.d: Ko ba tare da sanin mafi ƙarancin darajar ba, za ka iya ɗaukar mataki idan ka san gangara.
l-m-h3-b0c36-07.s.s1.explain: x_sabo = x − (ƙimar koyon)×(gangara). Gangara tana ba da alkibla da girma, ƙimar koyon kuma tana ƙayyade faɗin mataki.
l-m-h3-b0c36-07.s.s2.model.0: Gangara tana nuna alkiblar gangarowa, ƙimar koyon kuma tana ƙayyade girman mataki; saboda haka duka biyun ana buƙata.
l-m-h3-b0c36-07.s.s2.model.1: Muna bincike ba tare da sanin mafi ƙarancin daraja ba; saboda haka dole a ƙayyade matsayi na gaba ta amfani da gangara a matsayin yanzu da ƙimar koyon kawai.

l-m-h3-b0c36-08.title: Domin sanin ko an rasa marasa lafiya
l-m-h3-b0c36-08.goal: Domin gano ko samfurin ya rasa wasu marasa lafiya, ƙayyade muhimmin ma’auni (bayani), sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c36-08.material: Muna tantance samfurin gwajin cuta. Abin da muke son sani shi ne yawan ainihin marasa lafiyar da samfurin ya gano a matsayin marasa lafiya.
l-m-h3-b0c36-08.s.s1.prompt: Wane ma’auni ne ke nuna wannan?
l-m-h3-b0c36-08.s.s1.o.a: Rabon amsoshin da suka dace cikin duka
l-m-h3-b0c36-08.s.s1.r.a: Da daidaito, marasa lafiya da aka rasa za su iya ɓoyuwa a cikin amsoshin masu lafiya da suka dace.
l-m-h3-b0c36-08.s.s1.o.b: Rabon ainihin marasa lafiya cikin waɗanda aka kira masu tabbataccen sakamako
l-m-h3-b0c36-08.s.s1.r.b: Wannan daidaiton tabbatacce ne, yana duba ko ƙararrakin ƙarya ba su da yawa. Ba ya nuna marasa lafiya da aka rasa.
l-m-h3-b0c36-08.s.s1.o.c: Rabon ainihin marasa lafiyar da aka gano da sakamako tabbatacce
l-m-h3-b0c36-08.s.s1.o.d: Lokacin da samfurin ya ɗauka wajen horo
l-m-h3-b0c36-08.s.s1.r.d: Lokacin horo ba shi da alaƙa da ikon gano marasa lafiya.
l-m-h3-b0c36-08.s.s1.explain: Recall shi ne rabon ainihin marasa lafiyar da aka gano. Ƙarancin marasa lafiyar da aka rasa yana nufin recall ya fi girma.
l-m-h3-b0c36-08.s.s2.model.0: Tambayar ita ce rabon ainihin marasa lafiyar da aka gano; saboda haka ya kamata a duba recall, wanda ainihin marasa lafiya ne ke zama tushen rabon.
l-m-h3-b0c36-08.s.s2.model.1: Daidaito yana haɗa amsoshin masu lafiya da suka dace, precision kuma yana amfani da hasashen sakamako tabbatacce a matsayin tushen rabon; saboda haka babu ɗayansu da ke nuna yawan marasa lafiyar da aka rasa.

l-m-h3-b0c37-05.material: Muna son sanin ko vectors a da b marasa sifili suna tsaye wa juna. Samfurin dot shi ne darajar da ake samu ta ninka abubuwan da suka dace sannan a tara. Ka yi tunanin bayanin da ake buƙata ƙwarai.
l-m-h3-b0c37-05.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ake buƙata ƙwarai domin sanin ko suna tsaye wa juna?
l-m-h3-b0c37-05.s.s1.r.a: Girman su kaɗai ba zai nuna alaƙar alkibla ba.
l-m-h3-b0c37-05.s.s1.o.b: Yawan abubuwan da ke cikin vectors biyun
l-m-h3-b0c37-05.s.s1.r.b: Ko da yawan abubuwan ya yi daidai, ba za ka iya sanin ko suna tsaye wa juna ba.
l-m-h3-b0c37-05.s.s1.o.c: Darajar da aka samu ta tara dukkan abubuwan vectors biyun
l-m-h3-b0c37-05.s.s1.r.c: Jimillar abubuwa ba za ta nuna alaƙar alkibla tsakanin vectors biyun ba.
l-m-h3-b0c37-05.s.s1.o.d: Darajar samfurin dot na vectors biyun
l-m-h3-b0c37-05.s.s1.explain: Vectors biyu marasa sifili suna tsaye wa juna ne kawai idan samfurin dot ya zama 0. Darajar samfurin dot guda ɗaya ta isa yanke hukunci.
l-m-h3-b0c37-05.s.s2.model.0: Idan suna tsaye wa juna, samfurin dot 0 ne; idan samfurin dot 0 ne, suna tsaye wa juna. Saboda haka darajar samfurin dot kaɗai ta isa yanke hukunci.

l-m-h3-b0c37-06.title: Bayanin da ake buƙata don tazarar amincewa ta matsakaici
l-m-h3-b0c37-06.goal: Domin nemo tazarar amincewa 95% ta matsakaicin jama’a, ƙayyade abin da ake buƙata ƙwarai (bayani), sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c37-06.material: Idan an san karkacewar ma’auni ta jama’a, muna son ƙiyasta matsakaicin jama’a da tazarar amincewa 95%. Tazarar ita ce matsakaicin samfur ± 1.96×(karkacewar ma’aunin jama’a ÷ √girman samfur). Ka yi tunanin bayanin da ake buƙata.
l-m-h3-b0c37-06.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ake buƙata ƙwarai domin gina tazarar?
l-m-h3-b0c37-06.s.s1.o.a: Mafi girma da ƙarami na samfur
l-m-h3-b0c37-06.s.s1.r.a: Zango kaɗai ba zai ba da kuskuren ma’auni ba.
l-m-h3-b0c37-06.s.s1.o.b: Matsakaicin samfur, karkacewar ma’aunin jama’a, da girman samfur
l-m-h3-b0c37-06.s.s1.o.c: Matsakaicin samfur da girman samfur kawai
l-m-h3-b0c37-06.s.s1.r.c: Karkacewar ma’aunin jama’a, wadda ke nuna yaɗuwa, ta ɓace; saboda haka ba za a ƙayyade faɗin tazarar ba.
l-m-h3-b0c37-06.s.s1.r.d: Yaɗuwa da girman samfur da ake buƙata domin ƙayyade tazarar kuskure sun ɓace.
l-m-h3-b0c37-06.s.s1.explain: Tsakiyar tazarar ita ce matsakaicin samfur, faɗinta kuma 1.96×σ÷√n ne. Ana buƙatar dukkan ƙimomi ukun domin ƙayyade iyakokin biyu.
l-m-h3-b0c37-06.s.s2.model.0: Tsakiyar tazarar ita ce matsakaicin samfur, karkacewar ma’aunin jama’a da girman samfur kuma suna ƙayyade faɗinta; saboda haka ana buƙatar ƙimomin ukun.
l-m-h3-b0c37-06.s.s2.model.1: Da matsakaicin samfur kaɗai ba za ka san faɗin ba, saboda haka ba a ƙayyade tazarar ba; karkacewar ma’aunin jama’a da girman samfur ne ke ƙayyade faɗin.

l-m-h3-b0c37-07.title: Domin aikin quadratic ya kasance da mafi ƙarancin daraja
l-m-h3-b0c37-07.goal: Domin sanin ko aikin quadratic f(x)=ax²+bx+c yana da mafi ƙarancin daraja, ƙayyade abin da ake buƙata ƙwarai (bayani), sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c37-07.material: Muna son sanin ko aikin quadratic f(x)=ax²+bx+c (a≠0), wanda ke nuna kuskure, yana da mafi ƙarancin daraja. Ka yi tunanin bayanin da ake buƙata ƙwarai.
l-m-h3-b0c37-07.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ne dole ka sani domin sanin ko akwai mafi ƙarancin daraja?
l-m-h3-b0c37-07.s.s1.r.b: c yana matsar da jadawali sama ko ƙasa kawai. Ba ya canza alkiblar buɗewarsa.
l-m-h3-b0c37-07.s.s1.r.c: Alamar b tana shafar wurin vertex, amma ba za ta ƙayyade alkiblar buɗewar jadawali ba.
l-m-h3-b0c37-07.s.s1.r.d: Discriminant yana nuna sau nawa jadawali ya haɗu da layin x. Wannan daban yake da samun mafi ƙarancin daraja.
l-m-h3-b0c37-07.s.s1.explain: Idan a>0, jadawali yana buɗewa sama kuma yana da mafi ƙarancin daraja. Idan a<0, yana buɗewa ƙasa kuma ba shi da mafi ƙarancin daraja. Alamar a kaɗai ake buƙata.
l-m-h3-b0c37-07.s.s2.model.0: Jadawali yana da mafi ƙarancin daraja ne kawai idan yana buɗewa sama, kuma alamar a ce ke yanke wannan alkibla; saboda haka sanin a ya isa.
l-m-h3-b0c37-07.s.s2.model.1: b da c suna matsar da jadawali kawai, ba sa canza alkiblar buɗewa; alamar a kaɗai ce ke yanke ko akwai mafi ƙarancin daraja.

l-m-h3-b0c38-10.title: Me ake buƙata don nemo yiwuwar sharadi?
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.goal: Ka ƙayyade wane ma’auni (bayani) ake buƙata lallai don nemo yiwuwar faruwar A idan B ta faru, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.material: Muna gina matatar saƙonnin banza. Muna son nemo yiwuwar P(A|B), cewa saƙo na banza ne (A) idan yana ɗauke da kalmar 'free' (B). Mu ƙayyade yiwuwar guda biyu da ake buƙata lallai.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.prompt: Wane ƙima biyu ake buƙata lallai don nemo P(A|B)?
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.r.a: Da waɗannan biyun kaɗai, ba za a iya tantance P(A|B) ba. Ana buƙatar haɗuwar abubuwan.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.r.b: Ana amfani da waɗannan biyun wajen nemo P(B|A). An juya tsarin sharadin.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.r.d: Haɗin abubuwa kaɗai ba ya nuna maka mahaɗin da ke tsakanin su.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.explain: P(A|B)=P(A∩B)/P(B). Wannan shi ne kaso, cikin lokutan da B ta faru, wanda A ma ta faru.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s2.model.0: Ana amfani da lokutan da B ta faru a matsayin tushe kawai, saboda haka ƙasa ita ce P(B), kuma sama tana buƙatar P(A∩B), yiwuwar faruwar duka biyun tare.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s2.model.1: Da P(A) da P(B) kaɗai, ba ka san sau nawa suke faruwa tare ba, saboda haka ba za a iya tantance ƙimar ba; ana buƙatar haɗuwar abubuwan.

l-m-h3-b0c43-02.material: Wannan binciken gidaje ne a gari mai unguwanni 10. Wata hanya tana zaɓar wasu unguwanni kawai ta binciki duk gidajen cikinsu; ɗayar kuma tana zaɓar wasu gidaje daga kowace unguwa. Bambance hanyoyin biyu.

l-m-h3-b0c43-02.s.s1.r.c: Ranar ba ta da alaƙa da yadda aka zaɓa.
l-m-h3-b0c43-02.s.s1.o.d: Teburin sunayen unguwanni a jere bisa haruffa

l-m-h3-b0c44-06.material: Muna son gano yadda dukan ɗalibai 800 na makarantar suke gamsuwa da abincin rana na makaranta, ta hanyar binciken samfurin ɗalibai 100. Ka yi tunanin abin da yake da muhimmanci a hanyar zaɓen ɗaliban domin samfurin ya wakilci makarantar gaba ɗaya.

l-m-h3-b0c44-06.s.s1.o.c: Ɗauki ɗalibai 100 na farko da suka amsa, bisa jerin amsawarsu
l-m-h3-b0c44-06.s.s1.r.c: Hakan na iya karkata ga ɗaliban da suka amsa da wuri.

l-m-h3-b0c44-06.s.s1.r.d: Idan galibi kana zaɓar mutanen da ka sani, samfurin yana karkata gefe ɗaya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-06.s.s1.explain: Dole ne a zaɓa bisa bazata domin kowane ɗalibi ya sami dama iri ɗaya ta zaɓuwa; ta haka samfurin ba zai karkata ga wani rukuni na musamman ba.
l-m-h3-b0c44-06.s.s2.model.0: Zaɓen bazata yana ba kowane ɗalibi dama iri ɗaya ta zaɓuwa, saboda haka samfurin ba ya karkata gefe ɗaya kuma yana wakiltar jama'a.

l-m-h3-b0c44-08.title: Bayanan da ake buƙata don yiwuwar rarrabuwar binomial
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.goal: Ka yanke shawarar wane ma'auni (bayanin da ake buƙata) yake muhimmanci domin gano ƙimomin da ake buƙata wajen lissafa yiwuwar da rarrabuwar binomial, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.material: Ana jefa ƙwayar lamba mai adalci sau da dama, kuma X shi ne adadin lokutan da 6 ta fito. Ka yi tunanin wane bayani yake da muhimmanci domin nemo P(X=2) ta amfani da rarrabuwar binomial B(n, p) da X ke bi.
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s1.o.a: Adadin jefawa n da yiwuwar samun 6 a jefa guda ɗaya p
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s1.o.b: Launin ƙwayar lambar da aka jefa
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s1.r.b: Launin ƙwayar lamba ba shi da alaƙa da yiwuwar samun 6.
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s1.o.c: Lambar da ta fito a jefawar da ta gabata
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s1.r.c: Kowane gwaji yana da 'yanci; saboda haka sakamakon baya ba ya canza yiwuwar.
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s1.o.d: Yadda aka jefa ƙwayar lambar da ƙarfi
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s1.r.d: Idan ƙwayar lamba tana da adalci, yiwuwar ba ta canzawa ko da yaya aka jefa ta da ƙarfi.
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s1.explain: Rarrabuwar binomial tana ƙayyadewa ne da adadin gwaje-gwaje n da yiwuwar nasara p a gwaji guda. Da waɗannan ƙimomi biyu za ka iya nemo P(X=2).
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s2.model.0: Rarrabuwar binomial tana ƙayyadewa ne da n da p; saboda haka, domin nemo P(X=2), kana buƙatar sanin adadin jefawa da yiwuwar samun 6, wato 1/6.
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s2.model.1: Launin ƙwayar lambar da sakamakon jefawar baya ba sa canza yiwuwar, saboda haka n da p kawai ake buƙata.

l-m-h3-b0c45-08.s.s1.explain: Octave ɗaya na nufin rabon mita 2:1. A yanke bisa rabo, ba bambanci ba.

l-m-h3-b0c46-05.title: Me ya kamata mu ƙirga domin sanin ma’aunin bugun kiɗa?
l-m-h3-b0c46-05.goal: Ƙayyade ma’aunin (bayani) da ake buƙata ƙwarai domin gano ma’aunin lokaci na waƙa (3/4, 4/4 da sauransu), sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c46-05.material: Ma’aunin lokaci 3/4 yana nufin awo guda yana ɗauke da tsawon bayanin kula quarter (1/4) guda 3. Kana son gano ma’aunin lokacin waƙa.
l-m-h3-b0c46-05.s.s1.o.a: Yawan kayan kida da ake bugawa
l-m-h3-b0c46-05.s.s1.r.a: Yawan kayan kida ba shi da alaƙa da ma’aunin lokaci.
l-m-h3-b0c46-05.s.s1.r.b: Ko lokacin ya yi tsawo, ba za ka iya sanin tsawon awo guda ba.
l-m-h3-b0c46-05.s.s1.o.c: Yawan nau’ukan bayanin kula da aka yi amfani da su a waƙar
l-m-h3-b0c46-05.s.s1.r.c: Yawan nau’o’i ba zai nuna tsawon awo guda ba.
l-m-h3-b0c46-05.s.s1.o.d: Tsawon bayanin kula quarter (1/4) nawa ne awo guda?
l-m-h3-b0c46-05.s.s1.explain: Ma’aunin lokaci yana ƙayyade tsawon awo guda. Idan ka ƙirga tsawon bayanan kula quarter (1/4), za ka gane ko 3/4 ne ko 4/4.
l-m-h3-b0c46-05.s.s2.model.0: Ma’aunin lokaci yana nuna tsawon da ke shiga awo guda; saboda haka ana buƙatar ƙirga bayanan kula quarter (1/4) nawa ne a awo guda.
l-m-h3-b0c46-05.s.s2.model.1: Tsawon waƙa da yawan kayan kida ba su da alaƙa da tsawon awo; saboda haka ba za su zama ma’aunin yanke ma’aunin lokaci ba.

l-m-h3-b0c46-06.title: Wane bayani ake buƙata domin yin kusurwar dama da igiya mai kulli?
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.topic: Igiya ta Masar da kusurwar dama
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.goal: Ƙayyade ma’aunin (bayani) da ake buƙata ƙwarai domin gano ko triangle da aka yi da igiya mai kulli triangle mai kusurwar dama ce, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.material: Kana yin triangle a ƙasa da madaukiyar igiya mai tazarar sarari 12 daidai, alamar kulli, domin yin kusurwar dama. Kana son gano ko triangle ɗin da ka yi mai kusurwar dama ne.
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s1.o.a: Launi da kayan da aka yi igiyar da su
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s1.r.a: Launi da kayan igiya ba su da alaƙa da kusurwoyi.
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s1.r.b: Ko da akwai sarari 12, ana iya yin triangle marar kusurwar dama, kamar sarari 5, 5, da 2.
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s1.o.c: Yawan sararin da kowane gefen triangle uku yake da shi
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s1.o.d: Yankin ƙasa da aka yi triangle a kansa
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s1.r.d: Ko ƙasar tana da faɗi, ba za ka iya gane siffar triangle ba.
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s1.explain: Idan gefen ukun sarari 3, 4, da 5 ne, 3²+4²=5², saboda haka kusurwar dama ce. Jimillar sarari 12 kaɗai ba ta ƙayyade siffa ba.
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s2.model.0: Ana buƙatar sanin yawan sararin gefuna uku domin duba ko jimillar murabba’ai ta daidaita; saboda haka ana buƙatar yawan sararin kowane gefe.
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s2.model.1: Ko jimillar sarari 12 ce, 3,4,5 da 5,5,2 duka suna yiwuwa; saboda haka jimilla kaɗai ba za ta nuna ko kusurwar dama ce ba. (3, 4, 5, 5)

l-m-h3-b0c46-07.material: Wani bincike ya aika tambayoyi ga miliyoyin mutane da aka zaɓa daga jerin da ya karkata gefe ɗaya, amma sakamakonsa ya bambanta sosai da gaskiya. Kana son gano ko samfurin yana wakiltar kowa.

l-m-h3-b0c46-07.s.s1.r.b: Ko yawan ya yi yawa, zaɓen nau’in mutane guda kawai yana karkatar da sakamako.
l-m-h3-b0c46-07.s.s1.r.d: Rana ba ta da alaƙa sosai da ko samfurin wakilci ne.
l-m-h3-b0c46-07.s.s1.explain: Idan hanyar zaɓe ta karkata gefe ɗaya, komai girman samfurin ba ya wakiltar kowa.
l-m-h3-b0c46-07.s.s2.model.0: Ko samfurin ya yi girma, yana karkata idan wasu mutane kaɗai aka zaɓa; saboda haka yadda aka zaɓa ne ya fi muhimmanci.

l-m-h3-b0c46-08.title: Wane bayani ake buƙata domin warware Caesar cipher?
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.goal: Ƙayyade ma’aunin (bayani) da ake buƙata ƙwarai domin gano rubutun asali na saƙon Caesar cipher, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.material: Caesar cipher yana canza haruffan abjadi ta matsar da kowane harafi adadin matsayi tsayayye. Wanda ya karɓi saƙon sirri yana son gano rubutun asali.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.o.a: Girman takardar da aka rubuta saƙon a kanta
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.r.a: Girman takarda ba shi da alaƙa da ƙa’idar canza haruffa.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.r.b: Yawan haruffa kaɗai ba ya nuna adadin matsarwa.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.o.c: Adadin matsayi da alkiblar da aka matsar da haruffa
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.o.d: Lokacin da aka aika saƙon sirri
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.r.d: Lokacin aikawa ba shi da alaƙa da ƙa’idar canza haruffa.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.explain: Idan ka san adadin matsayi da alkiblar matsarwa, za ka iya matsar da akasin haka domin dawo da haruffan asali.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s2.model.0: An matsar da kowane harafi da adadin matsayi tsayayye; idan ka san adadi da alkibla, za ka iya matsar da baya ka gano rubutun asali.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s2.model.1: Lokaci, girman takarda, da yawan haruffa ba ƙa’idar canji ba ne, don haka ba a buƙatar su wajen warwarewa.

l-m-h3-b0c47-06.s.s1.o.d: Ko tana daidaita idan an juya ta a kusa da cibiyar da aka zaɓa

l-m-h3-b0c47-06.s.s2.model.1: Launi, kewaye, da zamani ba su da alaƙa da sakamakon juyawa; abin da ake buƙata kawai shi ne duba ko tana daidaita bayan an juya.

l-m-h3-b0c47-07.goal: Domin gano ko tsarin lamba tsarin matsayi ne, ƙayyade ma’aunin (bayani) da ake buƙata ƙwarai, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.material: Kowane tsarin lamba yana da alamomi da hanyoyi dabam. Lambobin Roman ba tsarin matsayi ba ne, amma tsarin tushe 60 na Babila da na tushe 10 na yau tsarin matsayi ne.

l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s1.o.a: Ko ana rubuta alamomi daga hagu zuwa dama
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s1.r.a: Alkiblar rubutu ba ta da alaƙa da yadda ake ƙayyade daraja.
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s1.o.b: Ko alama ɗaya tana da daraja dabam bisa matsayinta
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s1.r.c: Lambobin Babila suna da alamomi kaɗan sosai amma har yanzu tsarin matsayi ne.
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s1.o.d: Ko alamomin sun fito daga zane-zane
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s1.r.d: Siffa ko asalin alamomi ba ma’aunin ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s1.explain: Ko alama ɗaya tana canza daraja bisa matsayinta shi ne muhimmin tsarin matsayi.
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s2.model.0: A tushe 10, 2 yana da darajar 2 a matsayar ɗaya, 20 kuma a matsayar goma; saboda haka canjin daraja da matsayi shi ne ma’auni.
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s2.model.1: Tsari na iya zama mai matsayi ko da yawan alamomi ko alkiblar rubutu ta bambanta; saboda haka a duba yadda daraja ke canzawa da matsayi.

l-m-h3-b0c47-08.title: Sakamakon binciken abincin makaranta: me za mu buƙata mu ce yana wakiltar kowa?
l-m-h3-b0c47-08.goal: Domin gano ko sakamakon bincike yana wakiltar makarantar gaba ɗaya, ƙayyade ma’aunin (bayani) da ake buƙata ƙwarai, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c47-08.material: Domin nemo rabon duk ɗaliban makaranta da ke goyon bayan inganta abincin makaranta, an tambayi ɗalibai 100, 62 sun goyi bayan. Yi tunanin ko ya dace a ce sakamakon ra’ayin duk ɗalibai ne.
l-m-h3-b0c47-08.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ake buƙata ƙwarai domin hukunta wakilci?
l-m-h3-b0c47-08.s.s1.r.a: Tuni ka san yawan masu goyon baya. Idan ba ka san yadda aka zaɓe su ba, ba za ka iya hukunta wakilci ba.
l-m-h3-b0c47-08.s.s1.o.b: Yadda aka zaɓi ɗalibai 100 daga cikin kowa
l-m-h3-b0c47-08.s.s1.r.c: Tsawo ba shi da alaƙa da wakilcin rabon masu goyon baya.
l-m-h3-b0c47-08.s.s1.r.d: Lokaci kaɗai ba ya nuna ko samfurin wakilci ne.
l-m-h3-b0c47-08.s.s1.explain: Idan hanyar zaɓe ta nuna son zuciya, sakamakon ma yana karkata. Ko an zaɓa bisa bazata shi ne muhimmin abu ga wakilci.
l-m-h3-b0c47-08.s.s2.model.0: Idan hanyar zaɓe ta karkata, sakamakon ma zai karkata; saboda haka dole a san ko an zaɓe su bisa bazata.
l-m-h3-b0c47-08.s.s2.model.1: Tuni ka san yawan masu goyon baya; domin sanin wakilci, duba yadda aka zaɓi ɗalibai 100 maimakon tsawo ko lokaci.

l-m-h3-b0c47-09.title: Me ake buƙata don sanin ko sautuka biyu suna da octave ɗaya?
l-m-h3-b0c47-09.goal: Nemo bayanin dole don sanin ko sautuka biyu sun bambanta da octave ɗaya, ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c47-09.material: Do da Do mai octave ɗaya sama suna jin kamar suna da sunan sauti ɗaya. Domin hukunta da lambobi ko sautuka biyu suna octave dabam, ka yi tunanin bayanin da ake buƙata ƙwarai.
l-m-h3-b0c47-09.s.s1.o.a: Kayan kiɗan da ya buga sautuka biyun
l-m-h3-b0c47-09.s.s1.r.a: Ko da kayan kida ɗaya ne, alaƙar sauti ana ƙayyade ta mita.
l-m-h3-b0c47-09.s.s1.r.c: Ƙara ba ta da alaƙa da tsayin sautinsa.
l-m-h3-b0c47-09.s.s1.r.d: 220Hz da 440Hz, da 440Hz da 660Hz suna da bambanci iri ɗaya, amma biyun farko kaɗai ne octave.
l-m-h3-b0c47-09.s.s1.explain: Octave alaƙa ce da rabon mita 2:1. A hukunta ta rabon, ba bambanci ba.
l-m-h3-b0c47-09.s.s2.model.0: Idan rabon mita 2:1 ne octave ne; saboda haka ana buƙatar rabon da ake samu ta raba mitocin biyu.
l-m-h3-b0c47-09.s.s2.model.1: 220 da 440 suna da alaƙar ninki 2, octave ne; 440 da 660 suna da bambanci ɗaya amma ninki 1.5 ne, saboda haka bambanci kaɗai bai isa ba.

l-m-h3-b0c48-06.s.s1.r.b: Tsayi ba shi da alaƙa da lokacin da tsawon layin ke canzawa.

l-m-h3-b0c48-06.s.s1.r.c: Matsayin menu ba ya nuna lokacin da layin ya fi tsawo.

l-m-h3-b0c48-06.s.s1.r.d: Adadin kujeru ba shi da alaƙa da tsawon layin a lokuta dabam-dabam.

l-m-h3-b0c48-07.title: Ta yaya ya kamata a inganta tambayar bincike?
l-m-h3-b0c48-07.goal: Gano ma'auni (bayanin) da tambayar bincike take buƙata, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c48-07.material: Kana son mayar da “Wane laima ne mai kyau?” zuwa tambayar bincike. Ka yi tunanin ma'aunin da ake buƙata domin a iya amsa tambaya ta hanyar aunawa.
l-m-h3-b0c48-07.s.s1.prompt: Wace tambaya aka inganta domin a iya amsa ta ta hanyar aunawa?
l-m-h3-b0c48-07.s.s1.o.a: Wane laima ne ya fi kyau a gani?
l-m-h3-b0c48-07.s.s1.r.a: Wannan tambaya ce game da ɗanɗano ko ra'ayi, don haka ba za a iya yanke hukunci ta aunawa ba.
l-m-h3-b0c48-07.s.s1.o.b: Shin laima mafi girma ya fi kyau?
l-m-h3-b0c48-07.s.s1.r.b: Babu ma'aunin abin da ake nufi da “mafi kyau”, don haka ba a bayyana abin da za a auna ba.
l-m-h3-b0c48-07.s.s1.o.c: Me ya sa laima suke zagaye?
l-m-h3-b0c48-07.s.s1.r.c: Tana neman dalili ne, saboda haka babu ma'aunin aunawa.
l-m-h3-b0c48-07.s.s1.o.d: Nawa ne bambancin faɗin wurin da laima masu diamita 80cm da 100cm suke rufewa?
l-m-h3-b0c48-07.s.s1.explain: Ana iya amsa tambaya ta aunawa ne kawai idan ta bayyana abin da za a auna da yadda za a auna shi (mai canji da naúra).
l-m-h3-b0c48-07.s.s2.model.0: Ana iya auna mai canji diamita da sakamakon faɗin wurin da aka rufe da cm; saboda haka wannan tambaya ta dace da bincike.
l-m-h3-b0c48-07.s.s2.model.1: Sauran tambayoyin suna tambayar ɗanɗano ko dalili, ko kuma “mafi kyau” ba a fayyace shi ba; ba a san abin da za a auna ba, don haka bincikensu yana da wuya.

l-m-h3-b0c48-08.s.s1.r.c: Launi ba shi da alaƙa da dangantakar tazara da kuɗi.
l-m-h3-b0c48-08.s.s1.r.d: Lokuta kaɗai ba za su nuna dangantakar tazara da kuɗi ba.

l-m-h3-b0c48-08.s.s2.model.0: Da bayanan kuɗi da tazara biyu mabambanta, za a iya nemo gangara da wurin yanke; saboda haka wannan bayanin wajibi ne.

l-m-h3-b0c49-09.material: Ikirari: “Duk lambar marar ma’aurata firimiya ce.” Ka yi tunanin misalin da ake buƙata ƙwarai domin nuna ikirarin ba daidai ba ne.

l-m-h3-b0c49-09.s.s1.o.b: Lamba guda ma’aurata kuma firimiya ce
l-m-h3-b0c49-09.s.s1.r.b: Lambar ma’aurata ba lambar marar ma’aurata ba ce da ikirarin ya ambata.
l-m-h3-b0c49-09.s.s1.o.c: Lamba guda marar ma’aurata amma ba firimiya ba
l-m-h3-b0c49-09.s.s1.r.d: Komai yawan misalan da suka dace, ba za su karya ikirarin ba.
l-m-h3-b0c49-09.s.s1.explain: Domin karya “duk lambar marar ma’aurata”, misali guda marar ma’aurata amma ba firimiya ya isa. Misali, 9.

l-m-h3-b0c50-01.title: Domin bincika “Shin ɗalibai ba sa samun isasshen barci?”
l-m-h3-b0c50-01.goal: Yanke shawarar ma'auni (bayanin) da yake wajibi domin gano ko ɗaliban makarantarmu ba sa samun isasshen barci, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c50-01.material: Kana son bincika “Shin ɗaliban makarantarmu ba sa samun isasshen barci?” Ka yi tunanin abin da dole ne ka fara yanke shawara domin wannan tambaya ta zama tambayar bincike.
l-m-h3-b0c50-01.s.s1.prompt: Wane ma'auni ne wajibi domin ta zama tambayar bincike?
l-m-h3-b0c50-01.s.s1.o.a: Darussan makaranta da abokai suke so
l-m-h3-b0c50-01.s.s1.r.a: Darasin da aka fi so ba ya nuna ko mutum ba ya samun isasshen barci.
l-m-h3-b0c50-01.s.s1.o.b: Ma'aunin lokacin barci da ke bayyana “bai isa ba”
l-m-h3-b0c50-01.s.s1.r.c: Launin murfin ba shi da alaƙa da amsar tambayar.
l-m-h3-b0c50-01.s.s1.o.d: Yanayin ranar da za a gudanar da binciken
l-m-h3-b0c50-01.s.s1.r.d: Yanayi ba ma'auni ba ne na yanke hukuncin ko barci ya isa.
l-m-h3-b0c50-01.s.s1.explain: Dole ne a yanke shawarar awanni nawa ne ake kira “bai isa ba” kafin bayanai su iya amsa tambayar. Wannan ma'auni ne da za a iya aunawa.
l-m-h3-b0c50-01.s.s2.model.0: Ana iya tantancewa ta auna lokacin barci ne kawai idan an sa ma'aunin “bai isa ba” da awanni; saboda haka wannan wajibi ne.
l-m-h3-b0c50-01.s.s2.model.1: Yanayi da launin murfi ba su da alaƙa da lokacin barci, saboda haka ba za su iya zama ma'auni ba; za a yanke hukunci ne kawai idan akwai ma'aunin lokaci.

l-m-h3-b0c50-13.title: Zaɓen ƙimar wakilci ga hanyar da ɗalibai ke zuwa makaranta
l-m-h3-b0c50-13.goal: Nemo irin ƙa’ida (bayanin) da ya zama dole ƙwarai don zaɓen ƙimar wakilci ga bayanan yadda ɗalibai ke zuwa makaranta, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c50-13.material: An binciki ɗalibai 40 game da yadda suke zuwa makaranta (tafiya a ƙafa, bas, keke). Kana son zaɓen ƙimar wakilci guda ɗaya ga waɗannan bayanai.
l-m-h3-b0c50-13.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙa’ida ce ta fi dacewa wajen zaɓen ƙimar wakilci?
l-m-h3-b0c50-13.s.s1.r.a: Babu ƙima babba a bayanin yadda ɗalibai ke zuwa makaranta.
l-m-h3-b0c50-13.s.s1.o.b: Ko bayanai suna da ƙimomi adadi ne mai even
l-m-h3-b0c50-13.s.s1.r.b: Ko adadin yana da even yana da muhimmanci ne kawai lokacin neman tsakiyar ƙimomi.
l-m-h3-b0c50-13.s.s1.o.c: Ko ƙimomin sunaye ne (rukuni) ko lambobi
l-m-h3-b0c50-13.s.s1.o.d: Tsarin haruffa na sunayen ɗaliban da suka amsa
l-m-h3-b0c50-13.s.s1.r.d: Tsarin sunaye ba shi da alaƙa da yanayin ƙimomin.
l-m-h3-b0c50-13.s.s1.explain: Yadda ɗalibai ke zuwa makaranta suna, ba lambobi ba ne, saboda haka ba za a iya lissafa matsakaici ko tsakiyar ƙima ba. A yi amfani da yanayi, wato ƙimar da ta fi yawan bayyana.
l-m-h3-b0c50-13.s.s2.model.0: Ƙimomin sunaye ne kamar tafiya a ƙafa da bas, saboda haka ba za a iya lissafa matsakaici ba; don haka ko sunaye ne ko lambobi shi ne bayanin da ya zama dole.
l-m-h3-b0c50-13.s.s2.model.1: Ba za a iya tara ko jera bayanan rukuni ba, saboda haka dole ne a yi amfani da ƙimar da ta fi yawan bayyana a matsayin wakili.

l-m-h3-b0c50-25.material: An auna kusurwoyin ciki na triangle da dama da protractor, aka tabbatar jimillarsu kusan 180° ce. Kana son gabaɗaɗa cewa wannan gaskiya ne ga duk triangle.

l-m-h3-b0c50-25.s.s1.r.a: Komai yawan da aka auna, ba za ka iya duba kowane triangle ba.
l-m-h3-b0c50-25.s.s1.o.b: Canza kayan aunawa zuwa protractor mafi tsada
l-m-h3-b0c50-25.s.s1.r.b: Ko da yana da daidaito, ba ya ba da dalilin da ya shafi duk triangle.
l-m-h3-b0c50-25.s.s1.o.c: Ba da dalili mai ma’ana da ya shafi kowane triangle

l-m-h3-b0c50-25.s.s1.r.d: Ba za a iya gabaɗaɗa daga triangle na musamman kawai ba.

l-m-h3-b0c50-32.topic: Duba Ko Za a Iya Amincewa da Ikirari
l-m-h3-b0c50-32.goal: Gano ma'auni (bayanin) da yake wajibi domin tantance ikirarin tallan “Gamsuwa: 90% na masu amfani,” sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0c50-32.material: Tallan manhaja yana cewa “90% na masu amfani sun gamsu.” Kana son bincika ko za a iya amincewa da wannan ikirari.
l-m-h3-b0c50-32.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ne wajibi domin yanke hukuncin ko za a iya amincewa da shi?
l-m-h3-b0c50-32.s.s1.r.a: Launi ba shi da alaƙa da yadda za a amince da sakamakon bincike.
l-m-h3-b0c50-32.s.s1.r.b: Adadin masu haɓakawa ba shi da alaƙa da samfurin binciken.
l-m-h3-b0c50-32.s.s1.o.c: Mutane nawa aka tambaya da kuma yadda aka zaɓe su
l-m-h3-b0c50-32.s.s1.o.d: Girman shafin da tallan ya bayyana a kai
l-m-h3-b0c50-32.s.s1.r.d: Girman shafin ba shi da alaƙa da ingancin binciken.
l-m-h3-b0c50-32.s.s1.explain: Amincewa da ikirarin 90% ya danganta da ko an tambayi mutane 10 ko mutane 10,000 da aka zaɓa bisa bazata (1 cikin 10,000). Girman samfurin da yadda aka zaɓe shi suna da muhimmanci.
l-m-h3-b0c50-32.s.s2.model.0: Matakin amincewa da ikirarin 90% yana sauyawa gwargwadon ko an tambayi mutane 10 ko mutane 10,000 da aka zaɓa bisa bazata (1 cikin 10,000); saboda haka adadin mutane da hanyar zaɓe ake buƙata.
l-m-h3-b0c50-32.s.s2.model.1: Launi da girman shafi ba su da alaƙa da sakamakon; saboda haka yadda aka gudanar da binciken shi ne ma'aunin da yake wajibi.

l-m-h3-b0d07-03.title: Yaushe rⁿ ke taruwa: me ya kamata mu sani game da r?
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.goal: Nemo irin ƙa’ida (bayanin) da ya zama dole ƙwarai don gano kewayon r wanda jerin lissafi na ninkuwa rⁿ ke taruwa a ciki, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.material: Kana son yanke shawarar ko jerin {rⁿ} yana taruwa ko yana watsewa. Me kake buƙatar sani game da r na gama-gari?
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ne ke tabbatar da taruwa gaba ɗaya ba tare da barin wani abu a waje ba?
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.r.b: Idan r=1, jerin yana taruwa zuwa 1, kuma wannan ƙa’ida kaɗai za ta rasa wannan yanayin.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.r.c: r=2 tabbatacce ne amma yana watsewa; r=−0.5 kuma marar tabbas ne amma yana taruwa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.r.d: r=1/2 ba lamba cikakkiya ba ce amma tana taruwa zuwa 0.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.explain: Idan −1<r<1, yana taruwa zuwa 0; idan r=1, yana taruwa zuwa 1; idan r≤−1 ko r>1, yana watsewa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s2.model.0: Idan r=1, jerin ma yana taruwa zuwa 1, yayin da idan r≤−1 ko r>1 yana watsewa; saboda haka dole ne a san ko −1<r≤1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s2.model.1: Idan ka duba |r|<1 kawai, ka rasa r=1; saboda haka dole ne a bincika ko −1<r≤1 domin tantance daidai ko jerin yana taruwa.

l-m-h3-b0d07-12.goal: Nemo ƙa’idar (bayanin) da ake buƙata da gaske don gano ko jerin lissafi na ninkuwa marar iyaka yana taruwa, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.material: Me ke yanke shawarar ko jerin lissafi na ninkuwa marar iyaka a+ar+ar²+… (a≠0) yana taruwa?
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙa’ida ce ke yanke shawarar taruwa?
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.o.a: Ko kalma ta farko a ta yi ƙasa da 1
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.r.a: Idan a=0.5 kuma r=1, kalmomin suna nan a 0.5, saboda haka jerin yana watsewa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.o.b: Ko kalma ta farko a tabbatacciya ce
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.r.b: Ko a tabbatacciya ce, jerin yana watsewa idan r=2; ko da a marar tabbas ce, yana taruwa idan r=1/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.o.c: Ko cikakken ƙimar rabon gama-gari r ya yi ƙasa da 1
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.r.d: Idan −1<r<0, yana taruwa duk da cewa alamomin suna canzawa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.explain: Idan a≠0, jerin lissafi na ninkuwa yana taruwa idan |r|<1, kuma jimillarsa a/(1−r) ce. Idan |r|≥1, yana watsewa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s2.model.0: Domin kalmomin su kusanci 0, ana buƙatar |r|<1; sannan jimillar ɓangare tana kusantar a/(1−r), saboda haka girman rabon gama-gari ne ƙa’idar tantancewa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s2.model.1: Canza a ba ya canza ko jerin yana haɗuwa, saboda haka a ba ma’auni ba ne. Ko cikakken ƙimar r ta gaza 1 ne ke yanke haɗuwa.

l-m-h3-b0d07-14.title: Me ya kamata mu sani domin gane ko akwai matsakaicin ko ƙaramin ƙima?
l-m-h3-b0d07-14.goal: Nemo wane ma’auni (bayanin da ake buƙata) ne da gaske ake bukata domin yanke ko akwai matsakaicin ko ƙaramin ƙima a x=a, kuma bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0d07-14.material: Muna son yanke ko aikin f mai bambancewa yana da matsakaici ko ƙaramin ƙima a x=a. Wane bayani ake bukata da gaske?
l-m-h3-b0d07-14.s.s1.r.a: f(x)=x³ ba shi da matsakaici ko ƙaramin ƙima duk da cewa f'(0)=0.
l-m-h3-b0d07-14.s.s1.r.b: Ƙimar aiki guda ɗaya ba ta isa a kwatanta da ƙimomin da ke kewaye ba.
l-m-h3-b0d07-14.s.s1.o.c: Ko alamar f'(x) tana canzawa a ɓangarorin biyu na a
l-m-h3-b0d07-14.s.s1.r.d: Dukansu x³ da x⁴ suna da f''(0)=0, amma kasancewar matsakaici ko ƙaramin ƙima ya bambanta.
l-m-h3-b0d07-14.s.s1.explain: Matsakaici ko ƙaramin ƙima yana faruwa idan f' ya zama 0 kuma alamar tasa ta canza a ɓangarorin wannan wuri. f'(a)=0 kaɗai bai isa ba.
l-m-h3-b0d07-14.s.s2.model.0: Ko da f'(a)=0, ba matsakaici ko ƙaramin ƙima ba ne idan alamun ɓangarorin biyu iri ɗaya ne, saboda haka dole a san ko alamar tana canzawa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-14.s.s2.model.1: Matsakaici ko ƙaramin ƙima ne kawai idan ya sauya daga ƙaruwa zuwa raguwa ko akasin haka; saboda haka ana buƙatar sanin canjin alamar f' a ɓangarorin biyu.

l-m-h3-b0d08-03.title: Bayanin da ake buƙata ga iyakar (aⁿ+bⁿ)/(aⁿ⁺¹+bⁿ⁺¹)
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.goal: Don nemo iyakar (aⁿ+bⁿ)/(aⁿ⁺¹+bⁿ⁺¹), gano ƙa’idojin (bayanai) da suka zama dole ƙwarai, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinsu.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.material: Ga lambobi masu tabbas a da b, kana son tantance ƙimar lim(n→∞) (aⁿ+bⁿ)/(aⁿ⁺¹+bⁿ⁺¹).
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ne ya zama dole ƙwarai don tantance ƙimar?
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.r.a: Ko a+b iri ɗaya ne, iyakar (2,1) da (1.5,1.5) sun bambanta.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.o.b: Wanne daga cikin a da b ne ya fi girma
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.o.c: Ko a da b lambobi cikakku ne
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.r.c: Ko da ba lambobi cikakku ba ne, ana iya tantance ƙimar iyaka.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.o.d: Ko n even ne ko odd
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.r.d: Idan a da b masu tabbas ne, ba ruwansu ko n even ne ko odd.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.explain: Iyakar ita ce 1/max(a, b). Ƙarfin babbar ƙima ce ke sarrafa lambar sama da ƙasa.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s2.model.0: Ƙarfin babbar lamba ce ke sarrafa jimillar, saboda haka iyakar ta zama 1/(babbar lamba); shi ya sa dole ne a san wacce ce ta fi girma.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s2.model.1: Idan a>b, to (b/a)ⁿ→0, saboda haka iyakar 1/a ce; idan a=b ma 1/a ce, don haka sanin wacce ta fi girma yana tantance iyakar.

l-m-h3-b0d08-10.title: Bayanin da ake buƙata don nuna jerin baya haɗuwa
l-m-h3-b0d08-10.goal: Don gano dalilin da Σn/(2n+1) ba ya haɗuwa, gano ma’aunin da bayaninsa ake bukata ƙwarai, kuma bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0d08-10.material: Kana son nuna cewa jerin Σ(n=1~∞) n/(2n+1) ba ya haɗuwa.
l-m-h3-b0d08-10.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ne ake bukata ƙwarai don nuna haka?
l-m-h3-b0d08-10.s.s1.r.a: Kalmar farko kaɗai ba za ta iya yanke ko yana haɗuwa ba.
l-m-h3-b0d08-10.s.s1.r.b: 1/n² ma kaso ne, amma jerinsa yana haɗuwa.
l-m-h3-b0d08-10.s.s1.o.c: Cewa dukkan kalmomin suna da kyau
l-m-h3-b0d08-10.s.s1.r.c: 1/2ⁿ ma dukkan kalmominsa masu kyau ne, amma jerinsa yana haɗuwa.
l-m-h3-b0d08-10.s.s1.o.d: Cewa iyakar kalmar gama-gari ba 0 ba ce
l-m-h3-b0d08-10.s.s1.explain: n/(2n+1)→1/2≠0, saboda haka kalmomin ba sa komawa 0. Shi ya sa jerin ba zai haɗu ba.
l-m-h3-b0d08-10.s.s2.model.0: Idan jerin ya haɗu, kalmar gama-gari dole ta koma 0; amma n/(2n+1) yana komawa 1/2, saboda haka ba ya haɗuwa.
l-m-h3-b0d08-10.s.s2.model.1: Idan iyakar kalmar gama-gari ba 0 ba ce, jimillar tana ci gaba da taruwa ba iyaka, saboda haka muhimmin sani shi ne cewa iyakar 1/2 ce.

l-m-h3-b0d08-16.title: Ƙimomin da ake buƙata don gangaren layin taɓawa ga lanƙwan ma’auni
l-m-h3-b0d08-16.goal: Don nemo gangaren layin taɓawa ga lanƙwan ma’auni a t=1, gano ma’aunin da bayaninsa ake buƙata ƙwarai, kuma bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0d08-16.material: A kan lanƙwan da aka bayar da ma’aunin x=f(t), y=g(t), kana son nemo gangaren layin taɓawa a t=1.
l-m-h3-b0d08-16.s.s1.prompt: Waɗanne ƙimomi ake buƙata ƙwarai don nemo gangaren?
l-m-h3-b0d08-16.s.s1.r.a: Waɗannan suna nuna wurin batu ne kawai, ba gangare ba.
l-m-h3-b0d08-16.s.s1.r.b: Ba tare da sanin dy/dt ba, ba za a iya nemo gangaren ba.
l-m-h3-b0d08-16.s.s1.r.c: Ba tare da sanin dx/dt ba, ba za a iya nemo gangaren ba.
l-m-h3-b0d08-16.s.s1.o.d: Ƙimomin f'(1) da g'(1), inda f'(1)≠0
l-m-h3-b0d08-16.s.s1.explain: dy/dx=g'(t)/f'(t), saboda haka a t=1 ana buƙatar ƙimomin f'(1) da g'(1).
l-m-h3-b0d08-16.s.s2.model.0: Gangaren dy/dx=g'(1)/f'(1) ce, don haka ana buƙatar sanin saurin canjin x da y biyun, f'(1) da g'(1).
l-m-h3-b0d08-16.s.s2.model.1: Matsayin f(1) da g(1) ba sa shiga lissafin gangare, saboda haka mai ƙidaya g'(1) da ƙasan rabon f'(1) ake buƙata.

l-m-h3-b0d08-29.goal: Yanke shawarar ma'aunin (bayanin) da yake wajibi domin nemo tazarar da maki a kan layin lambobi ya motsa, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0d08-29.material: Gudun maki da ke motsawa a layin lambobi shi ne v(t). Muna son nemo tazarar da ya yi tafiya a zahiri daga lokaci 0 zuwa T.
l-m-h3-b0d08-29.s.s1.r.a: Alamomi na iya soke juna, saboda haka sakamakon na iya bambanta da ainihin tazarar.
l-m-h3-b0d08-29.s.s1.r.b: Ana buƙatar tazarar da aka yi tafiya, ba canjin matsayi ba.
l-m-h3-b0d08-29.s.s1.o.c: Lokutan da v(t)=0 da alamar kafin da bayan su
l-m-h3-b0d08-29.s.s1.r.d: Ƙimar gaggawa guda ɗaya ba ta da alaƙa kai tsaye da tazarar da aka yi tafiya.
l-m-h3-b0d08-29.s.s1.explain: Tazarar ita ce ∫|v|dt. Dole ne a raba zangon a lokutan da alamar v ke canzawa.
l-m-h3-b0d08-29.s.s2.model.0: Tazarar ita ce ∫|v|dt; saboda haka ana buƙatar sanin lokutan da v ya zama 0 kuma ya canza alama domin raba zangon.
l-m-h3-b0d08-29.s.s2.model.1: A zangon da v yake mara kyau, dole ne a juya alamar kafin a tara; saboda haka lokutan v=0 da alamomin kafin da bayan su suna da muhimmanci ƙwarai.

l-m-h3-b0d08-38.title: Wane bayani ake buƙata don ƙarar jikin juyawa?
l-m-h3-b0d08-38.goal: Yanke wane ma’auni (bayanin da ake buƙata) yake da muhimmanci ƙwarai don nemo ƙarar jikin da aka samu ta juya siffa kewaye da x-axis, kuma bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0d08-38.material: Yankin da lanƙwan y=f(x) (f≥0), x=a, x=b da x-axis suka kewaye ana juya shi kewaye da x-axis. Ana son nemo ƙarar jikin juyawa.
l-m-h3-b0d08-38.s.s1.r.a: Ƙimar faɗi guda ba ta nuna yadda girman sassan da’ira ke canzawa ba.
l-m-h3-b0d08-38.s.s1.o.b: Tazarar [a,b] da f(x) a kowane x
l-m-h3-b0d08-38.s.s1.r.c: Ana nemo ƙara ta tara faɗin sassan da’ira, ba ta amfani da tsawo ba.
l-m-h3-b0d08-38.s.s1.r.d: Sanin yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa kaɗai ba ya nuna radius ɗin faifan.
l-m-h3-b0d08-38.s.s1.explain: Sashen yanke a x da’ira ce mai radius f(x). Don amfani da V=π∫ₐᵇ{f(x)}²dx ana buƙatar tazara da f(x).
l-m-h3-b0d08-38.s.s2.model.0: A kowane x, sashen yanke da’ira ce mai radius f(x), saboda haka ana buƙatar tazarar [a,b] da ƙimomin f(x) don tara ƙarar.
l-m-h3-b0d08-38.s.s2.model.1: Ƙarar ita ce tarin faɗin sashen π{f(x)}² daga a zuwa b, saboda haka tazara da f(x) ake buƙata.

l-m-h3-b0d09-02.title: Wane ma’auni ne ke bambance ellipse da hyperbola?
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.prompt: Wane ma’auni ne ke bambance ellipse da hyperbola?
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.goal: Yanke wane ma’auni (bayanin) ake buƙata ƙwarai don gano abin da ke bambance ellipse da hyperbola, kuma bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.material: Akwai tsayayyun maki biyu F da F′ da batu mai motsi P. Idan aka sa sharadi ga nisan PF da PF′, ana zana ellipse ko hyperbola. Nemo sharadin bambance su.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.o.a: Ko PF ya fi ko ya gaza PF′
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.r.a: Wanne ya fi tsawo ba ya yanke nau’in lanƙwan.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.o.b: Ko nisan F da F′ cikakken lamba ne
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.r.b: Cikakken lamba ba ta da alaƙa da nau’in lanƙwan.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.o.c: Ko batu P yana sama da x-axis
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.r.c: Wurin batu ba shi da alaƙа da nau’in lanƙwan.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.o.d: Ko jimillar PF da PF′ ne ko cikakken bambancin su
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.explain: Ellipse tarin maki ne inda PF+PF′ yake dawwama, hyperbola kuma inda |PF−PF′| yake dawwama. Ko jimilla ko bambanci ne ke bambance su.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s2.model.0: Idan jimillar ta dawwama ellipse ce; idan cikakken bambancin ya dawwama hyperbola ce, don haka wannan lissafi ne ma’aunin.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s2.model.1: Sauran zaɓuɓɓuka ba sa canza nau’in lanƙwan. Ma’anoni sun bambanta bisa jimilla ko bambanci, wannan ne ma’aunin.

l-m-h3-b0d09-17.title: Me ke nuna mana ko kusurwar ƙanana ce?
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.topic: Dot product da kusurwar da ke tsakanin vectors
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.goal: Gano wane ma'auni (bayanin da ake bukata) ya zama dole domin gano irin kusurwar da vector biyu suka yi, sannan bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.material: Kana son sanin ko kusurwar da ke tsakanin vector biyu marasa sifili ƙanana ce ko babba. Gano wace ƙima ce ke nuna maka hakan.
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙima ce ke nuna ko kusurwar ƙanana ce ko babba?
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s1.r.a: Girma koyaushe yana da kyau (positive), don haka ba zai nuna irin kusurwar ba.
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s1.o.b: Jimillar ɓangarorin x na vector biyun
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s1.r.b: Jimillar ɓangarori ba ta da alaƙa kai tsaye da kusurwar da ke tsakanin vector ɗin.
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s1.r.c: Haɗin girman ma koyaushe yana da kyau, don haka ba zai nuna irin kusurwar ba.
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s1.explain: A cikin a·b=|a||b|cosθ, girman yana da kyau, saboda haka alamar cosθ ce ke yanke alamar. Idan ta zama mai kyau, kusurwar ƙanana ce; idan ta zama mara kyau, kusurwar babba ce.
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s2.model.0: Girman |a||b| koyaushe yana da kyau, saboda haka alamar dot product iri ɗaya ce da ta cosθ: mai kyau ga ƙaramar kusurwa, kuma mara kyau ga babbar kusurwa.
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s2.model.1: Sauran ƙimomin girma ne ko jimillar ɓangarori, saboda haka ba sa ɗauke da bayani game da alkiblar kusurwar. Shi ya sa alamar dot product ita ce ma'aunin da ake bukata.

l-m-h3-b0d09-31.s.s1.explain: Layuka biyu masu layi ɗaya suna kan jirgi guda, amma layuka biyu masu karkace ba za su iya kasancewa a kan jirgi guda ba.

l-m-h3-b0c42-13.topic: Ƙimomi biyu da ke canzawa tare
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.goal: Daga misalai da dama na wani sanadi gama-gari a bayan ƙimomi biyu da ke canzawa tare, nemo ka bayyana ƙa’ida, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.material: Misalan da ke ƙaruwa da raguwa tare: ① ƙamus da tsawo (shekaru) ② sayar da na’urar sanyaya iska da abin sha (zafi) ③ maki karatu da girman takalmi (aji). Yi amfani da wannan ƙa’ida ga “sayar da laima da yawan waɗanda suka makara”.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.prompt: Idan sayar da laima da yawan waɗanda suka makara sun ƙaru tare, wane bayani ya dace?
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.o.a: An sayar da laima da yawa, saboda haka ɗalibai suka makara
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.r.a: An ɗauka cewa ɗaya ne sanadin ɗayan.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.o.b: Ɗalibai sun makara, saboda haka an sayar da laima da yawa
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.r.b: An juya sanadi da sakamako ta hanyar da ba daidai ba.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.o.c: Launin laima ne ke yanke ko za ka makara
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.r.c: An ƙirƙiri sabuwar alaƙa ba tare da tushe ba.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.o.d: Ranakun ruwa na iya ƙara su duka
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.explain: Kamar misalan da suka gabata, bayan ƙimomi biyu da ke canzawa tare akwai yiwuwar abu na 3 da ke tasiri a kansu duka. A nan, ruwan sama ya dace.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s2.model.0: A ① zuwa ③, abu na 3 kamar shekaru, yanayin zafi, ko aji ya motsa ƙimomin tare; haka ma ga laima da jinkiri, ruwan sama na iya zama sanadi gama-gari.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s2.model.1: Kafin a ɗauka cewa ɗaya ne ke haddasa ɗayan, dole a nemo abin da ke tasiri a kansu duka; saboda haka ranakun ruwa ne suka fi dacewa.

l-m-h3-b0c45-13.s.s1.r.c: Yana samar da kusurwar dama, amma sauran lambobin biyu ba jere ba ne.

l-m-h3-b0c45-13.s.s1.explain: Ƙa’ida: idan ƙaramin lamba n ne, sauran su ne (n²−1)/2 da (n²+1)/2. Ga 9, su ne 40 da 41, kuma 81+1600=1681=41².

l-m-h3-b0d08-20.goal: Nemo ka bayyana tsari daga misalai da dama na x inda fₙ(x)=x·e^(−nx) ya fi girma, sannan ka gwada tsarin da sabon misali.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.material: Ga n=1, 2, 3, ƙimar fₙ(x)=x·e^(−nx) tana da matsakaicinta a x=1, 1/2, 1/3 bi da bi. Yi amfani da tsarin wajen hasashen x inda matsakaicin yake idan n=5.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.prompt: Idan n=5, a wane x ne ƙimar ta fi girma?
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.r.a: Ga n=1 ƙimar 1 ce, saboda haka ƙasishen n ne, ba n−1 ba (da n−1, ga n=1 ba zai yi aiki ba).
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.r.d: An juya alkiblar da x ke raguwa yayin da n ke ƙaruwa.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.explain: Daga fₙ'(x)=(1−nx)e^(−nx)=0, ana samun x=1/n; alamar tana sauyawa daga + zuwa − a gefensa, saboda haka matsakaici ne.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s2.model.0: 1, 1/2, 1/3 duk suna da sigar 1/n; don haka ga n=5, x=1/5. Idan aka samo asali ana samun (1−5x)e^(−5x)=0, wanda ma x=1/5 ne; saboda haka daidai ne.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s2.model.1: Alamar fₙ'(x)=(1−nx)e^(−nx) tana sauyawa daga + zuwa − a x=1/n; saboda haka idan n=5, x inda yake da girma mafi yawa shi ne 1/5.

l-m-h3-b0d09-10.goal: Nemo kuma ka bayyana tsari a wasu misalan gangaren asymptote na hyperbola, sannan ka gwada tsarin da sabon yanayi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.material: Mun nemo asymptote na hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1. Idan (a, b) = (2, 3), y = ±3x/2; idan (4, 1), y = ±x/4; idan kuma (1, 5), y = ±5x.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙa’ida ce ke haɗa gangaren asymptote da a, b?
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.r.a: A (2, 3), a/b=2/3 amma ainihin gangaren 3/2 ne.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.r.b: A (2, 3), b−a=1 amma ainihin gangaren 3/2 ne.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.r.c: A (2, 3), ab=6 amma ainihin gangaren 3/2 ne.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.explain: A cikin dukkan yanayi ukun, gangaren ±b/a ne. Asymptote ɗin daidai suke da y=±(b/a)x, wanda aka samu daga x²/a²−y²/b²=0.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s2.model.0: (2,3) yana ba da 3/2, (4,1) yana ba da 1/4, (1,5) kuma yana ba da 5, duka sun yi daidai da b/a; saboda haka ƙa’idar ita ce gangaren ±b/a.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s2.model.1: Saita x²/a²−y²/b²=0 yana ba da y²=(b²/a²)x², saboda haka gangaren misalan ya zama b/a.

l-m-h3-b0c45-15.material: Wata tablet ta Babila ta rubuta √2 da tushe 60 a matsayin 1;24,51,10. Wannan yana nufin 1 + 24/60 + 51/3600 + 10/216000.
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s1.prompt: Wane ne ƙimar decimal mafi dacewa?
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s1.r.a: Ka karanta lambobin ta hanyar haɗa su. Dole a raba da 60.
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s1.r.b: Ka ɗauki 24/60 a matsayin 0.6. Ainihin 0.4 ne.
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s1.r.d: Ka karanta 24 a matsayin wuraren decimal. 24/60=0.4 ne.
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s1.explain: 24/60=0.4 ne, 51/3600≈0.014; saboda haka 1+0.4+0.014 kusan 1.414 ne, kusan daidai da √2.
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s2.model.0: 24/60=0.4, 51/3600 kusan 0.014; don haka kusan 1.414 ne, daidai da √2≈1.414.
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s2.model.1: A tushe 60, kowace matsayi tana raguwa ta rabawa da 60; kada a karanta shi kamar 1.24, a ƙiyasta shi da 1+0.4+0.014.

l-m-h3-b0c45-16.title: Wane ƙiyasin kewayon duniya ne mai kyau daga bambancin kusurwar inuwa?
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.goal: Ƙiyasta kewayen duniya domin zaɓar girma ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.material: A wani gari hasken rana yana sauka kai tsaye da tsakar rana, kusurwar da ke tsakanin radius biyu da aka zana daga tsakiyar Duniya zuwa wannan gari da wani gari mai nisan km 800 ita ce 7.2°. An samo kusurwar daga kusurwar inuwa.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s1.prompt: Wane ƙiyasin kewayen Duniya ne ya fi dacewa?
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s1.r.a: Ka ƙirga matsayin lambobi ba daidai ba. 360÷7.2=50.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s1.r.b: Wannan 7.2×800 ne. Dole a yi amfani da 360° na cikakken zagaye domin nemo rabo.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi amfani da 180° a matsayin tushe. Cikakken zagayen duniya 360° ne.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s1.explain: 360° ninki 50 na 7.2° ne; saboda haka kewayen duniya ninki 50 na km 800 ne, kusan km 40,000.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s2.model.0: Cikakken zagaye 360° ninki 50 na 7.2° ne; don haka kewayen ma kusan km 40,000 ne, wato ninki 50 na km 800.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s2.model.1: Idan 7.2° ya yi daidai da km 800, to 1° kusan km 111 ne; ninka da 360 yana ba da kusan km 40,000, saboda haka ya dace.

l-m-h3-b0c45-17.title: Alluna nawa ake buƙata don shimfiɗa benen katako?
l-m-h3-b0c45-17.goal: Ƙiyasta yawan allunan da za a shimfiɗa a benen katako domin zaɓar girma ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c45-17.material: A ɗaki mai faɗin m 3.6 da tsawon m 2.4 za a shimfiɗa allunan faɗin cm 12 da tsawon m 2.4 gefe da gefe. A ɗauka babu gibi ko ragowar da za a yanke; ƙiyasta adadin allunan.
l-m-h3-b0c45-17.s.s1.prompt: Wane adadin alluna ne ya fi dacewa?
l-m-h3-b0c45-17.s.s1.r.b: Kamar an ɗauki faɗin allo cm 10.
l-m-h3-b0c45-17.s.s1.r.c: Ka raba yankin da faɗin kawai. Ka yi la’akari da tsawon allon ma.
l-m-h3-b0c45-17.s.s1.r.d: Kamar an ɗauki faɗin a matsayin cm 1.2. Duba raka’o’i.
l-m-h3-b0c45-17.s.s1.explain: Ana shimfiɗa allunan bisa hanyar m 2.4; m 3.6÷faɗin m 0.12=alluna 30. Yankin 8.64÷(0.12×2.4) ma 30 ne.
l-m-h3-b0c45-17.s.s2.model.0: Tsawon allon ya yi daidai da tsawon ɗaki; saboda haka m 3.6 da aka raba da faɗin m 0.12 yana ba da alluna 30.
l-m-h3-b0c45-17.s.s2.model.1: Raba yankin ɗaki m² 8.64 da yankin allo guda m² 0.288 a samu alluna 30. Dole raka’o’in su zama ɗaya, mita.

l-m-h3-b0c46-14.title: Yaya za mu ƙiyasta mitar Sol?
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.goal: Ƙiyasta mitar sautin Sol, wanda yake semitone 7 sama da Do, domin zaɓar girma ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.material: A daidaitaccen tsarin sautuka 12, hawa semitone 12 yana ninka mita sau 2, kowane semitone kuma yana ninka da abu iri ɗaya. Sauti semitone 7 sama da Do (262Hz) shi ne Sol.
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s1.prompt: Wane ƙiyasin mitar Sol ne ya fi dacewa?
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s1.r.a: Ka ƙara 1Hz ga kowane semitone. Dole mita ta ƙaru ta ninkawa.
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s1.r.b: Wannan mitar Do mai kaifi ce, semitone 12 sama (ninki 2).
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s1.r.d: Wannan 262×7 ne. Mita ba ta ninku sau 7 ga kowane semitone.
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s1.explain: Semitone 6 kusan ninki 1.41 ne, 12 kuma ninki 2; saboda haka semitone 7 kusan ninki 1.5 ne. 262×1.5≈393Hz.
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s2.model.0: Semitone 12 ninki 2 ne; saboda haka semitone 7 yana nufin 2^(7/12), kusan ninki 1.5; 262×1.5≈393Hz.
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s2.model.1: Semitone 6 ninki √2 ne, 12 kuma ninki 2; saboda haka semitone 7 kusa da ninki 1.5 ne, 393Hz kuma ya dace.

l-m-h3-b0c46-15.title: Me zai faru idan ka ninka hatsin kowanne murabba’i a allo mai murabba’ai 64?
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.goal: Ƙiyasta girman 2⁶⁴ domin zaɓar girma ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.material: Akwai labari da ake saka hatsi 1 a murabba’i na farko na allo mai murabba’ai 64, sannan a ninka adadin a kowane murabba’i na gaba. Jimillar kusan hatsi 2⁶⁴ ce. 2¹⁰ kusan 1,000 ne.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s1.prompt: Wane ƙiyasin girman 2⁶⁴ ne ya fi dacewa?
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s1.r.a: Wannan 64×2 ne. Dole a ninka 2 da kansa sau 64.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s1.r.b: Wannan kusan 2²⁰ ne. Dole a ninka da 2 sau da yawa fiye da haka.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s1.r.d: Wannan yana kusa da 2¹²⁸. An ɗauki ma'aunin ƙarfin sau biyu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s1.explain: 2⁶⁴=2⁴×(2¹⁰)⁶≈16×10¹⁸, don haka kusan 10¹⁹ ne. Ainihin ƙimar kusan 1.8×10¹⁹ ce.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s2.model.0: 2¹⁰≈10³, don haka 2⁶⁰≈10¹⁸; idan aka ninka da 2⁴=16, ana samun kusan 1.6×10¹⁹, wato kusan 10¹⁹.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s2.model.1: Idan aka ninka 2 da kanta sau 10, tana zama kusan sau 1,000. Saboda haka sau 64 yana kusan 10¹⁸, wato ninka 1,000 sau 6, sannan da 16, yana bada kusan 10¹⁹.

l-m-h3-b0c46-16.title: Lita nawa ne ruwan sama mai kaurin 20mm a kan fili gaba ɗaya?
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.topic: Ma'aunin ruwan sama da yawan ruwan sama
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.goal: Ka kiyasta yawan ruwan da ma'aunin ruwan sama ya auna domin zaɓar girma ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.material: Ma'aunin ruwan sama daga zamanin Joseon yana auna zurfin ruwan da ya sauka. A wani wuri ruwan sama ya kai 20mm. Ruwan zurfin 1mm a kan 1m² yana da 1L. Irin wannan ruwan ya sauka a kan fili mai faɗin 1,000m².
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙima ce ta fi dacewa wajen kiyasta yawan ruwan da ya sauka a filin?
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s1.r.b: An ninka raka'o'in ba daidai ba, don haka ƙimar ta yi girma sau 100.
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s1.r.c: An lissafa yawan ruwan da ya sauka a kan 1m² kawai. Dole ne a ninka da faɗin filin.
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s1.r.d: An ɗauki faɗin filin a matsayin 100m².
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s1.explain: Akwai 20L ga kowane 1m², filin kuma 1,000m² ne; saboda haka 20×1,000=20,000L (tan 20).
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s2.model.0: 1mm na ruwa daidai yake da 1L ga 1m²; saboda haka 20mm yana da 20L ga 1m², kuma ga 1,000m² jimillar 20,000L ce.
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s2.model.1: Akwai 20L ga kowane 1m² a cikin wurare 1,000, wato 20,000L; saboda haka 200L ƙanƙanta ne sosai.

l-m-h3-b0c46-17.title: Ta yaya za mu kiyasta nauyin babban dutsen saman dolmen?
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.goal: Ka kiyasta nauyin babban dutsen dolmen domin zaɓar girma ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.material: Idan aka ɗauki babban dutsen a matsayin akwati mai kusurwa huɗu, tsawonsa 5m ne, faɗinsa 3m, kaurinsa kuma 1m ne. Dutse ya fi ruwa nauyi kusan sau 2.7 idan ƙarar ta yi daidai. 1m³ na ruwa yana da tan 1.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙima ce ta fi dacewa wajen kiyasta nauyin babban dutsen?
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s1.r.a: Sau 2.7 na tan 15 kusan tan 40 ne, don haka tan 400 ya yi nauyi sosai.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s1.r.c: Sau 2.7 na tan 15 kusan tan 40 ne, don haka tan 4,000 ya yi nauyi sosai.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s1.r.d: Ko da ƙarar 15m³ ruwa ce, nauyinta tan 15 ne; saboda haka tan 4 ya yi sauƙi sosai.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s1.explain: Ƙarar ita ce 5×3×1=15m³; idan ruwa ne nauyinsa tan 15 ne, dutse kuma ya fi sau 2.7, don haka nauyin ya kai kusan tan 40.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s2.model.0: Ƙarar 15m³ ce, kuma idan ruwa ne nauyinsa tan 15 ne; kimar tan 40 da aka samu ta hanyar ninkawa da 2.7 ta dace.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s2.model.1: Ya fi tan 15 nauyi, kuma ya fi tan 45 sauƙi (sau 3 na tan 15), don haka kimar tan 40 ta dace.

l-m-h3-b0c47-14.material: Wani masani na Girka ta dā ya ƙiyasta kewayen Duniya daga bambancin kusurwar inuwar rana da tsakar rana, 7.2°, a birane biyu. Birane biyun suna kan layin arewa-kudu guda, kusan km 800 tsakaninsu.
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s1.prompt: Kusan km nawa ne kewayen Duniya?
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s1.r.a: Ka ninka 800×7.2. 7.2° wani sashe ne na 360° kawai.
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s1.r.b: Ka rasa sifili guda. Fara da ƙiyasta 360÷7.2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s1.r.d: Ka ninka 800×360. Dole a ninka da 360÷7.2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s1.explain: 7.2° ita ce 1/50 na 360°; saboda haka kewayen kusan ninki 50 na km 800 ne, wato 4×10⁴ km (km 40,000).
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s2.model.0: 7.2° ita ce 1/50 na 360°; don haka kewayen Duniya kusan 4×10⁴ km (km 40,000) ne, ninki 50 na km 800.
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s2.model.1: Cikakken zagaye 360° ninki 50 na 7.2° ne; saboda haka 800×50=40000, kewayen kuma kusan 4×10⁴ km ne.

l-m-h3-b0c47-16.s.s2.model.1: Ba tare da rabawa da 3 ba, 750×10⁴ ne; idan an raba, 250×10⁴. Saboda haka girman dala kusa da 250×10⁴ m³ ne.

l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s1.explain: Tsawon yana raguwa daga 1 zuwa 0.02. Kiyastawa da trapezoid masu faɗin 0.5 tana bada kusan 0.88.

l-m-h3-b0d09-20.material: Ƙarfi mai girma 3 da wani mai girma 5 suna aiki kan abu ɗaya. Ba a san kusurwar da ke tsakaninsu ba. Yi kimanta domin gano wace ƙima ba za ta iya zama girman ƙarfin sakamakon ba.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙima ba za ta iya zama girman ƙarfin sakamakon ba?
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.r.b: Da kusurwa da ta dace, 6, wanda ke tsakanin 2 da 8, zai iya faruwa.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.r.c: Idan alkiblarsu ta saɓa wa juna, 5−3=2 ne.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.explain: Girman ƙarfin sakamakon yana aƙalla |5−3|=2, kuma bai wuce 3+5=8 ba. 1 yana wajen wannan iyaka, saboda haka ba zai faru ba.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s2.model.0: Ƙarfin sakamakon ya fi ƙanƙanta, 2, idan ƙarfin ya nuna saɓanin alkibla; ya fi girma, 8, idan alkiblarsu ɗaya ce. Saboda haka 1 ba zai yiwu ba.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s2.model.1: Idan ka gina alwatika da ƙarfin biyun, sauran gefen ba zai gajarta da 5−3=2 ba, saboda haka ƙarfin sakamakon ba zai zama 1 ba.

l-m-h3-b0d09-34.material: Kiyasta tazara tsakanin A(1, 1, 1) da B(4, 5, 3). Bambance-bambancen coordinates a jere x, y, z su ne 3, 4, da 2.
l-m-h3-b0d09-34.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙiyasin AB ce ta fi dacewa?
l-m-h3-b0d09-34.s.s1.r.a: Ba zai gaza mafi girman bambancin coordinate ba, wato 4.
l-m-h3-b0d09-34.s.s1.r.c: Wannan ita ce jimillar dukkan bambance-bambancen coordinates, saboda haka ta fi tazarar tsawo.

l-m-h3-b0d09-34.s.s1.explain: AB²=9+16+4=29 ne, kuma tun da 25<29<36, 5<AB<6, saboda haka kusan 5.4 ne.
l-m-h3-b0d09-34.s.s2.model.0: AB²=29 ne, wanda yake tsakanin 5²=25 da 6²=36, don haka AB yana tsakanin 5 da 6, kusan 5.4.
l-m-h3-b0d09-34.s.s2.model.1: Tazarar ta fi babban bambancin 4 girma, kuma ta gaza jimillar bambance-bambancen 9. Saboda haka ba 3 ba ce ko 9 ba; kusan 5.4 ce, wato tushen jimillar murabba’u 29.

l-m-h3-b0d09-35.title: Kimanin girman inuwar siffar da aka karkatar fa?
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.goal: Kiyasta fadin tsinkayar kai-tsaye na siffa a kan jirgi, zaɓi girma ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.material: Siffa mai faɗi tana da yanki 20, kuma tana yin kusurwa 30° da ƙasa. Haske yana haskawa kai tsaye ƙasa, kuma kana ƙiyasta yankin inuwar (tsinkayar kai-tsaye). cos30°≈0.87.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙiyasin yankin inuwa ce ta dace?
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.r.a: Wannan shi ne ƙimar kusurwar 60°. A kusurwar 30° ta fi girma.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.r.c: Yankin inuwar ba zai iya fin yankin siffar asali ba.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.r.d: Yankin zai zama 20 ne kawai idan siffar tana layi ɗaya da ƙasa (0°). Idan ta karkata, yankin yana raguwa.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.explain: Yankin tsinkayar kai-tsaye = yankin asali × cosθ. 20×0.87≈17, wanda ya yi ƙasa da 20.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s2.model.0: Tunda yankin tsinkayar kai-tsaye = yanki × cosθ, 20×0.87≈17. Yayin da siffar ta ƙara karkata, inuwar tana ƙara raguwa, don haka yankinta bai kai 20 ba.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s2.model.1: 30° ya fi 0° karkata kaɗan, saboda haka inuwar tana raguwa kaɗan kawai. Shi ya sa kusan 17, wato ƙasa da 20 kaɗan, ya dace.

l-m-h3-b0d10-07.title: Game da nawa ne hyperbola a x=3?
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.goal: Ƙididdiga y-coordinate na batu akan hyperbola don yanke shawarar girman da ya dace ko kewayo, da bayyana dalilinku.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.material: Ƙididdiga y-coordinate (tabbatacce) na batu tare da x = 3 akan reshen dama na hyperbola x² - y²/16 = 1. Yi amfani da lambobi murabba'i, ba tare da kalkuleta ba.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.prompt: Wanne ya dace da kimantawa ga y?
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.r.a: Idan y = 16, to y² = 256, wanda yayi girma da yawa idan aka kwatanta da 128.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.r.b: y² shine 128. Ba a ɗauki tushen murabba'in ba.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.r.c: Daga y²/16=8, y²=128, kuma y ba 8 bane.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.explain: A x=3, y²/16=9-1=8, haka y²=128. Tun da 11²=121<128<144=12²,y yana tsakanin 11 da 12.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s2.model.0: y²=128 yana tsakanin 11²=121 da 12²=144, don haka y ya dan fi 11, kusan 11.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s2.model.1: Asymptote y = 4x shine 12 a x = 3, kuma lanƙwan yana ɗan ƙasa da shi, don haka yana kusan 11, kusa da 12.

l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s1.r.c: Idan kusurwa ƙasa da 30° ce, cos ya fi 0.87.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s1.r.d: Idan kusurwa ta fi 60°, cos ƙasa da 0.5 ne.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s1.explain: cosθ yana raguwa yayin θ ke ƙaruwa. cos30°≈0.87>0.8>cos45°≈0.71, don haka θ tsakanin 30° da 45°.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s2.model.0: 0.8 ƙasa da cos30°≈0.87 amma sama da cos45°≈0.71, saboda haka kusurwar tsakanin 30° da 45°.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s2.model.1: Idan dot product 0.8 ne, cosθ=0.8; kusurwa mafi girma na nufin cos ƙarami, don haka tana tsakanin 30° da 45°.

l-m-h3-b0c35-05.topic: Kuɗin kaya, farashin da aka liƙa, rangwame
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.goal: Bi matakan warwarewa, ko jerin dalili da sakamako, don gano riba daga kuɗin kaya, farashin da aka liƙa da farashin rangwame; nemo inda kuskure ya fara sannan ka gyara shi.
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.material: An sa farashin da aka liƙa ta ƙara ribar 25% a kan kuɗin kaya na won 20,000, sannan aka sayar da kayan da rangwamen 20% daga wannan farashin. Warwarewa: 1) farashin da aka liƙa=20,000×1.25=25,000 2) rangwame=20,000×0.2=4,000 3) farashin sayarwa=25,000−4,000=21,000 4) riba=21,000−20,000=won 1,000
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.s.s1.o.a: Mataki na 1: farashin da aka liƙa won 25,000
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.s.s1.r.c: An yi lissafin 25,000−4,000 daidai ta amfani da darajar matakin da ya gabata.
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.s.s1.explain: Ana lissafin rangwame bisa farashin da aka liƙa, saboda haka 25,000×0.2=won 5,000 ne. Farashin sayarwa won 20,000 ne, riba kuma won 0.
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.s.s2.model.0: Ya kamata a ninka kaso na rangwame da farashin da aka liƙa, amma an ninka shi da kuɗin kaya, saboda haka mataki na 2 ne kuskure. Idan 25,000×0.2=5,000, farashin sayarwa won 20,000 ne.
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.s.s2.model.1: An zaɓi tushe ba daidai ba a mataki na 2. 20% na farashin da aka liƙa, won 25,000, shi ne won 5,000; saboda haka farashin sayarwa won 20,000 ne, ribar kuma won 0.

l-m-h3-b0c36-17.goal: Bi warwarewar samfurin matrices biyu, ko jerin daga dalili zuwa sakamako, mataki-mataki; nemo farkon inda ya yi kuskure sannan ka gyara.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.material: Ga A=(1 2; 3 4) da B=(0 1; 1 0), wani ɗalibi ya lissafa AB ta hanyar abubuwa-zuwa-abubuwa. Nemo farkon layin da ba daidai ba.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.prompt: Wane ne farkon layin da aka lissafa ba daidai ba?
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.r.a: An ninka jere ta 1 na A da ginshiƙi na 1 na B daidai. Ba kuskure ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.r.b: An ninka jere ta 1 na A da ginshiƙi na 2 na B daidai. Ba kuskure ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.r.d: Wannan layin ma kuskure ne, amma akwai layin da ya fara yin kuskure tun da wuri.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.explain: (jere 2, ginshiƙi 1) ya kamata a ninka jere ta 2 na A da ginshiƙi na 1 na B, (0, 1), a samu 3×0+4×1=4. An musanya ginshiƙai yayin ninkawa.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s2.model.0: Jere ta 2, ginshiƙi na 1 yana ninkawa da ginshiƙi na 1 na B, (0,1); saboda haka 3×0+4×1=4 ne, amma an yi amfani da ginshiƙi na 2. Wannan shi ne farkon kuskure, a gyara zuwa 4.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s2.model.1: Layi biyun farko daidai ne, ginshiƙai sun musanya a layi na uku; saboda haka ya kamata ya zama 4, ba 3 ba.

l-m-h3-b0c36-19.title: Duba mataki guda na saukowar gangara
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.goal: Bi lissafin mataki guda na saukowar gangara, ko jerin daga dalili zuwa sakamako, mataki-mataki; nemo farkon kuskuren sannan ka gyara.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.material: Yi amfani da saukowar gangara domin nemo mafi ƙarancin f(x)=x²−6x. Nemo farkon layin kuskure a warwarewar da ke ɗaukar mataki ɗaya daga x=0 na farawa da ƙimar koyon 0.25.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.r.a: An samo derivative daidai. Ba kuskure ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.o.b: ② Gangara a matsayin farawa f'(0)=−6
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.r.b: An maye gurbin darajar daidai. Ba kuskure ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.o.d: ④ x ya ƙara nisa daga wurin ƙarami 3
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.r.d: Wannan sakamakon kuskuren ③ ne. Akwai kuskuren da ya gabata.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.explain: Sabon x = x − ƙimar koyon × gangara = 0 − 0.25×(−6) = 1.5. An ƙara gangarar, don haka ya matsa akasin alkibla.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s2.model.0: Saukowar gangara dole ta cire gangara, amma a ③ an ƙara ta, saboda haka x ya zama −1.5. A gyara zuwa 0−0.25×(−6)=1.5.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s2.model.1: Idan gangara −6 ce, dole a matsa dama, saboda haka x dole ya ƙaru. A gyara ③ zuwa 1.5.

l-m-h3-b0c36-20.material: Sakamakon gwaje-gwaje 200: an gano marasa lafiya 40 daidai a matsayin masu tabbataccen sakamako, an rasa marasa lafiya 10, an yi kuskuren kiran masu lafiya 20 da sakamako tabbatacce, kuma an gano masu lafiya 130 daidai. Nemo layin farko da bai dace ba a warwarewar ɗalibi.

l-m-h3-b0c37-17.material: Wannan maganin ɗalibi ne na nemo cosθ=(a·b)/(|a||b|) ga a=(3,4), b=(4,−3). Nemo layin farko da ya kuskure.

l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s1.explain: |b|=√(4²+(−3)²)=√25=5. Murabba’i yana zama positive ko wane alama, saboda haka a tara.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s2.model.0: Tun da (−3)²=9, |b|=√(16+9)=5. Amma a ③ an cire 9 aka samu √7; ③ shi ne kuskuren farko.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s2.model.1: Murabba’in abubuwan haɗin yana zama positive; a tara, ba a cire ba. Gyara ③ zuwa 5.

l-m-h3-b0c44-22.s.s1.o.d: ④ An ce yana ƙaruwa 160% ga awa 2
l-m-h3-b0c44-22.s.s1.explain: Coefficient correlation yana nuna ƙarfin alaƙar layi ne kawai, ba ƙimar canji ba.

l-m-h3-b0c47-20.goal: Bi warwarewar nemo rabon zinariya, inda dogon gefe ya ninka sau 1.618, ko jerin dalili da sakamako, mataki-mataki; nemo farkon kuskure sannan ka gyara.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.material: Idan rectangle mai dogon gefe x da gajeren gefe 1 yana da rabon zinariya, x:1=(x+1):x. ① x²=x+1 ② x²−x−1=0 ③ x=(1±√5)/2 ④ Tunda tsawo tabbatacce ne, x=(1−√5)/2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.a: A daidaiton rabo, ninkokin ciki sun yi daidai da ninkokin waje; saboda haka daidai ne.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.b: Daidaiton x²=x+1 ne aka matsar da komai gefe guda, saboda haka daidai ne.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.c: Sanya a=1,b=−1,c=−1 a cikin dabari quadratic daidai ne.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.explain: (1−√5)/2 kusan −0.618 ne, lamba mara kyau. Tsawon shi ne mai kyau, (1+√5)/2≈1.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s2.model.0: √5≈2.236; saboda haka (1−√5)/2 kusan −0.618 ne, mara kyau kuma ba zai zama tsawo ba. A gyara zuwa (1+√5)/2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s2.model.1: Tsawo tabbatacce ne; saboda haka a zaɓi tushen mafi girma, (1+√5)/2≈1.618, amma ④ ta zaɓi ƙarami.

l-m-h3-b0c48-19.goal: Bi matakan warwarewar da ke nuna 2=1, ko jerin dalili da sakamako; nemo farkon kuskure sannan ka gyara.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.material: A ɗauka a=b, ninka ɓangarorin biyu da a a samu a²=ab. Cire b² daga ɓangarorin biyu a samu a²−b²=ab−b². Faɗaɗa abubuwan gama-gari: (a+b)(a−b)=b(a−b). Raba ɓangarorin biyu da (a−b) a samu a+b=b, wato 2b=b, don haka 2=1.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.a: Ninka ɓangarorin biyu da a a samu a²=ab
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.a: Ninka ɓangarorin biyu da lamba ɗaya daidai ne.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.b: Cire b² daga ɓangarorin biyu a samu a²−b²=ab−b²
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.b: Cire lamba ɗaya daga ɓangarorin biyu daidai ne.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.c: Raba ɓangarorin biyu da (a−b) a samu a+b=b
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.d: Sanya a=b cikin a+b=b a samu 2b=b
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.d: Lissafin sanya a=b daidai ne. Matsalar tana a layin baya.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.explain: Idan a=b, to a−b=0; saboda haka wannan ya raba da sifili. Ba a yarda a raba da 0 ba. (0)
