l-m-h3-b0c49-19.title: Wane mataki na warware x(x−2)=3x ne ya rasa mafita guda?
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.goal: Bi matakan warwarewar x(x−2)=3x, ko jerin dalili da sakamako, bisa tsari; nemo farkon kuskure sannan ka gyara.
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.material: Warwarewa: x(x−2)=3x. Raba ɓangarorin biyu da x a samu x−2=3. Saboda haka x=5. Amma idan aka saka x=0, ɓangarorin biyu ma sun zama 0.
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s1.prompt: Wane layi ne ya sa aka rasa mafita guda?
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s1.r.a: Daidaiton farawa daidai yake da sharadin matsalar.
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s1.o.b: Raba ɓangarorin biyu da x a samu x−2=3
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s1.r.d: Rubuta amsar yana bin sakamakon layin baya kawai.
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s1.explain: Idan ka raba da x a daidaito inda x zai iya zama 0, mafita x=0 tana ɓacewa. Matsar da sharudda a warware x(x−5)=0, amsoshi 0 ko 5.
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s2.model.0: x=0 ma mafita ce, amma rabawa da x ta watsar da yanayin x=0; saboda haka wannan layi ne kuskure.
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s2.model.1: Rabawa da wani abu da ka iya zama 0 tana sa mafita ta ɓace; matsar da sharudda a warware x(x−5)=0.

l-m-h3-b0c50-24.s.s1.explain: Idan x mara kyau ne, √(x²)=−x. Dabari da kullum daidai shi ne √(x²)=|x|, ga x=−3 kuma daraja 3 ce.
l-m-h3-b0c50-24.s.s2.model.0: Idan x mara kyau ne, √(x²) tabbatacce ne, ba daidai da x ba; saboda haka ba za a yi amfani da √(x²)=x ga kowane x ba.
l-m-h3-b0c50-24.s.s2.model.1: Dabarin daidai shi ne √(x²)=|x|, ga x=−3 daraja 3 ce; saɓanin ya samo asali ne daga gabaɗaɗawa ba daidai ba.

l-m-h3-b0d07-02.title: Iyakacin √(n²+3n)−n: Wane mataki ne ba daidai ba?
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.goal: Bi mafita ko jerin dalili da sakamako na nemo iyakar √(n²+3n)−n mataki-mataki, gano inda kuskure ya fara, sannan ka gyara.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.material: Mafitar lim(√(n²+3n)−n): (1) Cire tushen ta hanyar rarrabawa: 3n/(√(n²+3n)+n) (2) Raba da n: 3/(√(1+3/n)+1) (3) Tun da 3/n→3, 3/(√4+1)=1 (4) Iyakar ita ce 1
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.o.a: Mataki (1): inda aka cire tushen ta hanyar rarrabawa
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.r.a: Lambar sama ta zama (n²+3n)−n²=3n, saboda haka cire tushen ɗin daidai ne.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.o.b: Mataki (2): inda aka raba da n
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.r.b: Maganar da aka samu bayan raba lambar sama da ƙasa da n daidai ce.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.r.d: (4) kawai ya ɗauko ƙimar daga (3), saboda haka ba nan ne kuskuren farko yake ba.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.explain: Yayin da n→∞, 3/n→0. Saboda haka 3/(1+1)=3/2 ita ce iyakar daidai.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s2.model.0: Yayin da n yake ƙaruwa, 3/n yana kusantar 0, ba 3 ba, saboda haka mataki (3) ba daidai ba ne. Daidai shi ne 3/(1+1)=3/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s2.model.1: Ƙasan rabon 3/n yana ƙaruwa ba tare da iyaka ba, saboda haka 3/n yana zama 0 kuma √(1+0)=1. Don haka iyakar ita ce 3/2.

l-m-h3-b0d09-21.title: A ina ne aka yi kuskure wajen warware ƙimar cosine?
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.goal: Bi warwarewar neman cosine na kusurwar da ke tsakanin vector biyu, ko jerin dalili da sakamako, mataki-mataki. Nemo wuri na farko da kuskure ya faru ka gyara shi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.material: Wannan warwarewa ce ta kusurwa θ tsakanin a=(2, 1) da b=(1, −3). ① a·b=2−3=−1 ② |a|=√5, |b|=√10 ③ cosθ=−1/(√5+√10) ④ Saboda haka θ babbar kusurwa ce.
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.o.a: Haɗa girman a ƙasa maimakon ninkawa
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.o.d: Fadin kusurwa babba ce domin cosθ ba shi da kyau
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.r.d: Ƙarshen cewa kusurwa babba ce idan cosθ<0 daidai ne.
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.explain: Dole ne a ninka abin da ke ƙasa: |a||b|=√5·√10=5√2. Tun da cosθ=−1/(5√2)<0, ƙarshe iri ɗaya ne, amma furucin lissafin bai daidai ba.
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s2.model.0: Tun da cosθ=a·b/(|a||b|), abin da ke ƙasa shi ne ninkin girman, √50=5√2. Mataki na ③ da ya rubuta jimilla ne kuskure, kuma ƙimar da aka gyara ita ce −1/(5√2).
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s2.model.1: Dabarar tana raba a·b da ninkin |a| da |b|, saboda haka kada a haɗa su. Dole ne a gyara zuwa ninkawa domin ƙimar ta zama daidai.

l-m-h3-b0d09-36.material: Ƙafar tsaye daga maki P da yake wajen jirgi α zuwa α ita ce H, kuma ƙafar tsaye daga H zuwa layi l da yake cikin α ita ce Q. Wannan mafita ce ta gano tazara daga P zuwa l idan PH=3 da HQ=4. ① PQ⊥l ② ∠PHQ=90° ③ PQ=3+4=7 ④ Tazarar ita ce 7.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.r.a: PQ ⊥ l daidai ne bisa ka’idar layuka uku masu tsaye.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.r.b: PH yana tsaye da α, saboda haka wannan daidai ne.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.o.d: Ɗaukar tazara daga P zuwa l a matsayin PQ
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.r.d: Tun da PQ ⊥ l, daidai ne tazarar ta zama PQ.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.explain: A cikin kusurwar dama PHQ, PQ²=3²+4²=25, don haka PQ=5. Kada a tara tsawon bangarorin biyu.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s2.model.0: Kusurwar PHQ tana da kusurwar dama a H, saboda haka ka’idar Pythagoras tana bada PQ²=9+16=25, PQ=5. Mataki ③ da ya tara 3+4 ba daidai ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s2.model.1: A cikin alwatika mai kusurwar dama, hypotenuse ya fi gajarta da jimillar bangarorin, saboda haka 7 ba daidai ba ne; gyara zuwa 5.

l-m-h3-b0d10-08.title: Rubuta ma'auni na hyperbola daga foci da madaidaicin axis: a ina aka yi kuskure?
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.goal: Bi matakan mafita (ko sarkar dalili da sakamako) don nemo ma'auni na hyperbola daga foci da tsawon madaidaicin axis, nemo wurin farko da ya fara kuskure, sannan gyara shi.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.material: Wannan mafita ce ta nemo hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 mai foci (±5, 0), kuma mai transverse axis tsawonsa 6. ① Transverse axis 2a=6, a=3 ② Focus c=5 ③ b²=a²+c²=9+25=34 ④ x²/9 − y²/34 = 1
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.r.a: Tsawon madaidaicin axis shine 2a, don haka a=3 daidai ne.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.r.d: Matsakaicin adadin 9 a ƙarƙashin x² daidai ne.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.explain: Don hyperbola, c²=a²+b², don haka b²=c²−a²=25-9=16. Ma'auni shine x²/9-y²/16=1.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s2.model.0: A hyperbola yana da c²=a²+b², don haka b²=c²−a² dole ne ya zama 16. Rubuta shi da ƙari a ③ kuskure ne.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s2.model.1: Idan b² = 34, to c² = 9+34 = 43, kuma ma'anar ba zai zama (± 5,0). Don haka 34 ba daidai ba ne kuma 16 daidai ne.

l-m-h3-b0d10-09.goal: Bi matakan mafita (ko sarkar sanadi da sakamako) don nemo k domin layi ya yi kama da parabola, nemo wurin da ya fara kuskure, sannan a gyara shi.
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.material: Wannan shine mafita don nemo k ta yadda layin y = x + k ya kasance mai tangal zuwa parabola y² = 4x. ① (x+k)² = 4x ② x² + (2k−4) x + k² = 0 ③ Yana da tangent, haka D>0, wato, -16k+16>0 ④ Saboda haka k<1
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s1.o.a: Rubutun yanayin rashin ƙarfi kamar D>0
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s1.r.b: Sauya don nemo ma'anar tangency ita ce hanya madaidaiciya.
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s1.o.c: Shirya shi azaman ma'auni a x
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s1.r.c: Sake tsarawa bayan faɗaɗa (x+k)²=4x daidai ne.
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s1.explain: Lokacin tangent, akwai mahaɗa ɗaya, don haka D=0. Daga -16k+16=0, k=1.
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s2.model.0: Kasancewa tangent yana nufin akwai mahaɗa ɗaya, don haka ana buƙatar D=0. D>0 shine lokacin da layi ya haɗu da lanƙwasa a maki biyu. Gyara shi zuwa k=1.
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s2.model.1: Idan D> 0, layin ya hadu da lanƙwasa a wurare daban-daban guda biyu, don haka ba shi da tangent. Lokacin D=0, k=1.

l-m-h3-b0c33-24.title: Sake rubuta sharadin kuɗin shiga = kuɗi da aka kashe a matsayin furuci
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.goal: Sake bayyana sharadin da kuɗin shiga da kuɗin da aka kashe suka yi daidai ta wata hanya (furuci, tebur, hoto, kalmomi), ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anarsu ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.material: Farashin sayarwa kan kaya guda 5,000 won ne, kuɗin canji kan kaya guda 3,000 won, kuɗin tsayayye kuma 2,000,000 won ne. Ga yawan tallace-tallace q, nemo furucin da ma’anarsa ɗaya da “kuɗin shiga = kuɗin da aka kashe”.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s1.prompt: Wane furuci ne yake da ma’ana ɗaya da “kuɗin shiga = kuɗin da aka kashe”?
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s1.r.a: An ƙara kuɗin canji ga kuɗin shiga. Kuɗin canji yana gefen kuɗin da aka kashe.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s1.r.b: Ninka farashi da kuɗi da aka kashe ba shi da ma’ana.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s1.r.d: An juya alamar kuɗin tsayayye. Dole ne a ƙara shi ga kuɗin kashewa.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s1.explain: Kuɗin shiga 5,000q = kuɗin kashewa 2,000,000+3,000q; matsar da 3,000q zuwa wancan gefen yana bayar da (5,000−3,000)q=2,000,000.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s2.model.0: Daga 5,000q=2,000,000+3,000q, matsar da 3,000q zuwa gefen hagu yana bayar da (5,000−3,000)q=2,000,000.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s2.model.1: Yana nufin kuɗin won 2,000 da ya rage kowace kaya idan aka ninka da q daidai yake da kuɗin tsayayye, furuci iri ɗaya ne.

l-m-h3-b0c34-21.goal: Sake bayyana “cire haraji daga farashin da ya haɗa da VAT domin samun farashin kafin haraji” ta wata hanya (dabara, jadawali, hoto, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anar ɗaya ce.

l-m-h3-b0c34-23.material: Idan kuɗin shiga R(q)=100q won ne, kuɗin kashewa kuma C(q)=3,000+40q won ne, sauƙaƙa ribar P(q)=R(q)−C(q) zuwa dabara mai layi ɗaya a q.
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.s.s1.prompt: Wace dabara ce take nufin abu ɗaya da ribar P(q)?
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.s.s1.r.b: Dole ne a cire kuɗin dindindin 3,000 ma.
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.s.s1.r.c: Ka ƙara kuɗin kashewa 40q. Dole ne a cire kuɗin kashewa.
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.s.s1.explain: P=100q−(3,000+40q)=60q−3,000. Kana riƙe 60 won a kan kowane kaya, kuma da farko dole ne a biya kuɗin dindindin 3,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.s.s2.model.0: P=100q−(3,000+40q), saboda haka idan aka buɗe baka ana samun 60q−3,000.
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.s.s2.model.1: Ana cire dukkan kuɗin kashewa. Saboda haka 40q yana fita daga kuɗin shiga, ya rage 60q, sannan a cire kuɗin dindindin 3,000 ma.

l-m-h3-b0c34-24.title: Bayyana raguwar 20% ta hanyar koma baya
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.goal: Sake bayyana “raguwar idan aka kwatanta da watan da ya gabata, tare da ɗaukar watan da ya gabata a matsayin tushe” ta wata hanya (dabara, jadawali, hoto, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anar ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.material: Tallace-tallacen watan nan sun yi ƙasa da na watan da ya gabata da 20%. Bayyana abu ɗaya a matsayin “tallace-tallacen watan da ya gabata ninkin na watan nan ne sau nawa”.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.prompt: Wace magana ce take nufin abu ɗaya?
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.o.a: Tallace-tallacen watan nan sun ninka na watan da ya gabata sau 1.2.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.r.a: Watan nan ya ragu, saboda haka dole ne ya zama ƙasa da 1.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.o.b: Tallace-tallacen watan da ya gabata sun ninka na watan nan sau 1.25.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.o.c: Tallace-tallacen watan nan sun ninka na watan da ya gabata sau 0.2.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.o.d: Tallace-tallacen watan da ya gabata sun ninka na watan nan sau 1.2.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.r.d: Watan nan ya zama sau 0.8 na watan da ya gabata. Idan aka juya, ya zama sau 1.25.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.explain: Watan nan = watan da ya gabata × 0.8, saboda haka watan da ya gabata = watan nan ÷ 0.8 = watan nan × 1.25.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s2.model.0: Watan nan sau 0.8 ne na watan da ya gabata, saboda haka watan da ya gabata sau 1 ÷ 0.8 = 1.25 ne na watan nan.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s2.model.1: Ragewa da 20% yana nufin an bar 80%. Don komawa baya, a raba da 0.8, wanda ya ba da ninki 1.25.

l-m-h3-b0c35-06.title: Mayar da farashin da ya ragu da 20%
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.topic: Tushen kaso na ƙaruwa ko raguwa
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.goal: Sake bayyana “kason ƙaruwa da zai mayar da farashin da ya ragu da 20%” ta wata hanya (dabari, tebur, zane, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anar ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.material: Farashin kaya ya ragu da 20%. Farashin da aka rage ya zama sau 0.8 na asalin farashi. Ka yi tunanin ninkawa: da wane kaso ya kamata a ƙara farashin da aka rage domin a koma asalin farashi?
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.prompt: Menene kason ƙaruwa daga farashin da aka rage zuwa asalin farashi?
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.r.a: Ka ɗauka cewa raguwar 20% tana nufin ƙarin kaso iri ɗaya domin komawa. Tushen lissafin ya bambanta.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.r.c: Ka karanta darajar sau 0.8 a matsayin kason ƙaruwa.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.r.d: Ka gauraya mayar da shi sau 1.2 da ƙara masa 120%.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.explain: 0.8×(1+r)=1, saboda haka 1+r=1.25, wato r=25%. Tushen lissafi ya koma farashin da aka rage.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s2.model.0: Domin 0.8 ya zama 1 idan an ninka shi da wani adadi, dole ne a ninka shi sau 1.25; saboda haka a ƙara 25%.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s2.model.1: Raguwar kuɗi ɗaya ce, amma yanzu tushe ya yi ƙanƙanta, sau 0.8 na asali; saboda haka kason ƙaruwa ba 20% ba ne, 0.2÷0.8=25% ne.

l-m-h3-b0c35-14.title: Mayar da ma’anar wurin da ba a samun riba ko asara zuwa kalmomi
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.goal: Sake bayyana wurin da ba a samun riba ko asara ga kaya mai kuɗin dindindin 5,000 won ta wata hanya (dabara, jadawali, hoto, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anar ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.material: Kaya yana da kuɗin dindindin 5,000 won, farashin sayarwa 800 won kan kowane kaya, da kuɗin canzawa 300 won. Bayyana da kalmomi adadin kayan (wurin da ba a samun riba ko asara) wanda jimillar kuɗin shiga da jimillar kuɗin kashewa suke zama daidai.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ne yake nufin abu ɗaya da wurin da ba a samun riba ko asara?
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.o.a: Adadin kayan da, idan ana samun 800 won kan kowane ɗaya, ya biya 5,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.r.a: Ba ka cire kuɗin canzawa na 300 won ba.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.o.b: Adadin kayan da, idan an bar 500 won daga kowane ɗaya, ya biya kuɗin dindindin 5,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.o.c: Adadin kayan da, idan an bar 300 won daga kowane ɗaya, ya biya kuɗin dindindin 5,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.r.c: Ka ɗauki kuɗin canzawa a matsayin riba.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.o.d: Adadin kayan da kuɗin shiga ya kai 5,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.r.d: Ka duba kuɗin shiga kawai, ba ka kwatanta shi da jimillar kuɗin kashewa ba.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.explain: Kuɗin da ya rage daga kowane kaya shi ne 800−300=500 won. Bayan sayar da kaya 5,000÷500=10, kuɗin shiga da kuɗin kashewa za su yi daidai a 8,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s2.model.0: Kowane kaya da aka sayar yana barin 800−300=500 won. Saboda haka ana buƙatar kaya 10 don biyan 5,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s2.model.1: Jimillar kuɗin shiga 800x da jimillar kuɗin kashewa 5,000+300x dole su yi daidai. Saboda haka 500x=5,000 kuma x=10.

l-m-h3-b0c36-21.title: Rubuta tsarin lissafi da matrices
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.goal: Canza tsarin lissafi 2x+3y=7, x−y=1 zuwa wata siga (daidaito, tebur, zane, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anar ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.material: Muna son rubuta tsarin 2x+3y=7, x−y=1 a matsayin samfurin matrix. Rubuta coefficients a matrix, abubuwan da ba a sani ba da ɓangaren dama kuma a vectors ginshiƙai.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi daidaiton matrix mai ma’ana iri ɗaya.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s1.r.a: Alamar coefficient a daidaito na biyu ta bambanta, saboda haka ya zama −x+y=1.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s1.r.b: An musanya layuka da ginshiƙai na matrix coefficient, saboda haka ya zama daidaito daban.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s1.r.c: An rubuta coefficient −1 na y a matsayin 1, saboda haka ya zama x+y=1.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s1.explain: Kowace jere tana nuna coefficients na daidaito guda. Jere ta farko (2 3) ita ce 2x+3y, ta biyu (1 −1) kuma x−y.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s2.model.0: Jere ta farko ta samfurin matrix ita ce 2x+3y, ta biyu kuma x−y; saboda haka daidaiton biyun sun yi daidai da ɓangaren dama (7; 1).
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s2.model.1: Ninka coefficients na kowace jere da vector ginshiƙi (x; y) sannan a tara yana ba da daidaiton asali; saboda haka ma’anar ɗaya ce.

l-m-h3-b0c36-23.goal: Canza mataki guda na saukowar gangara zuwa wata siga (daidaito, tebur, zane, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anar ɗaya ce.

l-m-h3-b0c36-23.s.s1.explain: Motsawa akasin gangara yana nufin cirewa, kuma girman motsi η·f'(x) ne; saboda haka x−η·f'(x) ne.

l-m-h3-b0c36-23.s.s2.model.1: Farawa daga matsayin yanzu x da cire η f'(x) yana ba da motsi iri ɗaya da bayanin; saboda haka ma’anar ɗaya ce.

l-m-h3-b0c36-24.goal: Canza “rabo da aka rasa cikin ainihin marasa lafiya” zuwa wata siga (daidaito, tebur, zane, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anar ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.material: Cikin gwaje-gwaje 100, an gano marasa lafiya 30 daidai, an rasa marasa lafiya 10, an kira masu lafiya 5 marasa lafiya, kuma an gano masu lafiya 55 daidai.
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.s.s1.prompt: Wanne ne “rabo da aka rasa cikin ainihin marasa lafiya”?
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi amfani da dukkan gwaje-gwaje 100 a matsayin tushen rabon. Tushen rabon shi ne yawan marasa lafiya.

l-m-h3-b0c36-24.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi lissafi bisa masu lafiya da aka kira marasa lafiya.
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.s.s1.explain: Akwai ainihin marasa lafiya 30+10=40, kuma an rasa 10 daga cikinsu. 10/40=25%, wanda ya rage daga recall na 75%.
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.s.s2.model.0: An rasa 10 daga cikin ainihin marasa lafiya 40, saboda haka 10/40=25%, daidai da 1 a cire rabon waɗanda aka gano, 75%.
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.s.s2.model.1: Tushen rabon dole ya zama 40, ainihin yawan marasa lafiya; saboda haka rubuta 10/40=25%, ba 10/100 ba.

l-m-h3-b0c38-06.title: Sake rubuta tsarin lissafi a matsayin daidaiton matrix
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.goal: Sake rubuta siffar samfurin matrix na tsarin daidaito a wata hanya (daidaito, jadawali, hoto, ko kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anarsu ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.material: Muna son sake rubuta tsarin daidaito 2x+y=5, x−y=1 a matsayin daidaiton matrix mai siffar (matrix na ƙofofi)(x; y)=(gefen dama). Alamar semicolon (;) tana nuna sabon layi a matrix.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s1.prompt: Wane daidaiton matrix ke da ma’ana iri ɗaya da tsarin daidaito na asali?
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s1.r.a: Ƙimar y a layi na biyu ita ce -1, amma an rubuta ta a matsayin +1.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s1.r.b: An musanya tsarin 5 da 1 a gefen dama.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s1.explain: Rubuta ƙofofin kowane daidaito a layi guda, sannan ka rubuta gefen dama a shafi guda cikin tsari ɗaya. x=2, y=1 suna gamsar da duka daidaitattun.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s2.model.0: Layi na farko yana da ƙofofi 2, 1; na biyu yana da 1, -1; gefen dama kuma 5, 1 ne. Saboda haka [2 1; 1 -1][x; y]=[5; 1].
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s2.model.1: Saka x=2, y=1 cikin daidaiton matrix yana ba da 5 da 1 a layukan, saboda haka yana nufin abu ɗaya da tsarin daidaito na asali.

l-m-h3-b0c39-23.material: Injin tattara kaya yana aiki sau 90 cikin minti 1. Kana son bayyana wannan gudun a matsayin yawan sau cikin daƙiƙa.
l-m-h3-b0c39-23.s.s1.r.c: Ka lissafa 60÷90. An juya tsarin rabawa.
l-m-h3-b0c39-23.s.s1.r.d: Ka ninka yayin canza minti zuwa daƙiƙa. Ana samun yawan sau a daƙiƙa ta hanyar rabawa.
l-m-h3-b0c39-23.s.s1.explain: Minti 1 daƙiƙa 60 ne; saboda haka 90÷60=1.5. Sau 1.5 ne a daƙiƙa, wato sau 3 a cikin daƙiƙa 2.
l-m-h3-b0c39-23.s.s2.model.0: Minti 1 daƙiƙa 60 ne; raba sau 90 da 60 yana ba da 1.5, wato sau 1.5 a daƙiƙa.
l-m-h3-b0c39-23.s.s2.model.1: Sau 3 a cikin daƙiƙa 2 daidai yake da sau 1.5 cikin daƙiƙa 1, daidai da sau 90 a minti ɗaya. Cikin daƙiƙa 60, 1.5×60=sau 90.

l-m-h3-b0c45-26.goal: Sake bayyana triangle masu daidaito 3 da murabba’ai 2 da ke haɗuwa a vertex guda ta wata siga (daidaito, tebur, zane, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin ma’ana ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.material: Kusurwar triangle mai daidaito guda 60° ce, kusurwar murabba’i guda kuma 90°. Akwai tsari inda triangle 3 da murabba’ai 2 ke haɗuwa a vertex ba tare da gibi ba.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.prompt: Wane daidaito ne ke nuna suna haɗuwa ba tare da gibi ba?

l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.r.d: Ka tara yawan siffofi kawai, ba girman kusurwoyi ba.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.explain: Dole kusurwoyin su tara cikakken zagaye 360° domin babu gibi. 180°+180°=360°.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s2.model.0: Kusurwoyin da ke kewaye da maki dole su zama 360°; rubuta ko 60°×3 da 90°×2 suna ba da 360°.

l-m-h3-b0c46-23.title: Mitar sauti nawa ce idan aka ɗaga sauti octaves biyu?
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.goal: Sake rubuta mitar sautin da ke octaves biyu sama a wata siga (lissafi, jadawali, hoto ko kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma'anarta ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.material: Idan aka ɗaga octave ɗaya, ana ninka mita sau 2. Akwai sauti da yake octaves biyu sama da sautin 110Hz.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.prompt: Wane lissafi ne ya nuna mitar wannan sauti daidai?
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.r.a: Wannan ƙimar ce ta ɗaga octave ɗaya kawai (220Hz).
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.r.b: An ɗauki kowane octave a matsayin ninka sau 4. A zahiri ninka sau 2 ne, sau biyu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.r.d: Mitar tana ƙaruwa ta hanyar ninkawa, ba ta hanyar tarawa ba.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.explain: Kowane octave ninka sau 2 ne; saboda haka octaves biyu ninka sau 2×2=4 ne, kuma 110×4=440Hz.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s2.model.0: Kowane octave yana ninka mitar sau 2; saboda haka octaves biyu za a iya sake rubuta su a matsayin ninka sau 4, wato ninka 2 sau biyu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s2.model.1: Mitar tana hawa daga 110Hz zuwa 220Hz, sannan daga 220Hz zuwa 440Hz; saboda haka wannan daidai yake da 110×2×2=440.

l-m-h3-b0c46-24.title: Yuwuwar samun sandunan yut guda biyu da gefensu lebur ya fuskanto, a matsayin lissafi
l-m-h3-b0c46-24.goal: Sake rubuta yuwuwar samun sandunan yut guda 2 cikin guda 4 masu lebur a wata siga (lissafi, jadawali, hoto ko kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ma'anarsu ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c46-24.material: Ka jefa sandunan yut guda 4. A ɗauka cewa ga kowane sanda, gefen lebur da zagaye suna da yiwuwar fitowa iri ɗaya kuma sandunan ba sa shafar juna. Rubuta lissafin yuwuwar samun gefuna lebur daidai guda 2.
l-m-h3-b0c46-24.s.s1.prompt: Wane lissafi ne ya nuna wannan yuwuwar daidai?
l-m-h3-b0c46-24.s.s1.r.a: An manta da adadin hanyoyin zaɓar sanduna guda biyu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-24.s.s1.r.c: Wannan ita ce yuwuwar samun guda 1 kawai.
l-m-h3-b0c46-24.s.s1.r.d: An duba rabon adadin sanduna kawai, ba a ƙidaya hanyoyin zaɓa ba.
l-m-h3-b0c46-24.s.s1.explain: Akwai hanyoyi ₄C₂=6 na zaɓar sanduna 2, kuma kowace hanya tana da yuwuwar (1/2)⁴; saboda haka 6/16=3/8.
l-m-h3-b0c46-24.s.s2.model.0: Akwai hanyoyi 6 na zaɓar sandunan lebur guda biyu, kuma kowace hanya tana da yuwuwar (1/2)⁴; saboda haka ₄C₂×(1/2)⁴=3/8.
l-m-h3-b0c46-24.s.s2.model.1: Yuwuwar wani yanayi guda ɗaya da aka ƙayyade siffar duk sanduna huɗu ita ce 1/16; idan aka ninka ta da adadin irin waɗannan yanayi, 6, ana samun 6/16.

l-m-h3-b0c46-25.s.s1.explain: Don daidaito game da ginshiƙin y, alamar ma'aunin x ce kawai ke canzawa, ma'aunin y kuma ya kasance yadda yake. Maki mai daidaito da (4, −1) shi ne (−4, −1).

l-m-h3-b0c46-26.topic: Haɗin ciki da waje da faci
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.goal: Sake rubuta alwatika mai tushe 8 da tsawo 5 a wata siga (lissafi, jadawali, hoto ko kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ma'anarsu ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.material: Lissafin gargajiya na Gabas yana nemo faci ta yanke siffofi da matsar da sassan (ƙa'idar cike ciki da waje). Kana son yanke alwatika mai tushe 8 da tsawo 5, sannan ka haɗa sassan ya zama murabba'i mai tsawo mai faɗi 8.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.prompt: Menene tsawon murabba'in mai tsawo mai faci iri ɗaya?
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.r.a: Idan tsawon ya kasance yadda yake, faci zai ninka sau biyu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.r.b: Idan aka ninka tsawo sau biyu, faci zai ninka sau huɗu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.r.d: An rubuta faci na alwatika, 20, a matsayin tsawo.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.explain: Facin alwatika shi ne 8×5÷2=20. Tsawon murabba'in mai faɗi 8 kuma facinsa iri ɗaya shi ne 20÷8=2.5, wato rabin tsawon alwatika.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s2.model.0: Idan ka yanke ɓangaren sama na alwatika ka matsar da shi, zai zama murabba’i mai rabin tsayi; saboda haka tsayin rabin 5 ne, wato 2.5.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s2.model.1: Raba faɗi 20 da faɗin 8 ya ba da 2.5, don haka ya zama murabba’i mai faɗi iri ɗaya.

l-m-h3-b0c47-23.title: Yaya za ka sake rubuta daidaiton rabon zinariya ta wata siga?
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.goal: Sake bayyana daidaiton rabon zinariya φ ta wata siga (daidaito, tebur, zane, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin ma’ana ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.material: Rabon zinariya φ (kusan 1.618) yana cika φ=1+1/φ. Nemo daidaito dabam mai ma’ana ɗaya.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi daidaiton da ke da ma’ana iri ɗaya da na asali.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.a: Ya bambanta, domin φ²≈2.618 kuma φ−1≈0.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.b: Yana cika ne kawai idan φ=2. Amma φ kusan 1.618 ne.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.c: Idan aka soke φ a ɓangarorin biyu, 0=1 ake samu, wanda ba gaskiya ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.explain: Idan an ninka ɓangarorin biyu da φ, ana samun φ²=φ+1. Idan φ≈1.618, ɓangarorin biyu kusan 2.618 ne.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s2.model.0: Ninka ɓangarorin biyu da φ yana ba da φ²=φ+1, saboda haka ma’anarsa ɗaya ce da daidaiton asali.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s2.model.1: Sanya φ=1.618 yana ba da φ²≈2.618 da φ+1=2.618; saboda haka daidaiton biyun suna da ƙima ɗaya.

l-m-h3-b0c47-24.title: Yaya za ka juya yawan nau’in zomaye zuwa ƙa’ida mai layi ɗaya?
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.goal: Sake bayyana yadda yawan nau’in zomaye ke ƙaruwa a matsayin ƙa’ida mai layi ɗaya ta wata siga (daidaito, tebur, zane, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin ma’ana ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.material: An haifi nau’in zomaye guda biyu, bayan watanni biyu kuma suna haihuwar nau’i sabo kowane wata. Zomayen ba sa mutuwa. Yawan nau’i kowane wata yana ƙaruwa 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ….
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.prompt: Wanne ne ke juya wannan ƙaruwa zuwa ƙa’ida mai layi ɗaya daidai?
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.o.a: Wannan wata = wata ta baya × wata ta baya
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.r.a: Ninkawa yana ba da 1,1,1,…, daban da jerin da aka bayar. (1, 1, 1)
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.o.b: Wannan wata = watan baya + watanni biyu da suka wuce
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.r.c: Yana ƙaruwa 1,2,4,8. Ya bambanta da 1,1,2,3 da aka bayar. (1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 8) (1 2)
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.o.d: Wannan wata = watan da ya gabata + 1
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.r.d: Yana ƙaruwa kamar haka: 1, 2, 3, 4. Wannan ya bambanta da lambobin da aka bayar.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.explain: Yawan sabbin tagwaye ya yi daidai da yawan tagwayen da ke akwai watanni biyu da suka wuce. Saboda haka 1+1=2, 1+2=3, 2+3=5.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s2.model.0: Tagwayen wannan watan su ne tagwayen watan da ya gabata tare da sabbin tagwaye; yawan sabbin tagwayen kuma ya yi daidai da yawan tagwayen watanni biyu da suka wuce, saboda haka ƙa’idar ta dace.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s2.model.1: Ƙara lambobi biyu da suka gabata yana ba da lamba ta gaba, kamar 2+3=5 da 3+5=8, saboda haka ƙa’idojin biyu suna nufin abu ɗaya.

l-m-h3-b0c47-25.title: Ta yaya za ka rubuta juyawar 180° a kusa da asali a matsayin ma’auni?
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.goal: Sake bayyana motsin juyawar 180° a kusa da asali ta wata hanya (ma’auni, jadawali, hoto, ko kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anarta ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.material: Sanya wani tsari a kan faifan haɗaɗɗun lambobi sannan ka juya shi 180° a kusa da asali. Maki (3, 2) yana matsawa zuwa (−3, −2). Mayar da wannan motsi zuwa ma’auni na maki (x, y).
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s1.r.a: Wannan daidaito ne game da layin y-axis. (3, 2) yana zuwa (−3, 2).
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s1.r.b: Wannan daidaito ne game da layin x-axis. (3, 2) yana zuwa (3, −2).
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s1.r.c: Wannan daidaito ne game da layin y=x. (3, 2) yana zuwa (2, 3).
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s1.explain: Juyawar 180° tana sauya alamun x da y duka. Wannan ya yi daidai da matsawar (3, 2) zuwa (−3, −2).
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s2.model.0: Tun da (3, 2) yana zuwa (−3, −2), (−x, −y), wanda ke sauya alamun x da y duka, yana bayyana motsi iri ɗaya.
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s2.model.1: Daidaito game da y-axis ko x-axis yana sauya alama guda ɗaya kawai, saboda haka (3, 2) ba ya zama (−3, −2), kuma waɗannan ba su dace ba.

l-m-h3-b0c48-23.material: Daga cikin mutane 1000 da suka sha sabon magani, mutum 1 ya sami alamomi; daga cikin mutane 1000 da ba su sha ba, mutane 2 suka sami alamomi. Kanun labarin ya ce “raguwar haɗari 50%.” Nuna wannan gaskiya ta wata hanya.
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.prompt: Wace magana ce ke nuna gaskiya iri ɗaya da kanun labarin?
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.o.a: Yawan alamomin ya ragu da maki 50 na kaso
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.r.a: Bambancin yawan ya kai maki 0.1 na kaso. 50% raguwa ce ta dangantaka, daga 2 zuwa 1.
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.o.b: Daga cikin mutane 10 da ba su sha ba, mutane 2 sun sami alamomi
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.r.b: Mutane 2 ne cikin 1000. Ba mutane 2 cikin 10 ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.o.c: Yawan alamomin ya ragu daga 0.2% zuwa 0.1%
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.o.d: Kashi 50% na mutanen da suka sha maganin sun sami alamomi
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.r.d: 1 cikin 1000 shi ne 0.1%. Ba 50% ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.explain: Ya ragu da rabi daga mutane 2 zuwa 1, wato “raguwar 50%”; ta fuskar yawan kaso kuwa, ya ragu da maki 0.1.
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s2.model.0: 2 cikin 1000 (0.2%) sun koma 1 (0.1%), saboda haka da dangantaka ya ragu da rabi, a zahiri kuma ya ragu da maki 0.1 na kaso.
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s2.model.1: 50% na nufin raguwa ne bisa haɗarin farko, saboda haka ya bambanta da cikakken bambancin maki 0.1 na kaso; shi ya sa ya dace a bayar da su duka tare.

l-m-h3-b0c48-25.material: Kashi 10% na imel saƙon banza ne. Kalmar “free” tana bayyana a cikin kashi 80% na saƙonnin banza da kashi 5% na imel na yau da kullum. Ka yi tunanin imel 1000, sannan ka yi tunanin kaso na saƙon banza a cikin imel ɗin da ke ɗauke da “free.”
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.prompt: Wace bayani ce ta amfani da ƙidaya daidai?
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.o.a: 80 daga cikin saƙonni 85 masu ɗauke da “free,” wato kusan 94%
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.r.a: 5% na imel na yau da kullum shi ne 5% na 900, wato imel 45.
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.r.b: Tambayar tana magana ne game da duk imel ɗin da ke ɗauke da “free,” ba saƙonnin banza kaɗai ba.
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.o.c: 80 daga cikin imel 125 masu ɗauke da “free” saƙonnin banza ne, wato 64%
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.o.d: Saƙonnin banza 10% ne, saboda haka ko da akwai “free” adadinsu 10% ne
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.r.d: Idan aka ƙara bayanin “free,” yiwuwar tana canzawa.
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.explain: “Free” tana bayyana a cikin saƙonnin banza 80 daga 100 da imel 45 daga 900 na yau da kullum. 80÷(80+45)=64%.
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s2.model.0: Imel ɗin da ke ɗauke da “free” su ne 80+45=125, kuma 80 daga cikinsu saƙonnin banza ne, wato 64%.
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s2.model.1: 5% na imel 900 na yau da kullum su ne 45, saboda haka saƙonnin banza cikin imel masu “free” su ne 80/125.

l-m-h3-b0c48-26.title: Mayar da bambancin girman girgizar ƙasa zuwa ninkin kuzari
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.goal: Mayar da bambancin girman girgizar zuwa rabon kuzari ta wata hanya (ma’auni, jadawali, hoto, ko kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anarta ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.material: Kuzarin girgizar ƙasa E da girma M suna da alaƙa ta log E=4.8+1.5M. Sake rubuta ma’aunin domin gano sau nawa kuzarin girgizar girma 7 ya fi na girma 5.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s1.prompt: Wace bayani ce ta amfani da rabon kuzari daidai?
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s1.r.a: Dole ne a ninka da 1.5. Bambancin girma 1 ba ya nufin sau 10.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s1.r.b: Bambancin 3 a ƙimar log ba ya nufin ninki 3, amma yana nufin sau 10³.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s1.r.c: Ba za ka iya amfani da bambancin girma kai tsaye a matsayin ninkin kuzari ba.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s1.explain: Idan bambancin log E ya zama 1.5×2=3, rabon E zai zama sau 10³=1000.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s2.model.0: Bambancin log E ya zama 3, saboda haka rabon kuzari sau 10³=1000 ne.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s2.model.1: A cikin log, ƙaruwa da 1 yana nufin kuzari sau 10; saboda haka bambancin 3 yana nufin ninka sau 10 sau uku, wato 1000.

l-m-h3-b0c49-23.title: Bayyana furucin quadratic a matsayin motsin ƙwallo
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.goal: Mayar da dabari tsayi zuwa motsin ƙwallo: bayyana ta wata siga (dabari, tebur, zane, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin ma’ana ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.material: Bayan an jefa ƙwallo, tsawonta bayan t daƙiƙa h=−2(t−3)²+18 (m). Mayar da dabari zuwa kalmomin da ke bayyana motsin.
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.o.a: Tana kaiwa ƙaramin matsayi, m 18, a daƙiƙa 3, sannan ta taɓa ƙasa a daƙiƙa 6
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.r.a: −2 a gaba yana nufin tana buɗewa ƙasa, saboda haka wannan shi ne mafi girman wuri.
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.o.b: Tana kaiwa mafi girman tsawo m 18 a daƙiƙa 3, sannan ta taɓa ƙasa a daƙiƙa 6
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.o.c: Tana kaiwa mafi girman tsawo m 3 a daƙiƙa 18
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.r.c: Vertex ita ce (3,18), saboda haka lokaci daƙiƙa 3, tsawo kuma m 18. (3, 18)
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.o.d: Tsawon farawa m 18 ne kuma kullum tana sauka
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.r.d: Idan t=0, tsawo 0 ne; saboda haka ta fara daga ƙasa.
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.explain: Vertex (3,18) ce, tana buɗewa ƙasa; saboda haka mafi girma m 18 ne a daƙiƙa 3. h=0 idan t=0 da 6. (3, 18)
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s2.model.0: −2(t−3)² ba ya wuce 0; saboda haka h ya fi girma idan t=3, daraja 18, kuma h=0 idan t=0 da 6, don haka ta taɓa ƙasa.
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s2.model.1: Vertex (3,18) ce, don haka mafi girman tsawo m 18 ne a daƙiƙa 3; bisa daidaiton madubi tana komawa ƙasa a daƙiƙa 6. (3, 18)

l-m-h3-b0c49-24.goal: Bayyana x²−4x−5<0 bisa matsayin jadawalin, ta wata siga (dabari, tebur, zane, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin ma’ana ɗaya ce.

l-m-h3-b0d07-05.title: Mayar da jimillar ɓangare n/(n+1) zuwa kalmar gama-gari
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.goal: Bayyana kalmar gama-gari aₙ na jimillar ɓangare Sₙ=n/(n+1) ta wata hanya (ma’auni, jadawali, hoto, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anarsu ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.material: Jimillar jerin Σaₙ daga kalma ta farko zuwa kalma ta n ita ce Sₙ=n/(n+1). Bayyana jerin iri ɗaya ta amfani da kalmar gama-gari aₙ.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.prompt: Wanne ne ya bayyana aₙ daidai?
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.r.a: S₂−S₁=1/6 ne, amma wannan bayani yana ba da a₂=2/3, don haka sun bambanta.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.r.c: Idan n=1, yana ba da 1/4, amma a₁=S₁=1/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.explain: aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁. n/(n+1)−(n−1)/n=1/{n(n+1)}, kuma ya dace da n=1 ma, yana ba da 1/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s2.model.0: Kalmar gama-gari ita ce bambancin jimillar ɓangare biyu maƙwabta, Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁; saboda haka saka n/(n+1)−(n−1)/n a kan ƙasa guda yana ba da 1/{n(n+1)}.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s2.model.1: S₁=1/2 kuma S₂−S₁=1/6; saka ƙimomin cikin 1/{n(n+1)} yana ba da 1/2 da 1/6, saboda haka jerin iri ɗaya ne.

l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.explain: f'(x)=e^(−x)−xe^(−x)=(1−x)e^(−x), kuma e^(−x)>0; saboda haka f'>0 yana nufin 1−x>0, wato x<1.

l-m-h3-b0d09-06.goal: Sake bayyana sharaɗin cewa nisa zuwa cibiyar hankali da layin jagora sun yi daidai ta wata siga (magana, jadawali, hoto, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anarsu ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.material: Tarin maki P(x, y) masu daidaitaccen nisa daga cibiyar hankali F(0, 2) da layin jagora y = −2 parabola ce. Mayar da wannan sharaɗi zuwa ma’auni guda.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.prompt: Wane ma’auni ne ke bayyana ma’ana iri ɗaya?
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.r.a: A cikin 4py, p=2 ne, saboda haka 8y ne, ba 4y ba.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.r.b: Parabola tana da y-axis a matsayin axis, saboda haka an musanya x da y.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.r.c: Cibiyar tana sama, saboda haka parabola tana buɗewa zuwa sama. Alamar ta bambanta.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.explain: Yin murabba’i ga ɓangarorin biyu na √(x²+(y−2)²)=|y+2| yana ba da x²+y²−4y+4=y²+4y+4, wato x²=8y.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s2.model.0: Rubuta “nisan ya yi daidai” a matsayin ma’auni yana ba da x²+(y−2)²=(y+2)², kuma sauƙaƙawa yana ba da x²=8y, saboda haka suna nufin abu ɗaya.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s2.model.1: Idan koli yana a asali, cibiyar kuma (0,2) ce, to p=2, saboda haka x²=4py=8y; kuma tun da tana buɗewa zuwa sama, alamar ma daidai ce.

l-m-h3-b0d09-38.goal: Mayar da daidaiton sphere da aka buɗe zuwa wata siffa (daidaito, tebur, hoto ko kalmomi), kuma bayyana dalilin ma’anarsu ɗaya.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.material: An buɗe daidaiton sphere: x²+y²+z²−2x+4y−6z+5=0. Sake rubuta shi domin a ga cibiyar da radius kai tsaye.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.prompt: Wane daidaito ne ke wakiltar sphere ɗin ɗaya?
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.r.a: Alamun ko’odin cibiyar an juya su.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.r.b: Gefen dama murabba’in radius ne, saboda haka 9 ne ba 3 ba.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.r.c: An samu gefen dama ba daidai ba ta hanyar ƙara constant 5.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.explain: Kammala murabba’ai yana bada (x−1)²+(y+2)²+(z−3)²=1+4+9−5=9. Cibiyar (1,−2,3), radius 3. (2, 3)
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s2.model.0: Kammala murabba’in x,y,z yana ƙara 1+4+9, an matsar da 5; gefen dama ya zama 9, daidaito iri ɗaya.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s2.model.1: Matsar da 9 daga dama zuwa hagu da buɗewa yana bada −2x+4y−6z da constant 1+4+9−9=5, kamar daidaiton asali.

l-m-h3-b0d10-10.goal: Canja ma'auni na faɗaɗa ellipse zuwa wani nau'i (equation, tebur, hoto, kalmomi), kuma bayyana dalilin da yasa ake nufi da abu ɗaya.
l-m-h3-b0d10-10.material: An rubuta ma'auni na ellipse a faɗaɗɗen nau'i kamar 4x² + 9y² - 16x + 18y - 11 = 0. Sake rubuta shi a cikin nau'i mai nuna tsakiya da tsayin manya da ƙananan gatura.
l-m-h3-b0d10-10.s.s1.prompt: Wanne ma'auni ne ke wakiltar ellipse ɗaya?
l-m-h3-b0d10-10.s.s1.r.c: 16 da 9 ba a haɗa su tare zuwa 11 akai-akai.

l-m-h3-b0d10-10.s.s1.explain: 4(x−2)²+9(y+1)²=11+16+9=36, kuma raba ta 36 yana bada (x−2)²/9+(y+1)²/4=1. Cibiyar ita ce (2, -1).
l-m-h3-b0d10-10.s.s2.model.0: Ƙirƙirar x da y zuwa cikakkun murabba'ai yana sanya gefen dama 11+16+9=36, don haka rarrabawa da 36 yana ba da (x−2)²/9+(y+1)²/4=1, wanda shine ma'auni ɗaya.
l-m-h3-b0d10-10.s.s2.model.1: Fadada wannan ma'auni yana ba da 4x²+9y²−16x+18y+25=36, wanda ya yi daidai da ainihin lissafin, don haka ellipse iri ɗaya ne.

l-m-h3-b0c34-25.s.s1.r.c: Ana cire haraji daga ribar, saboda haka ribar da ka riƙe tana raguwa.

l-m-h3-b0c36-25.title: Vectors biyu suna nuni zuwa alkibla ɗaya?
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyi ko ikirari biyu game da alkiblar vectors (1,2) da (2,4), zaɓi mafi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.material: Akwai ikirari biyu game da alkiblar vectors u=(1,2) da v=(2,4). Ikirari A: Abubuwan sun bambanta, saboda haka alkiblar ta bambanta. Ikirari B: v ninki 2 na u ne, saboda haka alkiblar ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.prompt: Wane ikirari ne ya fi dacewa?
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.o.a: A: Abubuwan sun bambanta, saboda haka alkiblar ta bambanta
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.r.a: Ka rasa cewa vectors na iya samun girma dabam amma su nuna hanya ɗaya.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.o.b: B: Alaƙar ninki 2 ce, saboda haka alkibla ɗaya ce
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.o.c: Dukansu daidai ne: kowace alkibla tana yiwuwa
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.r.c: Alkiblar tana tabbata a matsayin guda ɗaya kawai. Ikirari biyu masu saɓani ba za su iya zama daidai duka ba.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.o.d: Dole girman su yi daidai domin alkiblar ta yi daidai
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.r.d: Ka gauraya girma da alkibla. Ana ƙayyade alkibla dabam da girma.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.explain: Idan v=2u, to v ya miƙe daga u cikin alkibla ɗaya. Girma ne kaɗai ya bambanta, alkiblar kuma ɗaya ce.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s2.model.0: v=(2,4)=2×(1,2), saboda haka u ne da aka miƙa tsawonsa ninki biyu cikin alkibla ɗaya; abubuwan sun bambanta ne saboda girman ya bambanta.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s2.model.1: Vectors masu alkibla ɗaya su ne ninkoki masu kyau na juna; saboda haka B, mai alaƙar ninki 2, daidai ne, A kuma ta ɗauki bambancin girma a matsayin bambancin alkibla.

l-m-h3-b0c37-25.title: Shawarar littattafai: dot product da cosine similarity
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyin zaɓen littattafai masu kama da dandano, zaɓi mafi dacewa ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.material: Dandano s=(1,2), Littafi X=(1,2), Y=(6,0). Hanya A tana zaɓar dot product mafi girma; B cosine similarity mafi girma cosθ=(a·b)/(|a||b|). Ana son littafi mai “alkibla” iri ɗaya da dandano.

l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.r.a: Dot product yana ƙaruwa idan vector sun fi girma, don haka ba ya kwatanta alkibla kaɗai.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.o.b: Dukansu za su zaɓi littafi ɗaya
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.r.b: A tana zaɓar Y, B kuma X, saboda haka sun bambanta.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.o.c: B: raba da girma, a kwatanta alkibla kawai
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.o.d: A: Littafi mai girma koyaushe ya fi kyau
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.r.d: Girman ba ya nuna yadda ya dace da dandano.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.explain: X yana da alkibla iri ɗaya da s, cos=1; na Y kusan 0.45 ne. Dot product ya fi kimanta Y mai girma, don haka bai dace da manufar alkibla ba.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s2.model.0: Cosine similarity tana raba da girma, tana kwatanta alkibla kaɗai. Tana zaɓar X mai alkibla iri ɗaya da s.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s2.model.1: Dot product ya fito 6 saboda Y yana da girma, amma alkiblarsa ta bambanta. Idan alkibla ake nema, B ce ta dace.

l-m-h3-b0c38-07.material: Vektocin ƙimar fina-finai uku: P=(1,2,3), Q=(2,4,6), R=(3,2,1). Q yana ba da maki masu karamci fiye da P, amma tsarin abubuwan da suke so iri ɗaya ne. Muna son kwatanta tsarin, ba girman maki ba.

l-m-h3-b0c38-07.s.s1.explain: Q=2P ne, saboda haka alkiblar iri ɗaya ce kuma kamanceceniyar cosine ita ce 1. Ko da yake R yana kusa da P ta fuskar nisa, tsarin abubuwan da aka fi so ya bambanta.

l-m-h3-b0c42-32.material: Kason amincewa ya tashi daga 20% zuwa 25%. Kanun A: “Kason amincewa ya ƙaru da 5%” Kanun B: “Kason amincewa ya ƙaru da 5%p (ƙarin 25%)”.
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.prompt: Wane kanun ne ya fi daidaito?
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.o.a: A, ya ƙaru da 5, babu matsala
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.r.a: “5%” na iya nufin 5% na 20, wato ƙarin 1.
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.o.b: B, ya bambanta %p da kason ƙaruwa
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.o.c: B ba daidai ba ne, domin 5%p da 25% sun bambanta
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.r.c: Su furuci ne da ke auna abubuwa dabam; amfani da su tare ba kuskure ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.r.d: Ƙarin 5%p da ƙarin 5% suna nufin abubuwa daban.
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.explain: Daga 20% zuwa 25% ƙarin maki kaso 5%p ne, a matsayin rabo kuma ƙarin 5÷20=25% ne. “5%” na iya nufin 5% na 20 (=1).
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s2.model.0: Maki kaso yana nuna bambanci tsakanin kaso, ƙarin 25% kuma kason canji ne idan aka kwatanta da 20; saboda haka B mai bambance su ya fi daidaito.
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s2.model.1: 5% na A na iya nufin 5% na 20%, wato 1%p; don haka B da ke bambance 5%p da 25% yana rage rashin fahimta.

l-m-h3-b0c42-33.title: Abin da mutane 20 masu nasara suka yi tarayya da shi shi ne sirri?
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.goal: Kwatanta fassarori biyu na abin da lokuta masu nasara suke da shi tare, zaɓi mafi dacewa sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.material: An ce ’yan kasuwa 20 masu nasara duk suna tashi da ƙarfe 5 na safe. A: “Tashi da sassafe shi ne sirrin nasara.” B: “Ba tare da sanin lokacin tashi na ’yan kasuwar da suka gaza ba, ba za mu kira shi sirri ba.”
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.prompt: Wane furuci ne ya fi dacewa bisa waɗannan bayanai kaɗai?
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.o.a: A, dukkansu 20 iri ɗaya ne, saboda haka tabbatacce ne
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.r.a: An duba masu nasara kawai, ba a binciki waɗanda suka gaza ba.
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.o.b: A, masu tashi da sassafe masu ƙwazo ne
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.r.b: Ba a nuna cewa ƙwazo ne sanadin nasara ba.
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.o.c: B, an tabbatar tashi da sassafe ba shi da alaƙa da nasara
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.r.c: Ba a tabbatar da rashin alaƙa ba; kawai ba za mu iya sani ba.
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.o.d: B, babu rukunin waɗanda suka gaza da za a kwatanta, saboda haka ba za a iya kammalawa ba
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.explain: Idan an tattara masu nasara kawai, ba za a san ko ɗabi’ar ɗaya ta zama gama-gari ga waɗanda suka gaza ba. Saboda haka ba za a kammala cewa wannan sirri ne ba.
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s2.model.0: Idan ’yan kasuwar da suka gaza ma suna tashi da sassafe, wannan ba sirri ba ne; saboda haka B ya fi A da ta kammala ba tare da rukuni kwatance ba.
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s2.model.1: Idan an tattara masu nasara kawai, ba za a san ko abin da suka yi tarayya da shi yana da alaƙa da nasara ba; saboda haka B da ke bayyana iyakar shaida ya fi dacewa.

l-m-h3-b0c43-06.title: Wace ƙima ce ya kamata ta bayyana warwatsewar maki?
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.goal: Kwatanta ƙimomi biyu da ke nuna yadda bayanai suka warwatse, zaɓi wanda ya fi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalilanka.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.material: A jarabawar lissafi, yawancin maki na ɗalibai 20 suna tsakanin 70 da 80, kuma ɗalibi guda ɗaya ne kawai ya samu maki 20. Kewayon maki 60 ne, kewayon kwata-kwata kuma maki 8 ne. Zaɓi ƙimar da za ta bayyana warwatsewar yawancin ɗalibai.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙima ce ta fi dacewa wajen bayyana warwatsewar yawancin ɗalibai?
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.o.a: Kewayo maki 60, domin yana nuna babban bambanci
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.r.a: Makin ɗalibi guda ɗaya na 20 ya sa kewayon ya yi girma sosai.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.o.b: Kewayo maki 60, domin yana amfani da dukan bayanai
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.r.b: Kewayon yana amfani da ƙimomi biyu kawai, mafi girma da mafi ƙanƙanta.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.o.c: Dukansu iri ɗaya ne, domin suna auna warwatsewa
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.r.c: Idan akwai ƙima mai nisa da sauran, ƙimomin biyun suna bambanta sosai.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.o.d: Kewayon kwata-kwata maki 8, domin faɗin rabin bayanan tsakiya ne
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.explain: Ƙimar 20 guda ɗaya tana shafar kewayon sosai. Kewayon kwata-kwata shi ne faɗin rabin bayanan tsakiya, saboda haka yana wakiltar yawancin ɗalibai da kyau.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s2.model.0: Makin 20 na ɗalibi guda ɗaya ya sa kewayon ya zama maki 60, saboda haka kewayon kwata-kwata na maki 8, wato faɗin rabin bayanan tsakiya, ya fi nuna warwatsewar yawancin ɗalibai.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s2.model.1: Kewayon yana amfani da ƙima mafi ƙanƙanta da mafi girma kawai, saboda haka ƙimomi masu nisa suna shafar sa sosai. Kewayon kwata-kwata kuwa ba ya shafuwa sosai, saboda haka ya fi dacewa.

l-m-h3-b0c43-16.topic: Coefficient na correlation da zane warwatse
l-m-h3-b0c43-16.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyi kan amfani da coefficient na correlation tare da zane warwatse, zaɓi mafi dacewa ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c43-16.material: Coefficient na correlation na bayanai huɗu duk kusan 0.8 ne, amma zanen warwatse ya bambanta: siffar layi, lankwasa, siffar da ƙima ta musamman guda ta jawo, da warwatse na yau da kullum.
l-m-h3-b0c43-16.s.s1.prompt: Wace hanya ce ta fi dacewa da rahoto?
l-m-h3-b0c43-16.s.s1.o.a: Rubuta coefficient 0.8 kaɗai, domin sauƙi ne
l-m-h3-b0c43-16.s.s1.r.a: Ko ƙima ɗaya ce, siffofin zane warwatse sun bambanta.
l-m-h3-b0c43-16.s.s1.o.b: Saka zane warwatse kawai, kada a rubuta lambobi
l-m-h3-b0c43-16.s.s1.r.b: Lambar ma tana taƙaita ƙarfin alaƙa; amfani da biyun ya fi.
l-m-h3-b0c43-16.s.s1.o.c: Rubuta cewa duk bayanai huɗu iri ɗaya ne
l-m-h3-b0c43-16.s.s1.r.c: Zanen warwatse sun bambanta, ba za a ce bayanai iri ɗaya ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c43-16.s.s1.o.d: Saka coefficient na correlation da zane warwatse tare
l-m-h3-b0c43-16.s.s1.explain: Ko coefficient ɗaya ne, siffofin sun bambanta. Lamba tana nuna ƙarfi, zane kuma siffa da ƙimomi na musamman; saka biyun ya dace.

l-m-h3-b0c43-16.s.s2.model.1: Lamba guda tana nuna ƙarfin alaƙa kawai; zane kuma yana nuna siffa da ƙimomi na musamman.

l-m-h3-b0c47-26.title: Wanne daga cikin ƙiyasin pi guda biyu na zamanin da ya fi kusa?
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.goal: Kwatanta ƙiyasin pi guda biyu na zamanin da, zaɓi wanda ya fi kusa da π, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.material: Pi (π) shi ne 3.14159…. Hanyar tsohuwar Masar ta ɗauki π a matsayin 256/81 (kusan 3.1605), hanyar Babila kuma ta ɗauke shi a matsayin 25/8 (=3.125).
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.o.a: Ƙimomin biyu suna da nisa iri ɗaya daga π
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.r.a: Bambancin da ke tsakaninsu da π ya bambanta: kusan 0.0189 da 0.0166.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.r.b: Bambancin 3.1605 da π ya fi girma, kusan 0.0189.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.o.c: Babila (3.125): bambancinsa da π ya fi ƙanƙanta
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.o.d: Na Masar, mai kaso mai rikitarwa, ya fi daidaito
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.r.d: Rikitarwa ba ya sa adadi ya fi daidaito. Dole ne ka kwatanta bambance-bambancen.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.explain: Bambancin Masar da π=3.14159 kusan 0.0189 ne, na Babila kuma kusan 0.0166; saboda haka ƙimar Babila ta ɗan fi kusa.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s2.model.0: 3.1605−3.14159≈0.0189 kuma 3.14159−3.125≈0.0166. Tun da 0.0166 ya fi ƙanƙanta, ƙimar Babila ta fi kusa.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s2.model.1: 3.125 ya yi ƙasa da π, 3.1605 kuma ya yi sama da π. Idan aka kwatanta nisan da kowanne ya kauce, na Babila ya fi ƙanƙanta, don haka shi ne ya fi kusa.

l-m-h3-b0c48-30.title: Hanyoyi biyu na neman misali mai karya magana
l-m-h3-b0c48-30.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyi biyu na neman misali mai karya magana, zaɓi mafi dacewa sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c48-30.material: Magana: Jimillar lambobi marasa ma’auni biyu koyaushe ba ta da ma’auni. Hanya ta 1: Ƙara nau’i-nau’i da yawa na lambobi marasa ma’auni, kamar √2+√3 da √2+π. Hanya ta 2: Da gangan ƙirƙiri nau’i-nau’i na lambobi marasa ma’auni waɗanda jimillarsu lamba ce mai ma’auni.
l-m-h3-b0c48-30.s.s1.prompt: Wace hanya da dalili ne suka fi dacewa wajen nemo misali mai karya magana?

l-m-h3-b0c48-30.s.s1.r.a: Idan yanayin da ke karya maganar ba kasafai yake faruwa ba, ba lallai ne ka same shi ta hanyar gwadawa ba bisa tsari.
l-m-h3-b0c48-30.s.s1.o.b: Dukansu ba su da amfani: an riga an tabbatar da maganar
l-m-h3-b0c48-30.s.s1.o.c: Hanya ta 1: Tattara yanayi yana zama hujja
l-m-h3-b0c48-30.s.s1.r.c: Tattara yanayi da yawa har yanzu ba ya zama hujja ta gama-gari.
l-m-h3-b0c48-30.s.s1.o.d: Hanya ta 2: Gina misali da nufin samun tsarin da zai karya maganar
l-m-h3-b0c48-30.s.s1.explain: √2 da −√2 duka lambobi ne marasa ma’auni, amma jimillarsu 0 ce. Idan ka tsara wani tsari da zai karya maganar, misali mai karya ta zai bayyana da sauri.
l-m-h3-b0c48-30.s.s2.model.0: √2+(−√2)=0 lamba ce mai ma’auni, saboda haka Hanya ta 2, wadda ke tsara jimilla ta zama lamba mai ma’auni, tana samar da misali mai karya magana nan take.
l-m-h3-b0c48-30.s.s2.model.1: Ƙimomin da aka zaɓa ba bisa tsari ba galibi ba su da ma’auni, saboda haka ko da an gwada sau da yawa misali mai karya magana ba zai fito ba; shi ya sa Hanya ta 2 ta fi kyau.

l-m-h3-b0c49-31.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyi biyu na nuna ikirarin cewa √2 lamba mara-ajiya ce, zaɓi wacce ta fi kyau sannan ka bayyana dalilin.
l-m-h3-b0c49-31.material: Hanya ta 1: Lissafa √2 zuwa wurare 20 bayan alamar goma ka duba ko lambobin suna maimaituwa. Hanya ta 2: ɗauka cewa √2 kaso ne p/q a mafi sauƙin siga, sannan ka bincika ko hakan yana haifar da saɓani.
l-m-h3-b0c49-31.s.s1.prompt: Wace hanya ce ta fi dacewa wajen nuna cewa √2 lamba mara-ajiya ce?
l-m-h3-b0c49-31.s.s1.o.a: Hanya ta 1: ya isa idan lambobi 20 ɗin ba su maimaitu ba
l-m-h3-b0c49-31.s.s1.r.a: An duba adadin lambobi da yake da iyaka ne kawai; ƙila maimaituwar za ta fara daga baya.
l-m-h3-b0c49-31.s.s1.o.b: Hanya ta 1: kallon lambobi da yawa ta kwamfuta yana tabbatar da hakan
l-m-h3-b0c49-31.s.s1.r.b: Ko da an duba lambobi nawa, ba za a iya ganin dukan lambar da ba ta ƙarewa ba.
l-m-h3-b0c49-31.s.s1.o.c: Hanya ta 2: ɗaukar cewa kaso ne zato kawai, don haka ba za a amince da shi ba
l-m-h3-b0c49-31.s.s1.r.c: Idan zato ya haifar da saɓani, hakan yana tabbatar da cewa zato ba daidai ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c49-31.s.s1.o.d: Hanya ta 2: tana bincika dukan kaso p/q lokaci guda
l-m-h3-b0c49-31.s.s1.explain: Ko da an lissafa wurare da yawa bayan alamar goma, wannan ba hujja ba ce. Idan ɗaukar cewa kaso ne ya haifar da saɓani, hakan yana nuna cewa lambar ba kaso ba ce.
l-m-h3-b0c49-31.s.s2.model.0: Kallon adadin wurare bayan alamar goma mai iyaka ba zai nuna ko lambobin za su maimaitu daga baya ba; amma saɓanin da ya biyo bayan ɗaukar cewa kaso ne yana kawar da duk yanayi, saboda haka hanya ta 2 ta fi kyau.
l-m-h3-b0c49-31.s.s2.model.1: Rubuta ta a matsayin p/q yana bada p²=2q², wanda ke sa p da q duka ma'auru; wannan saɓani ne, don haka hanya ta 2 ita ce hujjar.

l-m-h3-b0d09-25.s.s1.explain: |a−b|²=|(1,−1)|²=2, kuma |a|²−2a·b+|b|²=1−0+1=2. Furucin X yana ba da 0, don haka ya bambanta.

l-m-h3-b0d10-11.s.s1.explain: Lokacin da x ya girma, -1 ba shi da daraja, don haka y²/9≈x²/4, wato, y≈±3x/2. Canza 1 zuwa 0 yana ba da daidai waɗannan layukan.
l-m-h3-b0d10-11.s.s2.model.0: Lokacin da x ya yi girma sosai, a cikin x²/4−y²/9=1 1 ɗin ya zama mara kyau kuma gefen hagu yana kusa da 0, don haka layin X, wanda aka samo ta hanyar canza 1 zuwa 0, daidai ne.

l-m-h3-b0c34-31.material: Kana zaɓar tsawon lokacin biyan 600 × 10,000 won. Sharuɗɗa: ① biyan wata-wata bai wuce 30 × 10,000 won ba ② cikin waɗannan, mafi ƙarancin jimillar biya. l-m-h3-b0c34-31.s.s1.explain: Lokutan da biyan wata-wata bai wuce 30 × 10,000 won ba su ne watanni 24 da 36; a cikinsu, mafi ƙarancin jimillar biya yana watanni 24 (648 × 10,000 won).

l-m-h3-b0c36-30.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi amfani da duk ƙimomin 12 a matsayin shigarwa, ya karya sharadin d≤6.
l-m-h3-b0c36-30.s.s1.explain: d ya zama aƙalla 4 kuma bai wuce 6 ba; cikin waɗannan 4 ne ke da lissafi mafi sauƙi.
l-m-h3-b0c36-30.s.s2.model.0: Ana buƙatar d≥4 don ɗanɗano 4, kuma d≤6 saboda yawan ƙimomi; saboda haka 4 ya dace kuma lissafinsa ya fi sauƙi.
l-m-h3-b0c36-30.s.s2.model.1: d=3 ya yi ƙasa da buƙata, d=12 ya yi yawa ga bayanan ƙima. Zaɓi d=4 mai sauƙi, ya cika sharuddan.

l-m-h3-b0c37-30.title: Zaɓen ƙudurin hoto
l-m-h3-b0c37-30.goal: Auna sharuɗɗan masu saɓani kan yawan pixel kowane gefe idan aka mayar da hoton baki-da-fari vector; zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa.
l-m-h3-b0c37-30.material: A rage hoton baki-da-fari zuwa pixel n×n don vector mai shigarwa n². Sharuɗɗa: ① shigarwar n²≤4000; ② don gane haruffa n≥40; ③ a cikin waɗannan, a zaɓi mafi kaifi, n mafi girma.
l-m-h3-b0c37-30.s.s1.prompt: Wane n ne ya fi cika duk sharuɗɗan?
l-m-h3-b0c37-30.s.s1.r.a: n²=784 ya cika ① amma ƙasa da 40 ne, ya karya ②.
l-m-h3-b0c37-30.s.s1.r.b: Ya cika sharuɗɗa biyu, amma akwai n mafi kaifi (③).
l-m-h3-b0c37-30.s.s1.r.d: n²=6400 ya wuce 4000, ya karya ①.
l-m-h3-b0c37-30.s.s1.explain: Idan 40≤n kuma n²≤4000, n≤63. Zaɓuɓɓag cikin mafi girma n=60 (shigarwa 3600).
l-m-h3-b0c37-30.s.s2.model.0: Daga n²≤4000 ana samun n≤63, kuma n≥40. Saboda haka 60, mafi kaifi cikin zaɓuɓɓuka a zangon, ya dace.
l-m-h3-b0c37-30.s.s2.model.1: Da 28 ba a gane haruffa; 80 yana da shigarwa 6400 da yawa. Zaɓi 60, mafi girma da ya cika sharuɗɗan.

l-m-h3-b0c37-31.goal: Auna sharuɗɗan masu saɓani wajen zaɓen matakin amincewar tazarar ƙiyasi, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c37-31.material: Idan kuskuren ma’aunin matsakaicin samfurin 2 ne, iyakar kuskure: 80% ±2.6, 90% ±3.3, 95% ±3.9, 99% ±5.2. Sharuɗɗa: ① amincewa 95% ko sama; ② kuskure ±5 ko ƙasa.

l-m-h3-b0c37-31.s.s1.explain: Saboda ①, 95% da 99% sun rage. ② ta cire 99% (±5.2). 95% ce ta cika duka.
l-m-h3-b0c37-31.s.s2.model.0: Ƙasa da 95% ya karya ①, 99% kuma ya karya ② da kuskuren 5.2. 95% kaɗai ta cika duka.
l-m-h3-b0c37-31.s.s2.model.1: Ƙara amincewa yana faɗaɗa tazara. 95% mai ±3.9 ta cika kuskure ≤5 da amincewa ≥95%.

l-m-h3-b0c37-32.goal: Auna sharuɗɗan masu saɓani kan adadin matakan dakatar da saukowa bisa gangara; zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c37-32.material: Ga f(x)=x², ƙimar koyo 0.2 tana rage x zuwa ninki 0.6 kowane mataki. Fara x=8. Sharuɗɗa: ① idan an tsaya |x|≤0.5; ② lissafi bai wuce matakai 8 ba; ③ a cikin waɗannan matakai kaɗan gwargwadon yiwuwa.
l-m-h3-b0c37-32.s.s1.prompt: Wane adadin matakai ne ya cika duk sharuɗɗan?

l-m-h3-b0c37-32.s.s1.r.b: x≈0.62, ya fi 0.5, ya karya ①.
l-m-h3-b0c37-32.s.s1.r.d: Ya cika ① amma ya karya ② mai cewa matakai 8 ko ƙasa.
l-m-h3-b0c37-32.s.s1.explain: Matakai 5 suna ba da 0.62 bai isa ba; 6 suna ba da 0.37≤0.5. Matakai 9 sun wuce iyakar 8.
l-m-h3-b0c37-32.s.s2.model.0: Matakai 6 suna ba da x≈0.37, sun cika ① kuma ba su wuce 8 ba. Matakai 5 kaɗai suna ba da 0.62.
l-m-h3-b0c37-32.s.s2.model.1: Matakai 3 da 5 ba su cika sharadin kuskure ba, 9 ya wuce adadin matakai; 6 ne ya cika duka.

l-m-h3-b0c37-33.title: Zaɓen sarkakiyar samfurin
l-m-h3-b0c37-33.goal: Auna sharuɗɗan masu saɓani wajen zaɓen sarkakiyar samfurin (digirin polynomial), zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa.
l-m-h3-b0c37-33.material: Kuskuren horo/gwaji na samfuran digiri d: d=1: 9/10; d=3: 2/3; d=4: 1.5/3.2; d=6: 0.2/8. Sharuɗɗa: ① kuskuren gwaji ≤3.5; ② gibin horo da gwaji ≤2; ③ samfurin mafi sauƙi.
l-m-h3-b0c37-33.s.s1.prompt: Wane digiri ne ya cika sharuɗɗa uku?
l-m-h3-b0c37-33.s.s1.r.a: Shi ne mafi sauƙi amma kuskuren gwaji 10 ya wuce 3.5.
l-m-h3-b0c37-33.s.s1.r.c: Ya cika sharuɗɗa biyu amma ya fi d=3 sarkakiya, ya karya ③.
l-m-h3-b0c37-33.s.s1.r.d: Kuskuren horo ƙanƙanta ne amma gwaji 8 ya karya ①.
l-m-h3-b0c37-33.s.s1.explain: d=3 da 4 sun cika ① da ②; mafi sauƙi d=3 ya dace. d=6 ya karkata ga bayanan horo.
l-m-h3-b0c37-33.s.s2.model.0: d=1 da d=6 suna da kuskuren gwaji fiye da 3.5; d=3 da 4 sun cika, zaɓi mafi sauƙi d=3.
l-m-h3-b0c37-33.s.s2.model.1: Ga d=4 kuskuren gwaji ya kai 3.2. d=3 mafi sauƙi ne, ya cika sharuɗɗa.

l-m-h3-b0c39-35.s.s1.explain: Kowane sashe yana ɗaukar sau 3×mintuna 3=9. Cikin mintuna 60, ana iya duba har sassa 6 (mintuna 54), amma sassa 7 suna ɗaukar mintuna 63, wanda ya wuce.

l-m-h3-b0c41-30.material: Haƙurin sashen ±0.5 mm (faɗi 1 mm); sikelin kayan aiki ya zama 1/10 na wannan faɗi ko ƙasa. Kasafi 30,000 won. Ma’aunin tef (1 mm, 5,000 won), caliper (0.05 mm, 20,000 won), micrometer (0.01 mm, 80,000 won).
l-m-h3-b0c41-30.s.s1.prompt: Wane zaɓi ya fi cika sharuɗɗan biyu?
l-m-h3-b0c41-30.s.s1.r.a: Sikelin 1 mm bai cika sharadin ≤0.1 mm ba.
l-m-h3-b0c41-30.s.s1.r.b: Sikelinsa ya dace amma 80,000 won ya wuce kasafi.
l-m-h3-b0c41-30.s.s1.o.d: Ƙara haƙuri zuwa 1 mm a yi amfani da tef
l-m-h3-b0c41-30.s.s1.r.d: Haƙuri ƙa’idar samfur ce, ba za a canza ta don dacewa da kayan aiki ba.
l-m-h3-b0c41-30.s.s1.explain: Caliper kaɗai ke da sikelin ≤0.1 mm da farashi ≤30,000 won. (lambobi: 0.05, 20,000)
l-m-h3-b0c41-30.s.s2.model.0: Caliper mai sikelin 0.05 mm ya cika ≤0.1 mm, 20,000 won kuma cikin kasafi; ya cika duka.
l-m-h3-b0c41-30.s.s2.model.1: Tef sikelinsa ya yi girma, micrometer ya yi tsada; caliper ya dace.

l-m-h3-b0c41-31.goal: Auna sharuɗɗan kuɗin kunshi da haɗarin karyewa masu saɓani, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c41-31.material: Akwati A 400 won kowanne, ƙimar karyewa 5%; B 520 won, 1%; C 900 won, 0.5%. Kaya na da darajar 3,000 won; idan ya karye darajar ta ɓace. Ƙimar karyewa ≤2%, jimillar kuɗin kaya guda (kunshi+asara) ƙarami ya fi.
l-m-h3-b0c41-31.s.s1.prompt: Wane akwati ya cika duka kuma ya fi dacewa?
l-m-h3-b0c41-31.s.s1.r.a: Jimillar kuɗi ga kaya guda 550 won ne, amma ƙimar karyewa 5% ta karya sharadin 2%.

l-m-h3-b0c41-31.s.s1.r.b: Matsakaicin ƙimar karyewa 3% ne, ya karya sharadin ≤2%.
l-m-h3-b0c41-31.s.s1.r.d: Ya cika sharuɗɗan amma jimillar kuɗi 915 won ita ce mafi girma.
l-m-h3-b0c41-31.s.s1.explain: Jimilla: A 550 won (an cire saboda 5%); B 520+30=550; C 900+15=915. Cikin sharuɗɗa B ne mafi arha.
l-m-h3-b0c41-31.s.s2.model.0: A an cire saboda 5%; B jimilla 550 won, C 915. B ya cika sharuɗɗa kuma ya fi arha.
l-m-h3-b0c41-31.s.s2.model.1: Ko da aka ƙara asarar karyewar 30 won, B jimilla 550 won ne, ƙimar 1% da kuɗi mafi ƙasa ya cika sharadi. (lambobi: 2)

l-m-h3-b0c41-34.title: Zaɓar gaurayen launuka idan akwai 12 L na Launi A kawai
l-m-h3-b0c41-34.goal: Idan za a sasanta tsakanin rabon haɗawa da iyakar ajiyar kaya, ka auna duk sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa wa juna, zaɓi sulhun da ya fi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c41-34.material: Dole ne a haɗa fenti Launi A da Launi B a rabon 3:2 don kada launin ya canza. Akwai 12 L na Launi A kawai a ajiya, Launi B kuma yana da yawa. Yi gwargwadon abin da za a iya.
l-m-h3-b0c41-34.s.s1.prompt: Wane zaɓi ne zai samar da mafi yawa yayin cika sharuɗɗan?
l-m-h3-b0c41-34.s.s1.o.a: Launi A 15 L + Launi B 10 L (25 L)
l-m-h3-b0c41-34.s.s1.r.a: Ba za a iya haɗa shi ba domin ya wuce ajiyar Launi A ta 12 L.
l-m-h3-b0c41-34.s.s1.o.b: Launi A 12 L + Launi B 8 L (20 L)
l-m-h3-b0c41-34.s.s1.o.c: Launi A 9 L + Launi B 6 L (15 L)
l-m-h3-b0c41-34.s.s1.r.c: Ya cika sharuɗɗan, amma ana iya samar da ƙari.
l-m-h3-b0c41-34.s.s1.o.d: Launi A 12 L + Launi B 13 L (25 L)
l-m-h3-b0c41-34.s.s1.r.d: 12 : 13 ba 3 : 2 ba ne, saboda haka launin zai canza.
l-m-h3-b0c41-34.s.s1.explain: Idan A ya kai 12 L, B ya zama 12÷3×2=8 L. 12:8=3:2 ne, saboda haka ana iya samar da 20 L.
l-m-h3-b0c41-34.s.s2.model.0: 12:8 daidai yake da 3:2, kuma yana amfani da dukan ajiyar A ta 12 L, saboda haka wannan shi ne mafi yawan abin da za a iya samarwa.
l-m-h3-b0c41-34.s.s2.model.1: A yana da 12 L kawai, saboda haka dole a sa B ya zama 12÷3×2=8 L don kada rabon ya canza.

l-m-h3-b0c42-23.goal: Idan buƙata ba tabbatacciya ba ce, auna sharuɗɗan masu saɓani wajen yanke adadin abincin rana, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c42-23.material: Akwatin abincin da aka sayar yana ba da riba 2000 won; wanda bai sayu ba asara 1000 won. Buƙata: akwati 10 yiwuwar 0.3; 20 yiwuwar 0.5; 30 yiwuwar 0.2. Auna haɗarin saura da damar rasa tallace-tallace.
l-m-h3-b0c42-23.s.s1.prompt: Wane adadin shiri ne ke ba da ƙimar da ake sa ran mafi girma?
l-m-h3-b0c42-23.s.s1.r.a: Dukkansu za su sayu, riba 20000 won, amma ana rasa damar sayar da ƙari.
l-m-h3-b0c42-23.s.s1.r.c: Ƙimar da ake sa ran 29000 won ce, ƙasa da ta 20.
l-m-h3-b0c42-23.s.s1.r.d: Asarar ragowar kaya ta yi yawa, ƙimar da ake sa ran 27000 won ce.
l-m-h3-b0c42-23.s.s1.explain: Ƙimar da ake sa ran bisa adadin shiri: 10=20000 won, 20=31000, 25=29000, 30=27000.
l-m-h3-b0c42-23.s.s2.model.0: Lissafin ƙimar da ake sa ran kowanne adadi yana nuna 20 mafi girma, 31000 won; shi ya dace. (lambobi: 20)
l-m-h3-b0c42-23.s.s2.model.1: 10 amintacce ne amma yana rasa dama; 25 ko 30 suna da asarar ragowa mai yawa. 20 ya fi dacewa.

l-m-h3-b0c42-29.title: Tambayoyi nawa ya kamata binciken ya ƙunsa?
l-m-h3-b0c42-29.goal: A zaɓen yawan tambayoyin bincike, auna duk sharuɗɗan saɓani, zaɓi daidaiton da ya fi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c42-29.material: Akwai tambayoyi 25 da dole a haɗa. Bisa yawan tambayoyi, rabon waɗanda suka amsa har ƙarshe shi ne 90% ga 20, 85% ga 25, 78% ga 30, da 60% ga 40. Sharuɗɗa: ① a haɗa dukkan tambayoyi 25 da ake buƙata ② aƙalla 80% su amsa har ƙarshe.
l-m-h3-b0c42-29.s.s1.prompt: Wane yawan tambayoyi ne ya cika sharuɗɗan biyu?
l-m-h3-b0c42-29.s.s1.r.a: Rabon masu amsawa ya yi yawa, amma ba za a iya saka tambayoyi 25 da ake buƙata ba.
l-m-h3-b0c42-29.s.s1.r.c: Rabon waɗanda suka amsa 78% ne, bai kai 80% ba.
l-m-h3-b0c42-29.s.s1.r.d: Rabon waɗanda suka amsa 60% ne, ya yi ƙasa sosai da 80%.
l-m-h3-b0c42-29.s.s1.explain: Tambayoyi 25 sun haɗa dukkan waɗanda ake buƙata kuma rabon amsa 85% ne, don haka sharuɗɗan biyu sun cika.
l-m-h3-b0c42-29.s.s2.model.0: Tambayoyi 25 sun haɗa dukkan waɗanda ake buƙata kuma rabon amsa 85% ne, don haka sharuɗɗan biyu sun cika.
l-m-h3-b0c42-29.s.s2.model.1: 20 tambaya sun yi kaɗan, 30 da 40 kuma masu amsawa sun kasa 80%; saboda haka 25 ya dace.

l-m-h3-b0c42-34.goal: A iyakar gwajin gano cuta, auna duk sharuɗɗan saɓani, zaɓi daidaiton da ya fi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c42-34.material: Ga kowace iyaka, waɗannan su ne yawan marasa lafiyar da aka rasa da yawan masu lafiya da suka samu sakamako tabbatacce (ƙararrawar ƙarya). 40: 1·30, 50: 3·18, 60: 6·9, 70: 10·4. Sharadi: cikin marasa lafiya 5 ko ƙasa da aka rasa, a sami mafi ƙarancin ƙararrawar ƙarya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-34.s.s1.prompt: Wace iyaka ce ta cika sharadin?

l-m-h3-b0c42-34.s.s1.r.c: Ƙararrawar ƙarya 9 ce, amma an rasa 6, fiye da 5.
l-m-h3-b0c42-34.s.s1.explain: Iyakokin da aka rasa 5 ko ƙasa su ne 40 da 50; a cikinsu 50 mai ƙararrawar ƙarya 18 ce mafi ƙaranci, saboda haka ta dace.
l-m-h3-b0c42-34.s.s2.model.0: Iyakokin da kaɗai ke sa a rasa 5 ko ƙasa su ne 40 da 50; 50 tana da ƙarancin ƙararrawar ƙarya 18, saboda haka amsar 50 ce.
l-m-h3-b0c42-34.s.s2.model.1: 60 da 70 sun rasa fiye da 5, ba su dace ba; daga 40 da 50, 50 tana da ƙarancin ƙararrawar ƙarya kuma ta cika sharuɗɗan biyu.

l-m-h3-b0c43-21.title: Mintuna nawa kafin lokacin makaranta za a tashi?
l-m-h3-b0c43-21.goal: Auna haɗarin makara da lokacin tashi masu saɓani, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c43-21.material: Lokacin zuwa makaranta yana bin normal, matsakaici 25 minti, karkacewa 5. Ƙimar makara ≤5%, a tashi a ƙarshen lokacin da zai yiwu. P(Z>1)=0.16, P(Z>1.6)=0.055, P(Z>2)=0.023, P(Z>3)=0.001.
l-m-h3-b0c43-21.s.s1.prompt: Mintuna nawa kafin fara makaranta za a tashi?
l-m-h3-b0c43-21.s.s1.r.a: Yiwuwar makara kusan 16% ce, ta wuce 5%.
l-m-h3-b0c43-21.s.s1.r.b: Yiwuwar makara kusan 5.5% ce, ta wuce 5%.
l-m-h3-b0c43-21.s.s1.r.d: Yiwuwar makara ƙanƙanta ce amma dole a tashi da wuri.
l-m-h3-b0c43-21.s.s1.explain: Idan an tashi minti 35 kafin, (35−25)÷5=2, yiwuwar makara kusan 2.3%. Cikin waɗanda ≤5%, wannan shi ne mafi kusa da lokacin farawa.
l-m-h3-b0c43-21.s.s2.model.0: Minti 35 kafin yana ba da z=2, yiwuwar makara kusan 2.3%≤5%. Minti 33 yana da 5.5%, saboda haka 35 shi ne mafi ƙarshen lokacin tashi.
l-m-h3-b0c43-21.s.s2.model.1: Minti 30 ko 33 sun wuce haɗarin 5%; cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da suka cika, tashi minti 35 kafin shi ne mafi ƙarshen lokaci. (lambobi: 5)

l-m-h3-b0c43-34.material: Zaɓi hanya don binciken lokacin barci. Sharuɗɗa: ① ba za a san sunaye ba ② aƙalla 70% su amsa ③ cikin waɗannan, amsoshin ƙarya su yi kaɗan. Tattaunawa mai suna: amsa 95%, ƙarya 3%. Takardar sirri: 75%, 10%. Hanyar haɗin sirri: 82%, 6%. Binciken masu sa kai kawai: 40%, 4%.

l-m-h3-b0c43-34.s.s1.o.b: Binciken takarda ba tare da suna ba
l-m-h3-b0c43-34.s.s1.r.b: Ya cika sharuɗɗan, amma amsoshin ƙarya 10% ne, fiye da hanyar haɗin.
l-m-h3-b0c43-34.s.s1.o.d: Binciken masu sa kai kawai ba tare da suna ba
l-m-h3-b0c43-34.s.s1.r.d: Rabon amsa 40% ne, bai cika ② ba.
l-m-h3-b0c43-34.s.s1.explain: Waɗanda suka cika ① da ② su ne takarda sirri da hanyar haɗi; daga cikinsu hanyar haɗin da ke da ƙananan amsoshin ƙarya ta dace.
l-m-h3-b0c43-34.s.s2.model.0: Hanyoyin da ba su da suna kuma masu amsa aƙalla 70% su ne takarda da hanyar haɗi kawai; daga cikinsu hanyar haɗi tana da ƙarancin amsoshin ƙarya, 6%, saboda haka ita ce daidai.

l-m-h3-b0c49-34.s.s1.r.c: Azuzuwa 4 sun fi ƙarancin da ake buƙata 5 ƙasa, don haka siffar rarrabuwar ta ɓace.
l-m-h3-b0c49-34.s.s1.r.d: Azuzuwan sun yi kaɗan, don haka ba za a iya ganin siffar rarrabuwar ba.
l-m-h3-b0c49-34.s.s1.explain: Idan aka fara daga 10 da zangon 10, akwai azuzuwa 8 daga 10–20 zuwa 80–90, wanda ya cika sharadin azuzuwa 5 zuwa 8.
l-m-h3-b0c49-34.s.s2.model.0: Da zangon aji 10, akwai azuzuwa 8 daga 10–20 zuwa 80–90, saboda haka yana tsakanin 5 da 8.
l-m-h3-b0c49-34.s.s2.model.1: Zango 5 yana bada azuzuwa 16, da yawa ne; 20 da 40 kuma suna bada azuzuwa 4 da 2, kaɗan ne; don haka zango 10 ya dace.

l-m-h3-b0c49-35.title: Zaɓen adadin ma'aunai tsakanin kuskuren matsakaici da lokaci
l-m-h3-b0c49-35.goal: Ka yi la'akari da sharuddan da suka saɓa wa juna wajen adadin ma'aunai na lokacin faɗuwa; zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa sannan ka bayyana dalilin.
l-m-h3-b0c49-35.material: Idan kuskuren (karkacewar ma'auni) na auna lokaci guda 2 seconds ne, kuskuren matsakaicin ma'aunai n kusan 2/√n seconds ne. Kana son kuskuren matsakaici ya zama 0.5 seconds ko ƙasa da haka, amma auna lokaci guda yana ɗaukar mintuna 3, kuma kana da mintuna 60. Kana son amfani da mafi ƙarancin lokaci yadda zai yiwu.
l-m-h3-b0c49-35.s.s1.prompt: Wane adadin ma'aunai ne ya fi dacewa yayin kiyaye sharuddan?
l-m-h3-b0c49-35.s.s1.r.a: Kuskuren 2/3≈0.67 seconds ne, ya fi 0.5 seconds girma.
l-m-h3-b0c49-35.s.s1.r.c: Ya cika sharuddan, amma sau 16 ya isa, don haka ƙarin ma'auni ɓata lokaci ne.
l-m-h3-b0c49-35.s.s1.r.d: Kuskuren 0.4 seconds ne, amma yana ɗaukar mintuna 75, wanda ya wuce mintuna 60.
l-m-h3-b0c49-35.s.s1.explain: Idan an maimaita sau 16, kuskuren 2/4=0.5 seconds ne kuma lokacin mintuna 48 ne. Maimaitawa ƙasa da haka yana bada kuskuren da ya fi 0.5 seconds.
l-m-h3-b0c49-35.s.s2.model.0: Idan an maimaita sau 16, kuskuren 2/√16=0.5 seconds ne kuma yana ɗaukar mintuna 48; saboda haka ya cika sharuddan biyu da mafi ƙarancin ma'aunai.
l-m-h3-b0c49-35.s.s2.model.1: Idan an maimaita sau 15 ko ƙasa da haka, kuskuren ya fi 0.5 seconds; sau 25 kuma yana ɗaukar mintuna 75, ya wuce lokacin da ake da shi, don haka sau 16 ya dace.

l-m-h3-b0c50-06.title: Sharuɗɗan yanke shawarar girman bincike
l-m-h3-b0c50-06.goal: Yi la’akari da duk sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa wa juna game da yanke shawarar girman bincike, zaɓi mafita mafi dacewa sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0c50-06.material: Masu gudanar da bincike 3 suna bincike a ranakun aiki 10. Mutum 1 zai iya bincikar mutane 10 a rana aƙalla, kuma domin a amince da sakamakon, samfurin dole ya ƙunshi mutane aƙalla 100. Ana son wakiltar dukkan ɗalibai 900 na makarantar.
l-m-h3-b0c50-06.s.s1.prompt: Wane shiri ne ya fi cika dukkan sharuɗɗan?
l-m-h3-b0c50-06.s.s1.r.a: Za a iya bincikar mutane 300 aƙalla, saboda haka ba zai yiwu ba.
l-m-h3-b0c50-06.s.s1.r.b: Adadin bai kai 100 ba, kuma zaɓen abokai kawai yana karkatar da sakamakon.
l-m-h3-b0c50-06.s.s1.o.c: Binciki mutane 120 da aka zaɓa bisa bazata
l-m-h3-b0c50-06.s.s1.o.d: Binciki mutane 350 da aka zaɓa bisa bazata
l-m-h3-b0c50-06.s.s1.r.d: Matsakaicin adadi 300 ne, saboda haka ba za a iya kammala shi cikin lokacin ba.
l-m-h3-b0c50-06.s.s1.explain: Mafi yawan da za a iya bincika shi ne 3×10×10=300. Samfurin bazata kaɗai da ya kai aƙalla 100 amma bai wuce 300 ba shi ne mutane 120.
l-m-h3-b0c50-06.s.s2.model.0: Bincikar mutane har 300 mai yiwuwa ne, kuma ana buƙatar aƙalla 100; saboda haka samfurin bazata na mutane 120 yana cika sharuɗɗan biyu kuma yana wakiltar jama’a.
l-m-h3-b0c50-06.s.s2.model.1: Mutane 900 ko 350 sun wuce 300 kuma ba zai yiwu ba, 40 kuma bai kai 100 ba, saboda haka 120 ne ya fi dacewa.

l-m-h3-b0c50-21.title: Ƙayyade Yawan Tambayoyin Bincike
l-m-h3-b0c50-21.material: Dole ne a gano abubuwa 4: lokacin barci, maki lissafi, aji, da lokacin motsa jiki. Tambaya 1 tana ɗaukar daƙiƙa 30, kuma domin amsoshi su yi kyau binciken bai kamata ya wuce mintuna 3 ba.
l-m-h3-b0c50-21.s.s1.o.a: Rage shi zuwa tambayoyi 3, a tambayi barci da maki kawai
l-m-h3-b0c50-21.s.s1.r.a: Ba za ka gano aji da lokacin motsa jiki ba.
l-m-h3-b0c50-21.s.s1.r.b: Yana ɗaukar mintuna 6, ya wuce mintuna 3.
l-m-h3-b0c50-21.s.s1.o.c: Yi tambaya sau biyu kan kowanne canji, tambayoyi 8
l-m-h3-b0c50-21.s.s1.r.c: Yana ɗaukar mintuna 4, ya wuce mintuna 3.
l-m-h3-b0c50-21.s.s1.o.d: Yi tambaya sau ɗaya kan kowane canji, tambayoyi 4
l-m-h3-b0c50-21.s.s1.explain: Tambayoyi 4 suna ɗaukar mintuna 2, ƙasa da mintuna 3; an tambayi duk abubuwa 4. Tambayoyi 3 sun bar canji, 8 da 12 kuma sun wuce lokaci.
l-m-h3-b0c50-21.s.s2.model.0: Tambayoyi 4 suna ɗaukar mintuna 2, ƙasa da mintuna 3, kuma suna tambayar abubuwa 4 duka; saboda haka sun cika sharuɗɗan biyu.
l-m-h3-b0c50-21.s.s2.model.1: Tambayoyi 3 sun bar canji, 8 da 12 kuma mintuna 4 da 6 ne; saboda haka tambayoyi 4 ne suka fi dacewa.

l-m-h3-b0c50-28.title: Gyara Ikirari Bisa Misalin Karyatawa
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.goal: A cikin ikirarin da aka gyara bisa la'akari da misalin karyatawa, auna sharuddan da ke karo da juna, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa sannan ka bayyana dalilinsa.
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.material: Ikirari: Dukan lambobin asali mara'au ne. An samu misalin karyatawa 2. Kana son gyara ikirarin, kuma dole ne ya guji wannan misalin tare da kasancewa gaskiya ga yawan lambobin asali yadda zai yiwu.
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s1.prompt: Wane ikirari ne ya cika sharuddan biyu kuma ya fi dacewa?
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s1.r.a: Lambobin asali kamar 3, 5, 7 misalan karyatawa ne.
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s1.o.b: Dukan lambobin asali da suka fi 2 girma mara'au ne
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s1.o.c: Lambobin asali mara'au kaɗai su ne 3, 5, da 7
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s1.r.c: Akwai wasu lambobin asali mara'au kamar 11, saboda haka ba gaskiya ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s1.r.d: Akwai lambobin asali kamar 2, 3, 5, saboda haka ba gaskiya ba ne.
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s1.explain: Lambar asali da ta fi 2 girma ba za ta iya zama ninkin 2 ba, saboda haka mara'au ce. Wannan yana kauce wa misalin karyatawa 2 kuma ya haɗa sauran lambobin asali duka.
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s2.model.0: Lambar asali da ta fi 2 girma za ta rabu da 2 idan ma'auru ce, saboda haka mara'au ce; wannan yana cire misalin karyatawa 2 kawai, don haka ikirari ne mafi faɗi da yake gaskiya.
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s2.model.1: 3, 5, 7 lambobin asali ne mara'au, saboda haka ikirarin cewa ma'auru ne ba gaskiya ba ne; jimlar da aka ƙara “mafi girma fiye da 2” kuwa gaskiya ce kuma ita ce mafi faɗi.

l-m-h3-b0c50-34.title: Yanke Shawarar Abin da Za a Sanya a Rahoto
l-m-h3-b0c50-34.goal: Yayin zaɓar yadda za a gabatar da sakamako a rahoto, auna sharuddan da suka saɓa wa juna, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa sannan ka bayyana dalilinsa.
l-m-h3-b0c50-34.material: Za a sanya tallace-tallacen watanni 12 na yankuna 5 (ƙimomi 60) a rahoto mai shafi ɗaya. Mai karatu yana son ganin yanayin ƙaruwa da sauri kuma ya duba ainihin ƙimomi idan ya buƙata.
l-m-h3-b0c50-34.s.s1.r.a: Ƙimomin ainihi suna nan, amma ba za a iya ganin yanayin da sauri ba.
l-m-h3-b0c50-34.s.s1.r.b: Ana iya ganin yanayin ƙaruwa, amma yana da wuya a duba ainihin ƙimomi.
l-m-h3-b0c50-34.s.s1.o.c: Ƙara jadawalin taƙaitaccen bayanin kowace kwata a gefen jadawalin layi
l-m-h3-b0c50-34.s.s1.o.d: Buga jadawalin kek 5, ɗaya ga kowane yanki
l-m-h3-b0c50-34.s.s1.r.d: Ba sa nuna sauye-sauyen wata-wata ko yanayin ƙaruwa.
l-m-h3-b0c50-34.s.s1.explain: Jadawalin yana nuna yanayin, jadawalin taƙaitawa kuma yana nuna ainihin ƙimomi. Amfani da su tare a shafi ɗaya yana cika sharuddan biyu.
l-m-h3-b0c50-34.s.s2.model.0: Jadawalin layi yana nuna yanayin da sauri, jadawalin taƙaitawa kuma yana bada ainihin ƙimomi; saboda haka ya cika sharuddan biyu.
l-m-h3-b0c50-34.s.s2.model.1: Jadawali kaɗai ba ya nuna yanayin, jadawali layi kaɗai kuma ba ya fayyace ƙimomi; don haka shirin amfani da su tare ya fi dacewa.

l-m-h3-b0d07-08.title: Tallafi: mai yawa a shekarar farko, jimilla kada ta wuce iyaka
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.topic: Jerin lissafi na ninkuwa marar iyaka
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.goal: Yi la’akari da sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa wa juna game da kuɗin tallafi na shekarar farko wanda ke raguwa kowace shekara, zaɓi mafita mafi dacewa sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.material: Ana bayar da tallafi kowace shekara. Tallafin shekarar farko a ne (cikin raka’ar 10,000 won), kuma kowace shekara ta gaba tana zama r ninki na shekarar da ta gabata. Ko da aka ci gaba har abada, jimillar dole ta kasance aƙalla 100 × 10,000 won; tallafin shekara ta biyu dole ya zama aƙalla 70% na shekarar farko, kuma tallafin shekarar farko ya zama mafi girma.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.prompt: Wane tsari ne ya cika dukkan sharuɗɗan yayin da shekarar farko ta kasance mafi girma?
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.r.a: Ya cika sharuɗɗan, amma za a iya ƙara tallafin shekarar farko yayin da jimillar take cikin 100 × 10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.r.c: Jimillar ita ce 35/0.3≈116.7 × 10,000 won, wadda ta wuce 100 × 10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.r.d: Jimillar 100 ce (a raka’ar 10,000 won), amma tallafin shekara ta biyu 60% ne, wanda ya yi ƙasa da 70%.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.explain: Jimillar ita ce a/(1−r)≤100, kuma r≥0.7. Idan r=0.7, a≤30, saboda haka tallafin shekarar farko mafi girma shi ne 30 × 10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s2.model.0: Dole r ya zama aƙalla 0.7, kuma jimillar a/(1−r)≤100; saboda haka a=30 idan r=0.7 shi ne mafi girma, kuma wannan tsari ya fi dacewa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s2.model.1: Ƙara r yana rage a≤100(1−r), rage r kuma yana karya sharaɗin 70%; saboda haka r=0.7, a=30 shi ne matsaya mafi dacewa.

l-m-h3-b0d07-13.title: Ƙwallon da ke billa: sassauci da jimillar nisan da aka yi tafiya
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.goal: Auna duk sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa wa juna a ƙimar r da ƙwallo ke billa da ita, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa, kuma bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.material: An saki ƙwallo daga tsayin 3m, kuma a kowane billa tana tashi zuwa r ninki na tsayin baya. Sassaucin r ya zama aƙalla 0.5, jimillar nisan da za ta yi har ta tsaya kuma bai wuce 15m ba. Cikin waɗannan, sa r ta zama mafi girma.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s1.prompt: Wane tsari ne ke cika kowane sharadi tare da r mafi girma?
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s1.r.a: Yana cika sharuɗɗan, amma ana iya ƙara r har zuwa 2/3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s1.r.b: Sassaucin ya gaza 0.5, don haka ya saɓa wa sharuɗɗan.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s1.r.d: Jimillar nisan tafiya 21m ce, ta wuce 15m.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s1.explain: Daga jimillar nisan 3(1+r)/(1−r)≤15, r≤2/3. Mafi girman r da ke cika sharuɗɗan ita ce 2/3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s2.model.0: Jimillar nisan 3(1+r)/(1−r) ba ta wuce 15 ba, saboda haka r≤2/3; domin r ta yi girma, 2/3 ce ta fi dacewa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s2.model.1: Idan r=0.75, nisan 21m ne, ya wuce iyaka; idan r=2/3, daidai 15m ne, saboda haka wannan shi ne tsarin da ke da sassauci mafi girma cikin iyaka.

l-m-h3-b0d07-21.title: Gwangwani masu ƙarar ɗaya da aka yi cikin iyakar tsawo
l-m-h3-b0d07-21.goal: Auna duk sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa wa juna game da radius na gwangwanin silinda mai ƙarar 500cm³, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa, sannan bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0d07-21.material: Kana ƙera gwangwanin silinda mai ƙarar 500cm³. Ƙaramin faɗin saman yana rage kayan da ake buƙata, kuma don ya shiga kan shalfe tsayinsa bai wuce 8cm ba.
l-m-h3-b0d07-21.s.s1.prompt: Wane tsari ne ke amfani da ƙaramin abu tare da cika sharuɗɗan?
l-m-h3-b0d07-21.s.s1.r.c: Faɗin saman shi ne mafi ƙanƙanta, amma tsayin 8.6cm ya wuce iyakar 8cm.
l-m-h3-b0d07-21.s.s1.r.d: Yana cika sharuɗɗan, amma faɗin saman ya fi girma, kusan 357.
l-m-h3-b0d07-21.s.s1.explain: Don tsayin da bai wuce 8cm ba, r≥4.46. Faɗin saman yana ƙaruwa idan r>4.3, saboda haka 4.5, kusa da iyaka, ya dace.
l-m-h3-b0d07-21.s.s2.model.0: Idan h≤8, r aƙalla 4.46 ne; a wannan zangon faɗin saman yana ƙaruwa da r, saboda haka r=4.5 kusa da iyaka ya dace.
l-m-h3-b0d07-21.s.s2.model.1: r=4.3 yana da mafi ƙaramin faɗin saman amma ya wuce iyakar tsayi, don haka ba a yarda da shi ba; r=5 yana da aminci amma faɗin saman ya yi yawa, saboda haka 4.5 shi ne sulhu.

l-m-h3-b0d07-35.title: Zaɓen tsawon kwano da aka yi ta juyar da ƙarfi
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.goal: Yayin zaɓen tsawon kwanon da aka yi ta juyar da y=√x, auna sharuddan da suka saɓa wa juna, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa sannan ka bayyana dalilinsa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.material: An yi kwano ta juyar da lanƙwasar y=√x (0≤x≤h) a gefen ginshiƙin x (naúra: cm). Dole ne ƙarar ta kai aƙalla 50π cm³, tsawo h kuma bai wuce 12 cm ba; ƙaramar h tana rage kayan da ake amfani da su.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s1.prompt: Wane h ne ya cika sharuddan kuma yake amfani da mafi ƙarancin abu?
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s1.r.c: Yana cika sharuddan, amma yana amfani da abu fiye da h=10.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s1.r.d: Tsawon ya wuce iyakar 12 cm (ƙarar ita ce 98π).
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s1.explain: Ƙarar ita ce π∫₀ʰ x dx=πh²/2. Domin ta kai aƙalla 50π, ana buƙatar h≥10; mafi ƙaramin h, wato h=10, shi ne mafi dacewa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s2.model.0: Daga πh²/2≥50π, ana samun h≥10; saboda haka cikin iyakar tsawo 12 ko ƙasa da haka, h da ke amfani da mafi ƙarancin abu shi ne 10.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s2.model.1: h=8 yana da ƙarar da ba ta isa ba, h=12 da 14 kuma suna amfani da ƙarin abu ko sun wuce iyaka; saboda haka h=10, wanda ya cika sharadin ƙarar dai-dai, shi ne mafi dacewa.

l-m-h3-b0d07-36.title: Yanke Shawarar Lokacin Cika Tankin Ruwa
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.goal: Yayin zaɓen lokacin cika tankin ruwa, auna sharuddan da suka saɓa wa juna, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa sannan ka bayyana dalilin.
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.material: Ruwa yana kwarara zuwa cikin tanki da adadin (12−2t) lita/minti a lokacin t minti (0≤t≤6). Dole a cika shi da aƙalla lita 33 amma kada ya wuce ƙarfin lita 36; kuma ƙaramin lokaci ya fi kyau.
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.s.s1.prompt: Daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan, wane lokaci ne mafi dacewa da ya cika sharuɗɗan?
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.s.s1.r.a: Lita 27 ne, wanda bai kai lita 33 ba.
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.s.s1.r.b: Lita 32 ne, wanda ya yi ƙasa da abin da ake buƙata da lita 1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.s.s1.r.d: Lita 36 ne kuma ya cika sharuɗɗan, amma yana ɗaukar fiye da minti 5.
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.s.s1.explain: Adadin ruwan da ya kwarara cikin minti T shi ne 12T−T². Daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan, mafi ƙarancin lokaci da ya kai aƙalla lita 33 shi ne minti 5 (lita 35).
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.s.s2.model.0: A cikin minti T, ruwa 12T−T² lita ke kwarara; bayan minti 5 ya kai lita 35, wanda ya kai aƙalla 33, minti 4 kuma yana ba da lita 32, wanda bai isa ba.
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.s.s2.model.1: Minti 5 da minti 6 duka suna kaiwa aƙalla lita 33 ba tare da wuce lita 36 ba, amma ƙaramin lokaci ya fi kyau, saboda haka minti 5 ne ya fi dacewa.
