l-m-h3-b0d08-21.title: Gidan dabbobi a gefen bango: tsawo, faci da tsawon bango
l-m-h3-b0d08-21.goal: Yayin zaɓen girman gidan dabbobi mai siffar murabba'i mai tsawo a gefen bango, auna sharuddan da suka saɓa wa juna, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0d08-21.material: An gina gidan dabbobi mai siffar murabba'i mai tsawo a gefen bango (babu shinge a bangon). Facinsa dole ne ya kai aƙalla 150m², gefen da ke jikin bango y bai wuce 15m ba, kuma idan tsawon shingen 2x+y ya fi guntu ya fi kyau.
l-m-h3-b0d08-21.s.s1.prompt: Wane shiri ne ya cika sharuddan kuma yake da shinge mafi guntu?
l-m-h3-b0d08-21.s.s1.r.a: Shingen shi ne mafi guntu, amma y ya wuce 15m.
l-m-h3-b0d08-21.s.s1.r.c: Yana cika sharuddan, amma shingen ya fi tsawo, 36.5m.
l-m-h3-b0d08-21.s.s1.explain: Idan faci 150 ne kuma y≤15, to x≥10. Tsawon 2x+150/x yana ƙaruwa idan x≥8.7; saboda haka x=10 (35m) ne mafi guntu.
l-m-h3-b0d08-21.s.s2.model.0: Da y≤15 da xy=150, x≥10; tsawon 2x+150/x yana ƙaruwa idan x>8.66; don haka x=10 yana bada mafi ƙarancin tsawo, 35m.
l-m-h3-b0d08-21.s.s2.model.1: Ba tare da iyaka ba, x≈8.7 ne zai fi guntu, amma y zai wuce 15, don haka ba a yarda da shi ba. Mafi ƙaramin x da ke kiyaye iyakar, x=10, shi ne mafi dacewa.

l-m-h3-b0d08-34.title: Yanke girman lanƙwan samar da hasken rana
l-m-h3-b0d08-34.goal: Game da ma’aunin k a samarwa p(t)=k·t(12−t), auna sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa wa juna, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa, sannan bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0d08-34.material: A cikin awanni 12 na rana, samar da hasken rana p(t)=k·t(12−t) kW ne. Makamashin yau da kullum ya zama aƙalla 288kWh, kuma mafi girman samarwa bai wuce iyakar grid 36kW ba.
l-m-h3-b0d08-34.s.s1.prompt: Wane k ne ke cika sharuɗɗan biyu?
l-m-h3-b0d08-34.s.s1.r.a: Makamashin yau da kullum 230.4kWh ne, ƙasa da 288.
l-m-h3-b0d08-34.s.s1.r.b: Mafi girman samarwa 43.2kW ne, ya wuce 36.
l-m-h3-b0d08-34.s.s1.r.c: Mafi girman samarwa 54kW ne, ya wuce 36.
l-m-h3-b0d08-34.s.s1.explain: Makamashin ∫₀¹² k·t(12−t)dt=288k ne, kuma mafi girman samarwa a t=6 shi ne 36k. k=1 kaɗai ke cika sharuɗɗan biyu.
l-m-h3-b0d08-34.s.s2.model.0: 288k≥288 na makamashi yana bada k≥1, mafi girman 36k≤36 kuma yana bada k≤1; don haka k=1.
l-m-h3-b0d08-34.s.s2.model.1: Idan k ƙarami ne, makamashin ba zai isa ba; idan babba ne, samarwa ta wuce iyaka. k=1 ya cika iyakokin duka daidai, shi ne sulhu.

l-m-h3-b0d08-35.goal: Game da tsayin a na sashen baka y=a·x(2−x), auna sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa wa juna, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa, sannan bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.material: Sashen baka na gada y=a·x(2−x) ne (0≤x≤2, ma’aunin m). Tsayin tsakiya a ya zama aƙalla 3m, faɗin sashen bai wuce 6m² ba, kayan kuma su yi kaɗan gwargwadon iko.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s1.prompt: Wane a ne ke cika sharuɗɗan tare da ƙaramin amfani da kaya?

l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s1.explain: Tsayin tsakiya a ne a x=1, faɗi kuma ∫₀²a·x(2−x)dx=4a/3 ne. Mafi ƙarancin kaya da ke cika a≥3 da 4a/3≤6 shi ne a=3.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s2.model.0: Tsayin a≥3 ne, kuma 4a/3≤6 daga faɗi yana bada a≤4.5; don ƙaramin kaya a=3 ya fi dacewa.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s2.model.1: a=2 bai kai tsayi ba, a=6 ya wuce iyakar faɗi; don haka a=3, wanda ya cika tsayin da ƙyar, shi ne mai ƙarancin kaya.

l-m-h3-b0d08-39.title: Yanke lokacin isowa daga jadawalin gudu
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.goal: Game da lokacin isowa T a v(t)=6t−t², auna sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa, kuma bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.material: Gudun batu v(t)=6t−t² ne (0≤t≤6). Canjin matsayi bayan T sakan ya zama aƙalla 27, gudun v(T) a lokacin isowa bai wuce 5 ba, kuma gajeren T ya fi kyau.
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s1.prompt: Menene mafi gajeren T da ke cika sharuɗɗan?
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s1.r.a: Canjin matsayi kusan 26.7 ne, ƙasa da 27, kuma v(4)=8.
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s1.r.b: Canjin matsayi 30.4 ya isa, amma v(4.5)=6.75>5.
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s1.r.d: Yana cika sharuɗɗan duka, amma ya fi T=5 tsawo.
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s1.explain: Canjin matsayi 3T²−T³/3 ne, gudun isowa kuma 6T−T². A T=5 su ne 33.3 da gudun 5, don haka duka sun cika.
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s2.model.0: A T=5, canjin matsayi 3·25−125/3≈33.3 ne, aƙalla 27, kuma v(5)=5 bai wuce 5 ba; daga zaɓuɓɓukan wannan shi ne mafi gajeren lokaci.
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s2.model.1: T=4 da 4.5 ba su dace ba domin nisan ya gaza ko gudun ya yi yawa, T=6 kuma ya yi tsawo; T=5 ya cika sharuɗɗan kuma ya fi dacewa.

l-m-h3-b0d09-08.title: Yanke tazarar maɓuɓɓugan ruwa a tafkin ellips
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.topic: Cibiyoyin hankali da babban axis na ellips
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.goal: A tsarin tafkin ellips, yi la’akari da sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa wa juna, zaɓi mafita mafi dacewa sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.material: Wannan tafkin ellips ne mai babban axis tsayayye na 20 m. Ƙaramin axis dole ya zama aƙalla 12 m, nisan tsakanin maɓuɓɓugan ruwa biyu (cibiyoyin hankali) aƙalla 10 m, kuma hanyar tafiya (kewayen) ta zama mafi tsawo. Idan babban axis iri ɗaya ne, mafi kusancin siffar da’ira yana da kewayen da ya fi tsawo.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s1.prompt: Wane nisa tsakanin maɓuɓɓugan ruwa (2c) ne ya fi dacewa?
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ya karya sharaɗin cewa nisan tsakanin maɓuɓɓugan ya zama aƙalla 10 m.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s1.r.c: Idan c=9 ne, ƙaramin axis kusan 8.7 m ne, wanda ya yi ƙasa da 12 m.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s1.r.d: Yana cika sharuɗɗan, amma kewayen ya fi guntu fiye da idan tazarar 10 m ce.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s1.explain: Daga 2c≥10 da sharaɗin ƙaramin axis 2√(100−c²)≥12 ana samun c≤8, saboda haka 5≤c≤8. Kewayen ya fi tsawo idan c ya fi ƙanƙanta, wato 5, saboda haka 2c=10.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s2.model.0: Nisan tsakanin maɓuɓɓugan ruwa aƙalla 10 m ne, kuma daga sharaɗin ƙaramin axis ana samun c≤8. A cikin wannan kewayo, 2c=10 ya fi kusantar da’ira kuma yana ba da kewayen da ya fi tsawo, don haka ya dace.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s2.model.1: 14 m ma yana cika sharuɗɗan, amma yana sa sifar ta fi nesa da da’ira kuma hanyar tafiya ta fi gajarta. Don haka 10 m, mafi ƙarancin tazara da ta cika sharuɗɗan, ita ce mafi kyau.

l-m-h3-b0d09-27.goal: Yi la’akari da dukkan sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa wa juna game da alkiblar kwale-kwalen da ke haye kogi, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalilinsa.
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.material: Kogin yana gudana gabas da gudun (3, 0). Kwale-kwalen yana iya tafiya da gudun 5 a kan ruwa, kuma dole ne ya isa wurin da ke kai tsaye arewa a gabar kishiyar. Cikin waɗannan sharuɗɗa, ana son a haye cikin sauri sosai.
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s1.prompt: Wane gudun motsi ne ya dace kwale-kwalen ya samar (dangane da ruwa)?
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s1.r.a: Gudun sakamakon shi ne (3, 5), don haka kwale-kwalen yana karkata gabas.
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s1.r.b: Gudun sakamakon shi ne (−2, 0), don haka kwale-kwalen ba zai iya haye zuwa arewa ba.
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s1.r.c: Gudun sakamakon shi ne (−1, 3), don haka ruwa yana tura shi yamma.
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s1.explain: Don soke kwararar gabas (3,0), ɓangaren x dole ne ya zama −3. Tunda girman gudun 5 ne, ɓangaren y ya zama 4, kuma gudun sakamakon shi ne (0,4).
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s2.model.0: Don isa wurin kai tsaye arewa, ɓangaren x na gudun sakamakon dole ne ya zama 0, saboda haka ɓangaren x na kwale-kwalen shi ne −3. Sai ɓangaren y ya zama 4, kuma saurin haye zai fi girma.
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s2.model.1: (0,5) zai haye da sauri, amma kwale-kwalen zai karkata, saboda haka ba za a yarda da shi ba. Daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da suka cika sharadin, (−3,4) ya fi dacewa, kuma gudun sakamakon shi ne 4.
